name: Hollyoaks
description: The daily soap that follows the loves, lives and misdemeanours of a group of people living in the Chester village of Hollyoaks where anything could, and frequently does, happen...

videos.title: Off on One
videos.overview: A video spin-off from 1998 which sees Rob Hawthorne seek revenge against Kurt Benson. The storyline comes to a dramatic conclusion with Rob and Kurt fighting on a boat. Rob rushes at Kurt, however he moves out of the way and Rob falls into the sea, with everyone believing he is dead.

videos.title: October 23, 1995
videos.overview: Sarah is hospitalised when a joyride with her friends in Kurt's car goes disastrous. Louise's 17th birthday ends in tears over her cheating boyfriend. Kurt sets his sights on Natasha.

videos.title: October 27, 1995
videos.overview: Natasha and Dawn worry about Louise in the aftermath of the break-up. Kurt receives bad news about his car.

videos.title: October 30, 1995
videos.overview: Ollie has a terrible day when he loses both his money to Kurt and his girlfriend to Tony. Tickets for the Ragmoor Park concert prove as rare as gold dust, while Natasha tries to console Louise but her stock of sympathy is running low.

videos.title: November 7, 1995
videos.overview: Louise's morale reaches an all-time low, while Natasha finds a shoulder to cry on. Tony's love life is still intact, but the same cannot be said for his bike.

videos.title: November 13, 1995
videos.overview: Kurt takes the opportunity to throw a party in the Bensons' absence, but has to take measures to protect himself from Louise's advances. When Ollie turns up uninvited, she's reminded that not all's fair in love and war. Maddie plays fairy godmother to Dawn, whilst Jambo causes a stir with his choice of date - Margaret the Cow!

videos.title: November 20, 1995
videos.overview: Terry is making Dawn's life a misery at home, while Jambo's new friend proves unpopular with everyone else - and he's told to put him out to pasture. Julie finds out the path to true love never runs smoothly, while Tony looks like losing his job - can Dawn and Natasha save the day?

videos.title: November 27, 1995
videos.overview: Jambo discovers that every cow has a silver lining while Kurt's worried about Tony, who's been missing all night. Natasha is determined to sort out Sarah's life with a proposed trip to Alton Towers - but is she really thinking of her own love life?

videos.title: December 4, 1995
videos.overview: As the two parties plan to rendezvous at Alton Towers, those travelling with Bazz discover that he is on a different wavelength. Kurt finds himself outvoted, as the others decide to go off in search of little green men.

videos.title: December 11, 1995
videos.overview: Quick-thinking Ollie saves Lucy from great embarrassment. Jambo sees his glamorous companion's true identity finally unveiled, and Kurt eagerly prepares for a seasonal kissathon with his trusty mistletoe.

videos.title: December 18, 1995
videos.overview: Natasha is surprised and pleased to see Kurt performing on stage at The Dog in the Pond with her father, but he is shocked when she is put off him after getting her father's approval! Louise is in for a big Christmas surprise, while sleigh bells make way for wedding bells in the Cunningham household. Jambo's mobile grotto is a hit.

videos.title: 1 January 1996
videos.overview: The Bensons party while their parents are away, and Ollie has a smashing time, forcing Jambo and Tony to help him out of a predicament. Kurt's friends plot to get him together with Natasha, but the pair themselves remain stubborn, and Natasha resolves to keep her distance in the new year.

videos.title: 8 January 1996
videos.overview: Louise decides to treat herself to a new hair-do. Ruth decides to stick around. Kurt is in a quandary about his blue velvet trousers, and Maddie is out for the last laugh at the Video Road Race competition.

videos.title: 15 January 1996)
videos.overview: Louise goes mad with the hair dye. Tony's caught in a love triangle. Ollie and Sarah continue their secret rendezvous.

videos.title: 22 January 1996
videos.overview: Ollie and Sarah are an item... but they've never actually met! Kurt goes on a disastrous double date with Lucy, and Louise embarks on her first driving lesson.

videos.title: 29 January 1996
videos.overview: Ollie faces the music, and Louise prepares for the college revue. Jambo's on the road to discovery.

videos.title: 5 February 1996
videos.overview: Tony is in the mood for celebrating and Louise is given a helping hand by newcomer Dermot. Dawn tries to tempt her mother into a life of sin, and Jambo searches for his father.

videos.title: 12 February 1996
videos.overview: Romance is in the air as Kurt receives a mystery Valentine's card, and Ollie plays Cupid for an unsuspecting couple.

videos.title: 19 February 1996
videos.overview: It's pancakes at dawn for Kurt and Rob on the day of the Riverbank College Pancake Race. Meanwhile, Natasha is determined to find the identity of the admirer who sent her a St. Valentine's Day card.

videos.title: 26 February 1996
videos.overview: Carol imagines all manner of hideous consequences as Kurt prepares for his parachute jump, and Louise's obsession with Dermot intensifies.

videos.title: 4 March 1996
videos.overview: Maddie is not amused by the anonymous love letters, Ruth and Kurt go parachuting, and Louise makes a startling discovery.

videos.title: 11 March 1996
videos.overview: Lucy's eighteenth birthday party takes place, and Natasha tries to make Kurt jealous by going with Dermot - a decision which proves harmful when Rob gives Dermot a little something to help him score with her.

videos.title: 18 March 1996
videos.overview: Natasha's friends refuse to believe that she took drugs, as the police start asking questions. The truth of Natasha's fatal overdose begins to sink in for Rob and Dermot, and Maddie realises she has a lot more to cope with.

videos.title: 25 March 1996
videos.overview: It's confession time at the Bensons'. The police tell Maddie she is on her own but she's got a stalker for company. Tony is faced with a choice between Julie and his pension plan.

videos.title: 1 April 1996
videos.overview: Jambo has difficulty proving his innocence to Mrs. Benson, while Maddie is worried - is she the victim of an April Fool, or is the stalker after her? Lucy finds what she has been looking for but she has lost her man.

videos.title: 8 April 1996
videos.overview: Ollie gets a job at the video shop. Jambo continues the search for his long-lost father and Terry is playing mind games with Dawn. Meanwhile, Ruth discovers that Kurt is up to his old tricks.

videos.title: 15 April 1996
videos.overview: Ollie's got himself a job at the video shop but would swap it for a lads holiday. Jambo's search for his long lost father continues. Ruth plays mind games with Dawn, who's trying to keep a secret from her father.

videos.title: 22 April 1996
videos.overview: Louise tries to contact Natasha. Bazz searches for a cure for his hiccups and Ruth persuades Kurt to play with a local band.

videos.title: 29 April 1996
videos.overview: Kurt is annoyed with Rob for eating his dinner, everyone is worried about Louise and her unearthly sightings and Susi seems to have found a desperate remedy to her problems.

videos.title: 6 May 1996
videos.overview: Kurt receives a letter which makes him rush out and kiss Ollie. Terry is lashing out at everyone in sight, Jambo is having parental problems and the Medium has revelations about Natasha and Dawn.

videos.title: 13 May 1996
videos.overview: Susi drives people crazy with curiosity; Jambo hires a private eye, which upsets Dawn; and Louise's behaviour is disturbing.

videos.title: 20 May 1996
videos.overview: Ollie is forced into doing some revision, Ruth and Kurt are getting a lot closer, and the fashion show continues to be the bane of Jude's life.

videos.title: 27 May 1996
videos.overview: Excitement builds about the celebrity guest Michael has invited as Jude's fashion show nears its finale. Meanwhile, Ruth makes herself home at the Bensons', Ollie skips his revision, and Dawn tries to come to terms with her past.

videos.title: 3 June 1996
videos.overview: The welfare officer is due to visit the Cunningham household; Cindy may have to choose one parent or the other. Maddie and Michael do lunch and Kurt has a little something to make Ruth smile.

videos.title: 10 June 1996
videos.overview: Jambo tries to convince Kurt and Tony to come on a lads' holiday; Julie isn't convinced that Tony will save himself for their wedding night and Rob is stealing from the rich to give to the poor - namely Dermot.

videos.title: 17 June 1996
videos.overview: The race is on for Carol and Lucy to fix Kurt's guitar; Dawn finally tells her father about the baby and Ollie and Stan land Susi in it at the video shop.

videos.title: 24 June 1996
videos.overview: Maddie and Michael's romantic breakfast date is ruined by road rage. Ruth tells Kurt that only one of them will be going to America.

videos.title: 1 July 1996
videos.overview: Ruth and Kurt take their bike tests and wonder which of them will pass. Dawn and Jude find themselves a new flatmate, while Kurt thinks he has discovered why Ruth doesn't want him to accompany her to America.

videos.title: 8 July 1996
videos.overview: Ruth and Kurt are not speaking and time is running out because Ruth is off to the United States today, so Kurt turns to Jambo for advice. Dawn, meanwhile is worried about Jude - she thinks she is behaving oddly.

videos.title: 23 September 1996
videos.overview: Tony manages to rush from Scotland and, with the help of the check-in officer, makes it to the gate. Tony, eager to get over Julie, manages to flirt with several women and ends up having a one-night-stand. Meanwhile, Dawn and Jude are furious when Terry evicts Lewis in favour of Vinnie.

videos.title: 26 September 1996
videos.overview: Ibiza proves to be a nightmare for the lads. Bazz can't get his track played, Jambo and Jurt haven't pulled but Tony is attracting the beach babes by the dozen.

videos.title: 30 September 1996
videos.overview: While Rob and Lucy return from their holiday, Kurt finds his attempts to scare Carol backfire.

videos.title: 3 October 1996
videos.overview: Is Rob making promises to Lucy that he cannot keep? Tony panics as his past catches up with him.

videos.title: 7 October 1996
videos.overview: Susi and Cindy are friends again, at least temporarily. Jude is one step closer to discovering what is wrong with her and Tony feels unable to express his frustrations to Julie. Ollie, meanwhile, has more than his exam results to keep him happy.

videos.title: 10 October 1996
videos.overview: Jude receives her test results and Jambo hears the outcome of his uncle's will but is having problems remembering what type of car he has been bequeathed. While Angela and Terry are away on honeymoon, Max resumes his heavy drinking and Ollie faces a charge of having sex with a minor.

videos.title: 14 October 1996
videos.overview: Max discovers the downside of excessive drinking and as Ollie tries to dig himself out of a hole over Mandy, Lewis pushes him further back in. Julie attempts to develop her relationship with Tony, but he is strangely reluctant.

videos.title: 17 October 1996
videos.overview: Julie becomes listless when Tony rejects her and Jambo meets the woman of his dreams. Ollie tries to escape from his troubles by hiding out in army camouflage.

videos.title: 21 October 1996
videos.overview: Susi and Ollie are brought closer together. Michael is anxious to sort things out with Maddie and Bazz.

videos.title: 24 October 1996
videos.overview: Michael invites Maddie to a ball, what Lucy finds out about Rob frightens her and Susi's argument with Terry finds her homeless.

videos.title: 28 October 1996
videos.overview: Lucy and Carol spend the night nursing Rob while Susi is tracked down. Maddie gets a disturbing insight into Michael's darker side.

videos.title: 31 October 1996
videos.overview: Angela learns she is in need of an urgent operation and Maddie tries to avoid the determined Michael. Meanwhile, Rob plans a theft.

videos.title: 4 November 1996
videos.overview: Rob and Dermot wait for the right moment to strike, Angela is taken to hospital and Bazz and Jambo do their first-ever children's party.

videos.title: 7 November 1996
videos.overview: Ruth is out of favour with her flatmates and Angela makes a will. Dermot and Rob's plans for the perfect crime go horribly wrong.

videos.title: 11 November 1996
videos.overview: Rob and Lucy manage to escape from the submerged car. Rob dives back down for Dermot and Carol but is he too late? Ruth tells Dawn she thinks she might be pregnant.

videos.title: 14 November 1996
videos.overview: Rob insists the accident was caused by road rage but the police have their doubts and things look bleak for Carol. Maddie is back to her old form when an old flame turns up and Ruth has a new job as the editor of the college magazine but Kurt has his doubts about it.

videos.title: 18 November 1996
videos.overview: Lucy and Kurt decide to tell D.C. Norton the truth about Rob. Lewis finds himself a lodger while Jambo loses his cool.

videos.title: 21 November 1996
videos.overview: The Cunninghams are getting seriously worried about Terry's disappearance. Rob is under threat.

videos.title: 25 November 1996
videos.overview: The day has arrived for Rob's court hearing and Kurt and Jambo wouldn't miss it for the world.

videos.title: 28 November 1996
videos.overview: Ruth takes drastic measures when Kurt "seeks justice" on Rob. Rob narrowly makes it out alive when he is confronted by the drug dealers. Angela is horrified to discover that her marriage to Terry was a sham and bigamous.

videos.title: 2 December 1996
videos.overview: Kurt, Jambo and the gang decide to shop Rob but that's nothing to what the dealers have in mind for him.

videos.title: 5 December 1996
videos.overview: The news about Rob is all over the papers. Dawn and Jude have second thoughts about acting as match-makers for Maddie.

videos.title: 9 December 1996
videos.overview: Maddie wants Michael out of her life but it is not that simple. Angela returns home from the hospital.

videos.title: 12 December 1996
videos.overview: Maddie tells Jude the truth about Michael. Ruth has evidence against Tony's activities in Ibiza but will she use it against him? Ollie has got an- other date but he may not have much of a love life if Kurt gets his hands on him.

videos.title: 16 December 1996
videos.overview: Jude is thrilled at Michael's plans for Christmas and Julie is furious at Tony's first executive decision.

videos.title: 19 December 1996
videos.overview: Dawn dishes out a few home truths to Jude, much to the poor girl's dismay -- but it's almost certain she'll soon start plotting her revenge. Meanwhile, the future looks brighter for Susi.

videos.title: 23 December 1996
videos.overview: Christmas doesn't go well in the Benson and Cunningham households; Kurt reveals his decision to drop out of school and is thrown out of home, whilst Dawn tells her parents that Beth is seriously ill and needs her help.

videos.title: 26 December 1996
videos.overview: Tony seems flustered when he and Julie escape to a hotel for their long-awaited night together. Kurt is not impressing Jambo with his slovenly ways. Dawn makes a decision that could save her daughter's life.

videos.title: 30 December 1996
videos.overview: The day of Susi and Lewis's party dawns with Kurt looking for free laundry services. Tony and Julie have trouble finding privacy.

videos.title: 2 January 1997
videos.overview: Kurt is homeless, unemployed and a pedestrian. Dawn can think of nothing but the impending kidney transplant.

videos.title: 6 January 1997
videos.overview: Kurt is outstaying his welcome at Jambo's and Dawn has shocking news for the father of her child.

videos.title: 9 January 1997
videos.overview: Kurt returns home and gives his parents a fright, Bazz has taken to sleeping in his van and the father of Dawn's child agrees to donate an organ.

videos.title: 13 January 1997
videos.overview: Kurt endures his first day at the family firm and Jude finally sees Michael for what he is.

videos.title: 16 January 1997
videos.overview: Stan resorts to blackmailing Ollie to get a date, while Jude and Michael's split has worrying consequences for Maddie.

videos.title: 20 January 1997
videos.overview: Tony is annoyed with Julie when her new image starts affecting their bank balance, whilst an innocent remark from Ruth makes Angela put two and two together. Meanwhile, Maddie and Jude conspire to get Michael out of their lives once and for all.

videos.title: 23 January 1997
videos.overview: Mandy agrees to set up a date for Stan and Cindy. Ruth makes an untimely visit to the hospital.

videos.title: 27 January 1997
videos.overview: It's parents evening at Hollyoaks Comprehensive School and Darren is acting strange; Ruth has even bigger problems and decides to confront her father over his affair with Dawn. Jambo and Anita take an immediate dislike to each other and Tony is distraught when his worse fears are confirmed.

videos.title: 30 January 1997
videos.overview: Kurt, Jambo and Julie worry when Tony goes missing, but find him in hospital after accidentally swallowing the engagement ring. Ruth is horrified as Mr. Osborne tells her about his affair with Dawn and the circumstances regarding Beth. Darren attempts to fool the headteacher with a letter supposedly written by his parents, whilst Lucy and Bazz have dinner together as friends.

videos.title: 3 February 1997
videos.overview: Susi learns that Jude is no easy task master. Dawn has outstayed her welcome at Jude's flat. Ruth talks to her mother about her father and learns some surprising news. Julie begs forgiveness from Tony until Jude exposes him as a complete hypocrite.

videos.title: 6 February 1997
videos.overview: Ruth has a showdown with Angela. Jambo persuades Kurt to go on a mysterious double date with him.

videos.title: 10 February 1997
videos.overview: Bazz is left horrified by a face from his past. Jude accuses Ruth of sabotage. Dawn is left devastated in her pursuit of Jambo, Carol makes a move on Kurt, and Lewis takes delight in embarrassing Stan.

videos.title: 13 February 1997
videos.overview: Bazz confides in Lucy over his sexuality as it becomes village gossip. Kurt and Jambo ae annoyed as Tony takes things too far. Susi wonders how she can reconcile with her family, whilst Cindy attempts to profit from charity work.

videos.title: 17 February 1997
videos.overview: Susi gets a letter which makes her smile while Tony is in the depths of despair and stinking to high heaven. Jude has the perfect punishment for Cindy when her moneymaking scheme backfires and Jambo and Anita cook up a strange feast which is interrupted by a jilted Janice.

videos.title: 20 February 1997
videos.overview: Mrs. Benson receives a blast from the past and insists on telling her family. Julie moves in with Susi.

videos.title: 24 February 1997
videos.overview: Kurt is getting lot of aggro at work from Spike, while Ollie asks Stan to be a go-between for him and Mandy. Jambo argues with his mother about family values and Tony is jolted back into action after receiving a letter.

videos.title: 27 February 1997
videos.overview: Maddie and Jude realise that they have been lured into a trap.

videos.title: 3 March 1997
videos.overview: Michael continues to hold his hostages and forces Jude to drive them to Loch Lomond where he plans to marry Maddie. Kurt and Ruth have alerted the police but concern is rising for the captives' safety.

videos.title: 6th March 1997
videos.overview: Life is returning to normal after the siege. Jambo issues an ultimatum.

videos.title: 10 March 1997
videos.overview: Jambo fights the urge to say "I told you so" to his mother when she splits up with Mr. Gardner. Tony is devastated to learn that Julie is seeing other people and Lewis finally agrees to let Ollie and Mandy see each other.

videos.title: 13 March 1997
videos.overview: Carol finally seems to be over Kurt and Lewis offers to help out with Jude's serious money problems.

videos.title: 17 March 1997
videos.overview: Susi is distraught to hear of her father's death, and has a blazing row with her mother. Bazz has a row with Lewis, and is the victim of a homophobic attack later that night. Jambo is fired from the garden centre whilst Spike continues to get on the wrong side of Kurt.

videos.title: 20 March 1997
videos.overview: Jambo is inconsolable after losing his job at the garden centre but at least Anita has accepted his Easter invitation. Bazz is discovered battered and bruised but won't let Ruth write about the attack in the magazine.

videos.title: 24 March 1997
videos.overview: Lucy and Bazz go to the pub, where they are horrified to run into Spike and his friends. Jambo endeavours to get his job back from Mr. Gardner.

videos.title: 27 March 1997
videos.overview: Tony is furious at Julie for selling the hearse and decides that two can play at that game: Susi receives a letter which could change her life forever and Dawn and Jude receive a surprise visit.

videos.title: 3 April 1997
videos.overview: Tony and Julie battle over control of the video shop. Jude's career is in tatters. The police question Kurt over Spike's fall.

videos.title: 7 April 1997
videos.overview: Cindy attempts to take Mandy's mind off her domestic troubles. Marilyn reckons it's time Tony showed Julie who's boss.

videos.title: 10 April 1997
videos.overview: Bazz struggles with the restrictions caused by his head injury, and his insistence on returning to normality results in him crashing his van and starting a fight with Lewis. Darren and Max make a porn disk, Mr. Benson's trip down memory lane with Mrs. Benson goes terribly, and the grand opening of Parker's takes place.

videos.title: 14 April 1997
videos.overview: Ollie has a brainwave about the college magazine. Jude's modelling career soon becomes a charade. Susi enjoys an out-and-out spending spree.

videos.title: 17 April 1997
videos.overview: Stan discovers he's been voted Hunk of the Month.

videos.title: 21 April 1997
videos.overview: Susi is shocked by everyone's behaviour when Rob suddenly appears. Max is in bother when the Osbornes turn up on his doorstep looking for Darren. Kurt needs help when a surprise witness turns up.

videos.title: 24 April 1997
videos.overview: Darren's absence drives the Osbornes to distraction, and Mandy worries a night of passion might lead to more than she bargained for.

videos.title: 28 April 1997
videos.overview: Kurt worries about his upcoming trial, whilst Ruth begins to blame herself for the whole ordeal occurring in the first place. Meanwhile, Mr. Richardson finds Darren and Max's porno disk but lets them off scot free by breaking it in half before he can see what's on it.

videos.title: 1 May 1997
videos.overview: Love-struck Ruth puts Kurt before her A-Level revision and trouble looms on the horizon for Cindy. Tony and Marilyn return from their disastrous holiday.

videos.title: 8 May 1997
videos.overview: Dawn arrives just in time to prevent Cindy flying off the handle, while Tony and Julie patch up their rocky romance - but for how long?

videos.title: 12 May 1997
videos.overview: Ruth wishes she'd kept her mouth shut. Kurt and Rob go missing. Julie manages to keep Tony in the dark as she hatches her plot.

videos.title: 15 May 1997
videos.overview: A client makes an indecent proposal to Jude. Tony and Julie have their own request for Julie's parents.

videos.title: 19 May 1997
videos.overview: Rob seems to have found a real friend in Susi. Jambo and Dawn receive a strange message telling them to be in a certain street at a certain time. It's Cindy's birthday - but she has one huge problem after her party.

videos.title: 22 May 1997
videos.overview: Kurt and Ruth drop a bombshell on their parents.

videos.title: 29 May 1997
videos.overview: Lucy and Bazz go to the Lake District, and Bazz opens up about his worries regarding his upcoming operation. Later, he has a fall and is knocked unconscious. Ruth and Kurt join them, and Kurt worries about his impending trial.

videos.title: 2 June 1997
videos.overview: Mandy and Cindy have some explaining to do. Lewis and Lucy await news of Bazz. Romance blossoms between Rob and Susi.

videos.title: 5 June 1997
videos.overview: The contents of a parcel prompt Maddie to recall less happy times. Lucy realises she must warn Susi about Rob. Jude makes a desperate bid to get her ailing course work back on track.

videos.title: 9 June 1997
videos.overview: Spike takes the stand as Kurt's court case opens, and Jude includes one of Susi's dresses in her exhibition.

videos.title: 10 June 1997
videos.overview: Kurt is depressed over the court case and Ruth suggests he run away. Rob recovers from the stabbing, but there's no sign of Susi.

videos.title: 11 June 1997
videos.overview: The Bensons are on tenterhooks waiting for Kurt and Ruth to arrive, and Jude is thrust into the limelight.

videos.title: 12 June 1997
videos.overview: Kurt and Ruth make the most of their last hours together before the verdict is announced. Jude gets herself into so much trouble she thinks blackmail is the only answer to her problems.

videos.title: 16 June 1997
videos.overview: Jude's shocking revelations leave the Osbornes in turmoil. Dawn becomes the subject of local gossip, but then Carol lets slip something about Jambo and Anita.

videos.title: 19 June 1997
videos.overview: Ollie wants Mandy to model for Babe of the Month. Jude's debts catch up with her. Ruth pleads with her mother not to go to America.

videos.title: 23 June 1997
videos.overview: Jambo has his mind on seduction. Lewis reaches the end of his tether with Maddie and her locks. Jude waits for a fateful phone call from the agency.

videos.title: 26 June 1997
videos.overview: Jambo is caught in a compromising position and Mandy gets into trouble over Cindy's pregnancy testing kit.

videos.title: 30 June 1997
videos.overview: Jude is very upset over her ordeal but will not go to the police. Jambo's sins finally catch up with him. Lucy and Bazz come clean about being a couple.

videos.title: 3 July 1997
videos.overview: Jude opens up to Lewis, and he gives her advice on how to re-connect with her family. Bazz and Lucy decide to make their relationship official. Tony is annoyed when Julie's mother takes over their wedding plans. Jambo struggles as Lisa says that they need to end their affair.

videos.title: 7 July 1997
videos.overview: Lewis decides to issue Maddie a few home truths. Jude prepares to face her father. Mandy delivers an ultimatum to Cindy.

videos.title: 10 July 1997
videos.overview: Jude tells Lewis the truth about her 'escort' work. Cindy finally plucks up the courage to take a pregnancy test.

videos.title: 14 July 1997
videos.overview: Mr. Osborne returns from America with bad news for Ruth. The Cunninghams face a testing time when Jude and Cindy come clean.

videos.title: 17 July 1997
videos.overview: Ollie begins to panic as Lewis questions him about the Babe of the Month. Julie and Tony say "I do" at their wedding rehearsal.

videos.title: 21 July 1997
videos.overview: The band's concert in The Dog in the Pond is a success. Kurt is horrified to hear that Lucy and Bazz have gotten together. Jambo is upset to be rejected by Lisa.

videos.title: 24 July 1997
videos.overview: Jambo makes a shocking discovery about his parents. Kurt and Ruth struggle to settle into married life. Tony and Julie disagree over wedding plans, and Cindy wonders if she can tell her mother about her pregnancy.

videos.title: 28 July 1997
videos.overview: Jambo tries to make his parents see sense. Angela tells Jude to get her act together.

videos.title: 31 July 1997
videos.overview: Sparks fly between Lisa and Janice, and Jambo faces the consequences of his recent behaviour.

videos.title: 4 August 1997
videos.overview: Maddie gets a shock when she opens up the shop. Jambo is caught in the crossfire of a family row. The Cunninghams' run of bad luck seems set to continue.

videos.title: 7 August 1997
videos.overview: Tony's stag night arrives much to Kurt's delight, but is the groom himself really sure about the whole marriage business? Meanwhile, Julie's hen party goes with a bang thanks to some mischievous planning by the girls.

videos.title: 11 August 1997
videos.overview: It's Tony and Julie's wedding day, and Tony begins to have second thoughts. However, he is thrilled when Julie changes her mind and jilts him at the altar. Meanwhile, Jude accidentally causes a fire, and she and Maddie are trapped.

videos.title: 14 August 1997
videos.overview: Cindy begins to feel the pressure of keeping the baby a secret from her parents. Tony is horrified at the damage to the video shop. Jude thinks about her drinking problem while languishing in hospital.

videos.title: 18 August 1997
videos.overview: Carol prepares to comfort Tony by asking him to go to Newquay with her. Jude's resolve threatens to break - can she stay off the booze?

videos.title: 21 August 1997
videos.overview: Carol spots a hunky surf dude while living it up at Newquay.

videos.title: 28 August 1997
videos.overview: Carol is regretting her one night stand with Tony, whilst Jambo is worried that Dawn will have doubts about their night of passion.

videos.title: 1 September 1997
videos.overview: Matt's offer of help comes as a complete surprise to Bazz. Jambo hopes Kurt will prove a friend indeed and put him up for a few nights.

videos.title: 4 September 1997
videos.overview: Kurt enrolls at college and gets more than he bargained for. Ollie is shocked to meet Stan's girlfriend and Tony's hopes of moving into his own flat are shattered.

videos.title: 8 September 1997
videos.overview: Jambo finds himself a lodger. Ruth plans to use the radio interview to expose Rob as a murderer. Lewis discovers that his father has started drinking again.

videos.title: 11 September 1997
videos.overview: The band are signed to a label - and promptly sack their manager for being too square. Jambo and Tony discover the ups and downs of living together.

videos.title: 15 September 1997
videos.overview: Mandy's photographs cause a row. Janice is frightened that she's losing Jambo. Tony finds sleeping in a hammock isn't all it's cracked up to be.

videos.title: 18 September 1997
videos.overview: Bazz is in a fix when Matt asks for a meeting to discuss business, whilst Tony and Jambo have another falling out.

videos.title: 22 September 1997
videos.overview: Ruth and Kurt are convinced that they are going to win the radio debate and the tension mounts as they wait for the ballot results. Bazz and Matt meet up - can Bazz resist the chemistry that's happening between them?

videos.title: 25 September 1997
videos.overview: Ruth and Kurt wait on tenterhooks as the ballot results are announced, but Rob is confident on a victory. Jambo tries to get his parents back together. Lewis walks on Bazz and Matt, causing red faces all round.

videos.title: 29 September 1997
videos.overview: Mandy gives Ollie the elbow. Ruth faces repercussions after the school drug debate. Lewis gives Bazz an ultimatum. Tony and Jambo agree to call a ceasefire, but then Jambo finds Dawn with another man.

videos.title: 2 October 1997
videos.overview: Ollie gets a date for his driving test. Mr. Osborne makes Dawn an offer he thinks she can't refuse, but she is more concerned with enlisting Lewis's help when Mr. Richardson has too much to drink.

videos.title: 6 October 1997

videos.overview: Justin's animosity towards his dad runs deep, will he ever come to terms with what has happened? Ellie's hatemail shows no sign of abating. Liam has a fright as his past comes back to haunt him. (Part 2)

videos.overview: Ellie is beginning to freak out as Steph's plans get underway. Mel and Justin struggle to come to terms with their father's death. Max is livid to see Mandy working back in Gnosh Village. after everything that's happened.

videos.title: 2 September 2004
videos.overview: Ellie is eager to get some sort of reaction from her mum and cooks her a meal. Mel, Sophie, Darlene and Justin throw a party while their parents are away. Jake moves into the Davies' newly transformed bachelor pad.

videos.title: 3 September 2004
videos.overview: Mel and Sophie are disgusted when they realise what they are actually eating from the barbecue. Liam secretly meets up with Jules. Steph's wicked game plan continues when she accompanies Ellie to sign on at HCC.

videos.title: 6 September 2004
videos.overview: Debbie is shocked to witness Steph stealing a necklace.

videos.title: 7 September 2004
videos.overview: Abby is horrified when Zara tells her about the initiation ceremony.

videos.title: 8 September 2004
videos.overview: Mel and Sophie panic when Justin doesn't return home. Steph continues her campaign of terror against Ellie. Russell takes Liam for a drink to help take his mind of the ex-girlfriend from hell. Bombhead tries to show Cameron how amazing the world is. Max is frustrated by Tony's presence in the village.

videos.title: 9 September 2004
videos.overview: Liam confronts Jules about her kiss with Russell. Steph gives Ellie a night out to remember. A beautiful stranger walks in to Darren's life. Beth makes a swift exit when Darren tries to cajole her into going upstairs.

videos.title: 10 September 2004
videos.overview: Mrs. Owen is beside herself with worry; how can she help her son? O.B. tries to convince Jack to take on his business idea. Sally has no sympathy for her wayward daughter and tells her she needs to start pulling her weight. Liz comforts Justin in his hour of need.

videos.title: 13 September 2004
videos.overview: Darren flirts with Beth, unaware of her secret. Ellie is excited at the prospect of starting college. Liam won't have a bad word said against Jules and thinks that she's lying about being responsible! D.I. Davies arrives back from London.

videos.title: 14 September 2004
videos.overview: Mr. Osborne is worried about Beth. Debbie is worried that Steph is going too far. Ali thinks Justin is out of order when he continues to test Mrs. Hunter to the limits! Dannii wants to go home for a few days as the boredom of the summer holidays sets in.

videos.title: 15 September 2004
videos.overview: Ellie phones in sick at work after trying, and failing, to get the paint out of her hair. Justin is humiliated by Mrs. Taylor when she walks him to school with Mel. Joe is worried about meeting the Carbones. Max tries to find out more about Beth from O.B.

videos.title: 16 September 2004
videos.overview: Ellie is upset when she sees her photo in the paper. Nicole and Mrs. Owen anxiously wait for Liam to return. Joe is worried when Mr. Carbone tells him they are going to the woods to dispose of something. Josh and Justin bully Ali.

videos.title: 17 September 2004
videos.overview: Ellie is upset when she receives a wreath in the post. Mrs. Taylor tries to make Justin go to school, but he hyperventilates. Max wants to hire a private investigator to look for Beth. Liam tells Russell that Jules had an abortion.

videos.title: 20 September 2004
videos.overview: Max is worried about Tom's first day at school. Ellie is living on her nerves - constantly worried what is round the next corner. Meanwhile, Abby, Steph and Zara go on a shopping spree.

videos.title: 21 September 2004
videos.overview: Abby is looking forward to university. Steph is upset because she can't lead a normal life. Meanwhile, Darlene stirs trouble and Tom's behaviour gets worse at school.

videos.title: 22 September 2004
videos.overview: Justin is late for his home tutoring. A delighted Abby accepts Lee's proposal; will Romeo and Juliet get their happy ending after all? Jealous Darren wants a night out with his dad.

videos.title: 23 September 2004
videos.overview: Beth is pleased when Max gives her Dawn's pendant. O.B. is upset when Tom thinks Max is funnier. Lee is worried about Abby going to university. Bombhead gets the wrong end of the stick and asks Will if he will marry Lee! Debbie tells Steph the game's over and threatens to turn her in to the police.

videos.title: 24 September 2004
videos.overview: Abby decides she doesn't want to go to university any more; she gives Lee a love necklace to remind him of her. Justin hides his bong under Ali's bed. O.B. has a catering problem. Dan confronts Steph about Ellie and Steph admits everything to Dan. He warns Steph that if she continues her revenge on Ellie she may face prison.

videos.title: 27 September 2004
videos.overview: Lee waits anxiously for Abby to call. Mr. Taylor searches Justin's room for any traces of cannabis. Cameron offers a helping hand to Bombhead as he prepares for his mum's birthday party. Dannii, Stacey and Lisa get their wires crossed.

videos.title: 28 September 2004
videos.overview: Sophie tries to cover for Justin. Max is expecting a visit from his mum when Beth arrives. The Owens' put up a united front. Bombhead decides to write to the Pope. Craig thinks up a scam when he hears about Bombhead's wish for sainthood.

videos.title: 29 September 2004
videos.overview: Becca is persuaded to tutor Justin again despite her attempts to say no! Mr. Osborne wants to call a truce with Darren. Liam and Nicole try to wind up Russell, but every prank they pull seems to backfire. Steph visits Dan in the Pit Stop with some diabetic donuts!

videos.title: 30 September 2004
videos.overview: Bombhead is worried about his mum's party. Max is furious with Darren. Mrs. Taylor lies again to Becca and tells her that Justin's on his way home. Jake's concerned about Steph - he doesn't want her getting hurt by Dan.

videos.title: 1 October 2004
videos.overview: Beth gets followed on her way to see Max by her adopted brother, Noah. Lee's upset - does Abby still want him to be part of her life? Jake apologises to Dan for warning him away from Steph. Justin's been out all night and no one knows where he is...

videos.title: 4 October 2004
videos.overview: Jake is furious with Dan for kissing Steph. Tony tells Mandy about Beth arriving in Hollyoaks. Ali tells Mrs. Taylor his dad knew about Justin. Bombhead wants to be a saint and Craig is more than happy to canonise him... at a price!

videos.title: 5 October 2004
videos.overview: Mr. Osborne decides to make an appearance at Beth's party. Craig is worried when he sees Steph in an unusually good mood. Mr. Hunter is worried about Lee's choice of college course. Darlene warns Justin that Mrs. Taylor is reaching the end of her tether.

videos.title: 6 October 2004
videos.overview: Lee worries that, because he's doing Bodyology, Abby won't respect him. Jake is horrified to discover that Steph spent the night with Dan. Mrs. Hunter gets a promotion... to the new head of year eleven. Ali is pleased when he reads Shakespeare with Nicole in class.

videos.title: 7 October 2004
videos.overview: Darren tells Debbie about Steph and Dan. Bombhead convinces Lee to take him with him to Brighton, but will Lee go through with it? Ali bunks off school with Nicole. How will Darren react to Mr. Osborne's declaration of love?

videos.title: 8 October 2004
videos.overview: Lee and Bombhead head for Brighton. Darren is upset when Mr. Osborne lies to him. Justin is fed up with school; he hates being chaperoned by his mum every day. Debbie confronts Steph about her relationship with Dan.

videos.title: 11 October 2004
videos.overview: The day's arrived for Zara, Lisa and Cameron to move into halls. Lisa isn't interested in keeping the place tidy, she wants to check out the new talent in the SU Bar! Debbie's determined to get Dan back from Steph's clutches and asks Ben where he is. Ali finds Mrs. Taylor crying - life is becoming unbearable at home.

videos.title: 12 October 2004
videos.overview: A freshly-showered Zara manages to show Zak more than she bargained for. Dannii and Joe receive some bad news. Meanwhile, Sally is shocked to learn about Dan and Steph. Jack isn't feeling himself and Darren remains unsympathetic.

videos.title: 13 October 2004
videos.overview: Darren is terrified when he finds Mr. Osborne collapsed. Debbie tries to make Dan jealous by flirting with Ben. Mrs. Taylor tries to make Justin go to school. Justin suffers a panic attack when Mrs. Taylor shouts at him about the state of the house. Lee tries to sell Abby's engagement ring.

videos.title: 14 October 2004
videos.overview: Darren is quick to blame Beth for his dad's illness; will Mr Osborne pull through? Cameron vows to stop cleaning. Lisa is horrified when she sneaks into Zak's room and finds him in bed with Zara. Ali wants to move back to his mum's, and Mrs. Dean's on the warpath.

videos.title: 15 October 2004
videos.overview: Debbie tries to clear the air with Dan although he isn't interested; will Debbie accept that their relationship is over? Craig doesn't want Ali to move away. Darren feels guilty that he didn't realise how ill Mr. Osborne really was. Bella arrives in halls to witness a fight between Zara and Lisa.

videos.title: 18 October 2004
videos.overview: Ali furiously searches for his vinyl in Justin's room and shares his suspicions with Mrs. Taylor. Lee is worried about his first day in HCC; his white beautician's outfit is just too embarrassing! Steph and Dan go on a shopping spree. Liam arrives home happy; college was great, but how long before the students find out about his past?

videos.title: 19 October 2004
videos.overview: Mrs. Taylor suggests that they should all have a family meal together. Darren is concerned about Mr. Osborne being alone while he's working. Craig starts selling a miracle cure. Zara and Lisa decide to get to know Bella by going through her belongings!

videos.title: 20 October 2004
videos.overview: Craig gives a nervous Ali advice on how to flirt with Nicole. Zara and Lisa never want to drink again after waking up in someone else's halls, and Cameron decides to throw out all their belongings they've left lying around! And when will Dan and Debbie realise what each other still feels?

videos.title: 21 October 2004
videos.overview: Dan plans a day in the pub with Ben and Callum away from the over-possessive Steph. Zara can't write her essay because her computer's playing up. Mr. Taylor reluctantly gives Justin a job at Body Boost, only to catch him smoking cannabis on his first day. Bombhead is upset that Craig's miracle cure didn't make his mum better.

videos.title: 22 October 2004
videos.overview: Ali wants to be as far away from Justin as possible. Darren takes his dad to a football match. Lisa can't find her lucky knickers anywhere; she can't go to the freshers' foam party without them. Mrs. Hunter seems determined to stay at the Davies' and chat.

videos.title: 25 October 2004
videos.overview: Justin leaves home following an ultimatum by his mother. Joe gets an unexpected call from his estranged father. Instantly smitten, Lisa assumes James is a mature student and makes out she is a post-graduate. Debbie asks Dan out for a drink just as friends.

videos.title: 26 October 2004
videos.overview: A worried Ali asks D.I. Davies for help. Joe's estranged father arrives in Hollyoaks with the intention of patching things up. Dan is taken aback when Lee asks for a loan of £500. Lisa attends her first class and is shocked to find James is her lecturer. Dannii has a run-in with Stuart at Body Boost.

videos.title: 27 October 2004
videos.overview: Bella winds Lisa up when she catches her drooling over her hunky lecturer, James. A worried Ali is concerned that Justin may get a visit from the police due to his blabbing. Max goes into Gnosh Village and asks to put up sign advertising for a baby-sitter. Ellie confirms her application at HCC and is overjoyed.

videos.title: 28 October 2004
videos.overview: Ali tells Justin that it was him who told the police about the drugs. Max and O.B. have an ideal day planned choosing the suitable baby-sitter. Steph is very dismissive with Zara - she hasn't got much time for her friends, she's devoting her time to Dan! Joe and Dannii continue to desperately search for a housemate.

videos.title: 29 October 2004
videos.overview: Steph isn't in a great mood when she runs into Ellie, telling her about her split with Dan. An excited Dannii asks Mel to move in with her and Joe. Mandy walks into a deserted house to find Max behind the sofa and O.B. behind the curtains. Ali spots the bruise on Liz's face and doesn't believe for a minute that she "walked into a door".

videos.title: 1 November 2004
videos.overview: Bombhead is becoming apprehensive of Mr Cunningham's constant presence. Steph is distraught when Dan finishes with her. Meanwhile, everyone's excited by the forthcoming Romeo and Juliet auditions. Nicole and Candy are approached by a model scout. Feigning illness to stay off school, Justin has his mum at his beck and call.

videos.title: 2 November 2004
videos.overview: Lisa, Zak, Cameron and Steph head down to rehearsals and are less than impressed with James's "Augusto Boal exercises". Mrs. Dean is distraught; she's lost the eternity ring Johnno gave her. Lee seems to be willing to sacrifice his relationship with Bombhead to fit in with the college "in crowd". Candy and Nicole go to a modelling agency in search of fame and fortune.

videos.title: 3 November 2004
videos.overview: Ali is angst-ridden over his feelings for Nicole. Liz continues to keep a watchful eye over Justin, and enlists the help of Darlene and Sophie. Lisa makes a huge fuss about the part she has got in the college play. When the list goes up, Cameron is surprised to discover that he is Romeo! Bombhead wanders around the village in a state of turmoil.

videos.title: 4 November 2004
videos.overview: With no man, no prospects and no money, Debbie is forced to evaluate her situation. Bombhead is still behaving strangely and no one can get through to him. Nicole and Candy decide to go shopping. Lee does his best to impress the entertainments committee.

videos.title: 5 November 2004
videos.overview: It's D-Day for Lee; will his hard work for the bonfire party finally pay off? Candy convinces Nicole that she will look stunning for the party. Meanwhile, Frankie invites herself and Debbie to the Taylor-Burton family's BBQ.

videos.title: 8 November 2004
videos.overview: Concerned about Bombhead, Cameron thinks it'd be a good idea if Lee went to visit him. Ben is sick of Dan's constant moping and gives him a much-needed kick in the right direction. Liz is surprised when Justin bounds down the stairs in his uniform and gets off to school. Nicole is paranoid about being at school after the 'chicken fillet' incident.

videos.title: 9 November 2004
videos.overview: Mel and Sophie enter into a bit of sibling rivalry after hearing that there is some new "eye candy" at the Body Boost. Debbie is still in a good mood following the news that she is to become a singer on a ferry. Bombhead becomes frustrated with Lee not answering his calls, so he decides to call in at the Hunters' house.

videos.title: 10 November 2004
videos.overview: Frankie worries as there's no sign of Johnno. Bombhead continues to isolate himself from his friends. Bella hires Lisa as her assistant, whilst Dan sulks after learning of Debbie's impending departure.

videos.title: 11 November 2004
videos.overview: O.B.'s marketing skills are not what you would expect from a man with a first in Business Studies. Darlene, Mel, Sophie and Mrs. Taylor are about to set out on their eagerly awaited shopping trip to London. Dan has big plans to change his life although he refuses to tell Ben what they are. Mrs. Dean insists that her relationship with her husband is fine after being quizzed by Craig. Nicole and Candy start to put "Operation Lady Bumps" into action.

videos.title: 12 November 2004
videos.overview: Frankie's world falls apart. Things go from bad to worse for Liz, and Darlene wonders if Liz is on the verge of a breakdown. Candy and Nicole go to the cosmetic surgery clinic. Can Nicole bounce back from this unexpected disappointment?

videos.title: 15 November 2004
videos.overview: Mr. Dean returns home, but only to announce that he's leaving Mrs. Dean for a much younger woman. Mr. C tries to convince Bombhead to talk to somebody about his problems. Stacey and Lee head down to college early to try out Stacey's beauty therapy experiment. Nicole gets Russell to clean her room in return for her typing up an essay for him.

videos.title: 16 November 2004
videos.overview: The Deans are still reeling from Mr. Dean's treacherous departure into the arms of an impregnated younger woman. O.B. is ready to start his first day as a window cleaner. Darlene doesn't seem too excited about her 18th birthday. Nicole shows Candy the pictures of botched breast enlargement operations that Russell gave her.

videos.title: 17 November 2004
videos.overview: The HCC drama society's attempt to put on a production of Romeo and Juliet is fast becoming a tragedy in its own right. Darlene is angry at Justin's ungrateful and surly attitude. Nicole is still obsessed with the size of her breasts. O.B.'s career as a window cleaner is proving tougher than he thought.

videos.title: 18 November 2004
videos.overview: It's Darlene's birthday and her family are intent on giving her a surprise birthday party. Lee decides to take a trip to the Body Boost pool for a "cardio vascular workout", or "looking at the talent" as Stacey would call it. Nicole has convinced her mum to give her £1,000 from her savings fund. Craig's mum seems to be much more enthusiastic about his "date" with Darlene than he is.

videos.title: 19 November 2004
videos.overview: Cameron is still struggling with his Shakespeare, much to Bella's annoyance. At the Taylors', everyone is trying to come to terms with Darlene's injuries after Justin pushed her through a window. Candy tells Nicole that she had a dream in which Nicole was on the front cover of a magazine.

videos.title: 22 November 2004
videos.overview: Bombhead is terrified when he returns to his house to find the police waiting for him. Having failed in the world of bouncy castles and naked window cleaning, O.B. is down in the dumps. Liz is having second thoughts about getting the police involved with her family problems.

videos.title: 23 November 2004
videos.overview: Lee and Sally struggle to see Bombhead in such a state. Richard returns to Liz with demands about Justin. O.B. and Zara encounter each other at the Father Christmas auditions.

videos.title: 24 November 2004
videos.overview: Frankie's trying to put on a brave face since Johnno's departure. The gang are still reeling from the news of Bombhead's mum and feel incredibly guilty for neglecting him. Nicole becomes increasingly confused about her body image as she sits through Becca's lesson on beauty. Zara and O.B. audition for the role of Santa at the local grotto.

videos.title: 25 November 2004
videos.overview: Lee struggles to get Bombhead to talk. Bella hides the fact that it's her birthday from the rest of the group. Debbie plays down the cut on her face to Dan, embarrassed about her rendezvous with Darren last night. Liz is called in to school to talk about Justin. It's O.B. and Zara's first day on duty at the Grotto.

videos.title: 26 November 2004
videos.overview: Dan's pleased with himself for giving Darren a beating. Liz struggles with her conscience - should she send Justin away to Boot Camp? Cameron's ever hopeful of Bella helping him with his lines. Liam's suspicious of Nicole's holiday plans and questions her, but she denies everything. O.B.'s buzzing about his new business idea.

videos.title: 29 November 2004
videos.overview: Dan faces the music. Max doubts O.B.'s business acumen. Justin's blasé attitude to boot camp soon passes when the co-ordinator tells him he might not make it home for Christmas.

videos.title: 30 November 2004
videos.overview: Having learned that a female recruit, Paula, escaped boot camp, Justin is sure he won't be far behind her. Liam can't believe that Nicole would be so silly as to go ahead with plastic surgery. Lisa has a go at Dan for being so foolish. Tony is down on Christmas.

videos.title: 1 December 2004
videos.overview: Frustration over the impending court case with Darren is wreaking havoc on Dan's life. Justin's first encounter with the infamous Paula doesn't bode well. Bella continues to rile everyone apart from a smitten Cameron. Meanwhile, Christmas Land 2004's opening day arrives with the promise of a surprise celebrity! When the mystery celebrity arrives, Nicole is singled out in the crowd. But the celebrity turns out to be O.B., much to everyone's anger.

videos.title: 2 December 2004
videos.overview: Lee is convinced that Bombhead's idea of going back to work is the worst thing possible. Sally is devastated at the possibility of Dan going back to prison. Max and O.B. revel in their success while a furious Tony reads the headline in The Chester Herald.

videos.title: 3 December 2004
videos.overview: Justin and Paula deny they were involved in the chaos of the previous day. O.B. and Max are dumbfounded at the sight that beholds them when they arrive for work. Bombhead insists the only person who ever listens to him is Max's dad, Mr. C. Zak is still envious of the hold Bella seems to have over Cameron.

videos.title: 6 December 2004
videos.overview: Dan's terrified at the idea of going back to prison. Justin and Paula make a break for freedom. Tony continues to deny his involvement in the destruction of O.B.'s giant inflatable Santas. Bombhead decides it's time go home.

videos.title: 7 December 2004
videos.overview: Debbie tries to talk Darren into dropping the charges against Dan. Bombhead is determined to get the house back to normal and sets about cleaning it. Justin and Paula have to face their punishment for trying to escape Boot Camp. Cameron's finally getting the grasp of Shakespeare. Max is determined to make Christmas the best ever for Tom, but Tony's doing his utmost to spoil it.

videos.title: 8 December 2004
videos.overview: When Liz receives a seemingly heartfelt letter from Justin, she is tempted to let him come home. Dan is still angry with Debbie for trying to get Darren to drop the charges. Cameron's insecurities are beginning to get the better of him and he is ready to quit the play. The harsh reality of Bombhead's situation comes knocking at his door in the form a burly loan shark.

videos.title: 9 December 2004
videos.overview: Cameron has a spring in his step now that Bella has helped him get to grips with Shakespeare's verse. Mandy and Max's plans for Christmas don't seem to be tying in with Tony's. Justin's letter to his mum didn't have the results he expected. Bombhead is struggling to cope and is desperate for someone to help him.

videos.title: 10 December 2004
videos.overview: Bella isn't going to let Cameron walk away from the play without a fight. Whilst on an orienteering task, Paula notices that Justin has a developed an appetite to conform and isn't impressed. Ben is convinced that Dan still has a chance of persuading Debbie to stay in Hollyoaks. Bombhead needs to talk to Tony about his mounting problems, if only Tony would stop talking about himself.

videos.title: 13 December 2004
videos.overview: Joe and Stuart make a pact. The stage is set, but will James muster the strength to replace his leading lady? The lads are under orders from the school to make Tom's costume for the play; can Max and O.B. save the day? The Deans unite in a time of trouble.

videos.title: 14 December 2004
videos.overview: Debbie tells Frankie about Johnno's baby. Mandy forgets Tony's birthday. Joe gets up Stuart's nose. When Cameron turns down a night on the town, Zak is not pleased; there was a time when he wouldn't have said no.

videos.title: 15 December 2004
videos.overview: Zak is still concerned about the influence Bella holds over Cameron as the final dress rehearsal approaches. Frankie's despair deepens when her thoughts turn to what kind of Christmas the Deans have in store. Tony is in an unforgiving mood after Mandy forgot his birthday. After a lengthy discussion, Joe and Stuart reach a compromise and agree to spend a day in each other's shoes.

videos.title: 16 December 2004
videos.overview: Cameron is struck dumb with fright and announces he can't remember a thing; not even the arrival of Bella can snap him out of his panic. It's Stuart's turn to live by Joe's rules and he's horrified to start his day with a cooked breakfast and strictly no exercising! Christmas at the Deans' is a depressing prospect after all the presents Frankie bought were nicked from The Dog in the Pond. Tony's assault on Christmas continues, leaving Mandy full of despair.

videos.title: 17 December 2004
videos.overview: Lisa and James's relationship continues to flourish. Joe surveys the trashed flat following Stuart's drunken outburst the night before. Debbie voices her concerns over the Deans' financial worries, but Frankie insists things will improve. Has Tony gone a step too far?

videos.title: 20 December 2004
videos.overview: Tony's still in Mandy's bad books after ruining the joy of Christmas for Tom. Dan's delighted when he qualifies for the race on Friday and Debbie announces she's staying in Hollyoaks. Lisa's distraught after finding out about James's girlfriend and child. Meanwhile, Liz receives a letter from Justin apologising for everything he's done.

videos.title: 21 December 2004
videos.overview: Mandy's furious with Tony for failing to turn up at Tom's Nativity. Darlene can't face up to Justin being back at home and locks herself away in her room. Dan's worried about Debbie giving up on her dreams for a life looking after her mum.

videos.title: 22 December 2004
videos.overview: It's Christmas Eve and a sickly Tony is devoid of festive cheer. He wakes in the night and is unnerved to find his old friend Jambo lying in bed next to him. Jambo leaves Tony to discover his future by himself, and it is a future where everything he holds dear is just a distant memory.

videos.title: 23 December 2004
videos.overview: Liam notices something different about Tony, and it isn't just the satin robe. Dan's racing career hangs in the balance before his first race has even started. Can Debbie make it to the racetrack in time?

videos.title: 24 December 2004
videos.overview: Dan faces disqualification from the race and his fate lies in Jake's hands. Will Tony fulfil his promise to make it snow and convince Mandy that he has changed?

videos.title: 27 December 2004
videos.overview: A devastated Ben and Debbie are drawn to Dan's Pit Stop as it slowly dawns on them that they'll never see Dan again. Candy and Nicole discuss their New Year plans. Bombhead's arrival upsets Lee, who feels let down by his actions. Tony's attempt to make amends with Mandy doesn't appear to have the desired effect.

videos.title: 28 December 2004
videos.overview: Ben is worried when he finds Les drunk in Dan's Pit Stop. Frankie is ecstatic when she hears that Debbie's job on the Hook of Holland Ferry is still hers for the taking. Nicole and Candy discuss how they're going to raise the money to pay for their night out in Liverpool. Mandy is still distant from Tony and is relieved when Becca returns from her parents'.

videos.title: 29 December 2004
videos.overview: Upbeat Tony buzzes around Gnosh Village; things are finally looking up for him and Mandy. Still coming to terms with his mum's death, Bombhead realises it's time to be there for Lee in his hour of need. Candy and Nicole are still fretting about finding funds for their New Year's Eve tickets.

videos.title: 30 December 2004
videos.overview: United in grief, the Hunters congregate before attending the ceremony. Unsure of himself, Ben frets about speaking on behalf of his best mate. Meanwhile, Tony waxes lyrical about new beginnings.

videos.title: 31 December 2004
videos.overview: Tony decides that if he's unable to bring Mandy to New York, he'll bring New York to Mandy! Debbie says goodbye to Dan and Hollyoaks. Bombhead is keen to celebrate the New Year, but Lisa isn't as enthusiastic.

videos.title: A Helping Mand
videos.overview: Mandy starts to regret taking such a firm line with Tony.

videos.title: About Face
videos.overview: Darlene turns to Craig for help in facing the world again.

videos.title: Misera-Bella
videos.overview: Zak pursues his quest to discover his flatmate's supposed secret.

videos.title: Ball Play
videos.overview: Justin attempts to mask his absence from school from his mates.

videos.title: Table Talk
videos.overview: Darlene steels herself for bad news from the consultant.

videos.title: Jake's Progress
videos.overview: A lonely Lisa finds solace in unlikely company.

videos.title: Bearing Arms
videos.overview: Steph discovers yet another object for her affection.

videos.title: Aye, Candy
videos.overview: Nicole's attempts to celebrate her birthday lead to unhappy returns.

videos.title: In the Neck
videos.overview: Darlene feels guilty for denying Sophie and Mel their holiday and, under pressure from Mel, lets Sophie try to hide her scar with make-up. Candy decides to cheer Paula up by giving her a makeover. Steph has an induction at Body Boost, but is more interested in Stuart's body than her own. Jack is horrified when he sees the aftermath of O.B.'s night in charge of The Dog in the Pond.

videos.title: Reverse Call
videos.overview: Lisa is besotted with thoughts of Jake, whilst Becca tries to treat her man to a few home comforts. The Taylor-Burtons rally round for Darlene's big day. Zara's magazine article about Body Boost hits the headlines. Nicole becomes jealous of Candy and Paula's friendship.

videos.title: Value Added Max
videos.overview: Jake's guilt persists when he receives a sexy text from Lisa, However, he can't resist the urge to see her and rushes round for a rendezvous - they are both in deeper than they thought. Max and O.B. bicker over the remnants of Christmas Inc, Max finds that romance might lie right on his own doorstep. Cameron causes ructions in Halls, and Zak wonders if Cameron's a lost cause. Mel and Stuart give Zara an ear bashing, but will Zara's crusade run out of steam?

videos.title: Reverse Thrust
videos.overview: Jake tries desperately to hide his secret from Becca. Cameron and Zak are at loggerheads over the food situation. At the end of his tether, Zak decides he can't live with Bella and Cameron any more. Meanwhile, Steph has Stuart in her sights and moves in for the kill. Elsewhere, Justin is depressed at not making the football team.

videos.title: The Odd Couple
videos.overview: Steph wakes up to a shocking discovery. Zara is fired, while Lisa wakes at the Davies' feeling lost and alone. Jake turns up at HCC, but a strong Lisa spurns his advances - it's over between them for good. Cameron wonders if Zak will ever come back, However, Zak is adamant that he's moving on and moving out. O.B. is unnerved by Max's unusually happy mood, as Sophie agrees to go out on a date with O.B. Richard does his best to make Justin feel better about himself.

videos.title: Board, Stupid
videos.overview: Jake agonises over his feelings for Lisa, whilst Lisa's sad after ending her affair with Jake. Her sadness is noticed by Ellie, but Lisa lies that she just misses Dan. Zara demonstrates outside Body Boost. Cameron mopes after Zak's sudden departure. Justin struggles to understand Paradise Lost, and gets a gaze from Becca.

videos.title: Duvet Day
videos.overview: Jake's anxious about Becca going away to care for her ill grandmother, worried that he'll give in to temptation and go to Lisa. Justin's determined to please Becca and has been up all night finishing his essay. Sophie and O.B. and Max and Mel go out on a date. Cameron's on a high after his kiss with Bella, but he's soon brought back down to earth and left dreaming of his lost love. Richard is furious with Stuart about Zara's little act outside Body Boost.

videos.title: Caught Short
videos.overview: The students conduct an in-depth enquiry into Bella's disappearance. Max wonders if he'll ever get a girlfriend. Still worried about Darlene after speaking to her on the phone, Ali decides to bunk off school. Zara confronts Lisa over her secret affair with Jake.

videos.title: Nothing to Blouse About
videos.overview: Justin is determined to get on Ali's good side before Darlene gets home. Russ and Joe drive Dannii to distraction with their sexist remarks. Jake is sure Zara will blab and does his best to talk her round. Sophie quizzes Mel about her ideal date.

videos.title: Joe Schmoe
videos.overview: Lisa is desperate to carry on her affair with Jake but worries about keeping Zara quiet. Russ and Joe continue to tease Dannii about the differences between men and women. Sophie starts to get cold feet, whilst Justin is jealous of Ali's friendship with Nathan.

videos.title: Soph Far, So Good
videos.overview: Joe is attacked by a gang of girls, which he attempts to keep secret from his friends. However, Dannii and Russ learn the truth, but Joe refuses to report them to the police. Lisa and Jake continue their illicit affair, but Lisa worries that Jake loves Becca more. Sophie anxiously waits for her date with Max. Nathan knocks on the Taylor-Burtons door wanting a kick about with Ali, but a jealous Justin tells Nathan that Ali isn't in.

videos.title: Putting the Boot In
videos.overview: Joe is still embarrassed about his attack. Max and Sophie are all loved up and can't stop texting each other. Jake throws a sickie and Lisa makes the most of pretending they're a 'real couple'. Ali and Justin can't believe their eyes when they find out Nathan's secret.

videos.title: Dean Counter
videos.overview: Ali is determined to find out what Nathan is hiding. O.B. is struggling to come up with ideas for Valentines Inc. and ropes Mel into lending a hand. Lisa is frustrated that Jake is going away to be with Becca and insists that she has to tell him how she feels before he leaves. Frankie is stunned when Johnno says he wants to meet her. Sam and Russ take a nervous Joe to The Dog in the Pond, watched by Dannii.

videos.title: Fast Feud
videos.overview: Craig supports his mum when she can't face seeing her divorce solicitor alone. Mel sets O.B. up on a blind date. Candy announces she's heading for a career in the fast lane... of a drive-through burger bar! Ali warns Justin to stay on the right side of Nathan.

videos.title: Punch the Crock
videos.overview: Craig can't hide his anger with his dad for walking out on the family. Paula acts as go-between for Candy and Nicole but isn't completely accurate when delivering messages between her two friends. Justin gets hassle from Sally about his grades but the only extra effort he's putting on is on football pitch. O.B. thinks Mel looks a million dollars, but will she manage to win Ben over on their first date?

videos.title: Cupboard Love
videos.overview: Sophie revels In her new-found love. A furious Mel storms off; O.B. tries to apologise but the damage is done. Becca tells Jake that she is more confident than ever that she belongs Hollyoaks with him. Justin is worried about Paula's interest in Ali.

videos.title: Third Party
videos.overview: Mandy returns to find Gnosh Village still closed. Jake visits Lisa in an attempt to soften her mood, but she is distraught at the thought of him spending the night with Becca. O.B. is pleased with Mel's interest in Valentines Inc., but that's not all she's interested in! Nathan wonders if Justin really has turned over a new leaf.

videos.title: Absolute-Lee
videos.overview:
A wayward streak leads Lee back into the arms of the past.

Tony was in Rome. Darren returned from Magaluf with a girl, Louise. Lee was bored of student life, So him and Bombhead entered a radio competition. Ben challenged Russ to a 10K run for Comic Relief. Abby returned to the village and bumped into Lee. Louise caused a stir throughout the village. Tony met a girl in Rome. Darren got a mystery call. Lee and Bombhead spent the day running round Liverpool. Mandy kept phoning Tony.

videos.title: Floss Leader
videos.overview: Mandy arrives in Rome in search of Tony, but will he want her back? Bombhead and Lee's quest leads to romance for Bombhead when he meets Cherry. Ben and Darren suffer from hangovers the morning after the night before.

videos.title: Engaged Tone
videos.overview: A lovelorn Mandy visits a church in Rome in the hope of finding divine intervention over her true feelings for Tony. A distracted Bombhead and Lee continue their competition quest. Russ is amazed when he hears about Ben and Louise's secret tryst the previous evening.

videos.title: Bouquet of Barbed Wire
videos.overview: Ben is sticking to his promise of helping Darren out of trouble. Bombhead couldn't be happier as he wakes on the beach to find Cherry next to him. Ben, Russ and Darren meet the loan sharks. All ready to hand the money over, the boys are shocked to discover who they're giving it to.

videos.title: Petal Power
videos.overview: Thinking Mandy has left Rome, Tony feels isolated and lonely. Meanwhile, Bombhead discovers Cherry has left him a note explaining why she had to run out. Also, can Russ persuade Ben to put the past behind him and help Darren?

videos.title: Fireman Sam
videos.overview: The new Mr. and Mrs. Hutchinson arrive back in Hollyoaks. Mel is getting cold feet about Valentine's Inc., she's not sure that she's qualified to play Venus. Jake is annoyed when he gets a Valentine's card from Lisa - what if Becca had found out.

videos.title: Lucky Gym
videos.overview: Mandy's furious when she finds out that Tony's not sure whether they're actually married or not. Ben is determined to make Darren pay as he begins a rigorous training scheme. Candy and Nicole quiz Paula about a Valentine's card she received but she refuses to name the sender. Lee and Bombhead investigate what women want from a man.

videos.title: Hug of War
videos.overview: Justin is at odds with Richard after he stopped him taking the job at the football ground. Jake is worried when Becca and Lisa arrange to go on girly night out. Mandy didn't return home the previous night, leaving Tony worried for their relationship. Lee persuades Bombhead to join him in his efforts to get fit, and will Ali turn up for his "date" with Paula?

videos.title: Liquid News
videos.overview: Can Mandy and Tony sort out their problems now their marriage is definitely legal? Max suggests that he and Sophie go on a double date with O.B. and Mel. Lee and Bombhead have got their work cut out getting into shape. An irate Paula wants answers about Ali's non-appearance at the date.

videos.title: The Honeymooners
videos.overview: Mandy and Tony are both feeling nervous about the celebrations ahead. Becca is oblivious of the crush that Justin has on her. Lee and Bombhead are suffering from their previous physical exertions. Max and O.B. wonder how they can get round the problem that they can't tell the twins apart.

videos.title: Gotta Lotta Bottle
videos.overview: Justin's attentions are making Becca uncomfortable. Lee is shocked when Les receives a job offer in Norwich - do Sally and Les still have a future together? Zara and Lisa overindulge and have a raucous time, much to the chagrin of Cameron and Steph.

videos.title: Dannii, Boy?
videos.overview: Justin's attentions are making Becca uncomfortable. Lee is shocked when Les receives a job offer in Norwich - do Sally and Les still have a future together? Zara and Lisa overindulge and have a raucous time, much to the chagrin of Cameron and Steph.

videos.title: Russ About Nothing
videos.overview: Russ tries to evade Dannii's questions about the lump on his testicle. Bombhead is delighted when Lee suggests that they should get a bachelor pad together. Toilet paper is in short supply in HCC halls as the mystery illness continues to grip the students. Max and O.B. have dates with the twins, but hatch an elaborate plan so they can watch the football, unaware that the girls have a plan of their own.

videos.title: Blueberry Ill
videos.overview: Sam says Russ needs to see a doctor but will Russ listen to his brother's advice? Zara soon realises there are more things to worry about when Lisa tells her some bad news; she's got Chlamydia. Lee is delighted to see Les come out of Sally's bedroom: it looks like their relationship is well and truly back on course!

videos.title: Brother In Qualms
videos.overview: Russ finally plucks up the courage to go to the clinic, but is uncomfortable when he's the only unaccompanied one there. Sally is in turmoil: should she move to Norwich with Les or stay at home with the kids? Lee is downbeat and Lisa has her own problems, but they both give their mum their blessing to move away. Ali is still winding Justin up about having a crush on Becca, but he vehemently denies it.

videos.title: Infection Detection
videos.overview: D-Day has arrived for Lisa, and it's time to tell Jake about her STI. Russ's frustrations continue to grow as the uncertainty over his future looms. Justin wakes with trepidation, as today's the day Darlene arrives home. The welcome home party is in full swing when Justin makes an appearance, but from Darlene's reaction, will he ever be forgiven.

videos.title: C For Yourself
videos.overview: Sam and Russ brace themselves for bad news.

videos.overview: Recriminations abound between Jake, Becca and Ben.

videos.overview: The students pool resources to face down their landlord.

videos.overview: Russell prepares for his operation.

videos.overview: Max and OB scent a chance to help Comic Relief

videos.title: Out, Patient!
videos.overview: Nicole tries to persuade Russell to face the world again.

videos.title: A Woman Scorned
videos.overview: Harsh words fly between Jake's two other halves.

videos.title: Knowles-It-All
videos.overview: Hollyoaks Village is graced with the presence of celebrity.

videos.title: Uncle Sam
videos.overview: Russ's patience with his brother finally snaps.

videos.title: Little Italy
videos.overview: Tony injects some continental consciousness into Gnosh.

videos.title: True Faith
videos.overview: Jake finally comes clean about Lisa.
