videos.overview: The return of the Mr Owen stuns Russell's brother.

videos.title: Down, Patrick
videos.overview: Lee's endeavours to stage an Irish spectacular run aground.

videos.title: Tone of Despair
videos.overview: Senor Hutchinson's latest TV endeavour goes awry.

videos.title: March 21, 2005
videos.overview: The house is proving too small for all of the Taylor-Burtons and it's starting to get to the kids. Lisa needs someone to talk to, but Lee is out of his depth when it comes to her and Jake. Tony is furious when he finds out that his TV commercial has been sabotaged.

videos.title: March 22, 2005
videos.overview: Lee and Lisa are upset with Ellie for taking the money off their mum. The bathroom rota at the Taylor-Burtons' is causing more arguments than ever. Tony is in full organisation mode to get the Easter Fair plans underway. O.B. finally comes up with an idea; an Easter egg hunt with a difference.

videos.title: March 24, 2005
videos.overview: Can Lisa and Lee find their parents? The madness continues at the Taylor-Burtons' as Ali and Justin set up camp in the bathroom; the girls are not amused. Russell asks Dannii to help make Ellie feel better about herself. O.B. assures Max the egg is safely hidden where no-one will find it, but they're forgetting about Tom!

videos.title: March 25, 2005
videos.overview: It's the day of the Easter egg hunt and Max and O.B. are in for a shock; the golden egg's gone missing! Ali and Justin reach a compromise with Darlene over the bathroom debacle after she turns the water off until she can use the toilet. The hunt for Les and Sally is still on with only a few addresses left before the trail grows cold.

videos.title: March 28, 2005
videos.overview: Mandy and Tony are shocked to discover the devastation in the village. A suffering Justin and Ali are puzzled when they wake up in the same bed. The Hunters arrive home from Norwich and life settles back down to a normal, even keel. Out of a box with Chinese writing comes a packet of sparklers and, with the help of some matches, Tom looks set for an afternoon of fun...

videos.title: March 29, 2005
videos.overview: Ben and Tom teeter on the windowsill; can they escape as the flames continue to consume the house? Lee and Lisa continue to worry about telling Les and Sally the truth over Ellie's disappearance. Darlene, Justin and Ali continue to feel hard done by after being grounded for their loutish behaviour.

videos.title: March 30, 2005
videos.overview: Ben and Tom recover in hospital following the fire. Tony puts Ali, Darlene and Justin to work. The Hunters disagree over Ellie.

videos.title: March 31, 2005
videos.overview: Les is seething after finding out about Lisa's affair with Jake. To add to their troubles, the impending visit by the social worker is worrying Max; he might still lose Tom. When Ben sees the depth of Max's gratitude, he realises the true worth of his sacrifice. Darlene, Justin and Ali are Tony's slaves for a day as punishment for their rampage through the village.

videos.title: April 1, 2005
videos.overview: Tom overhears Max wonder about what to do with him and, believing that he is no longer wanted, packs his things into a Pepe Poodle bag and runs away from home. Jake tries to put things right with Becca, but she rejects him. Les makes things right with Lisa. Darlene feels guilty when Justin and Ali play an April Fools joke on Tony.

videos.title: Doubting Thomas
videos.overview: Max and Mandy panic when Tom goes missing.

videos.title: Out On A Limb
videos.overview: Ben rues the way his injury prevents him helping search for Tom.

videos.title: Frankie, My Dear
videos.overview: A storm is raised when Steph and Craig take their mum out.

videos.title: The Hole Truth
videos.overview: Max and OB widen their search for Tom.

videos.title: Where There's a Will
videos.overview: The return of Ben's dad is much welcomed.

videos.title: Last Will and Testament
videos.overview: Steph is smitten by the prospect of her mum and Will getting together.

videos.title: The Blame Game
videos.overview: Max accuses OB of saying he was responsible for the fire.

videos.title: Feud And Drink
videos.overview: Max and Mandy squabble over their respective duties.

videos.title: Flaw Show
videos.overview: Becca does her best to make Jake feel uncomfortable.

videos.title: Jez, You It!
videos.overview: Lee and Bombhead come face to face with a new student.

videos.title: April 18, 2005
videos.overview: Tom is beginning to take advantage of Tony and Mandy's goodwill. When Steph breaks the tap in the bathroom, Jake is called on to bail his siblings out of trouble once again. It's the day before Russ's birthday and he's looking forward to seeing his dad. The students are intrigued by their new flatmate, Jez.

videos.title: April 19, 2005
videos.overview: Frankie goes on a date with the plumber. The Owens celebrate Russ's 21st birthday, but Sam is livid that Russ has invited their dad to the meal. Zara is convinced Jez is royalty and decides to exploit him. O.B. is wary of Max's initial reaction to him turning up, but he's missed Tom and wants to see him.

videos.title: April 20, 2005
videos.overview: The atmosphere's strained between Russ and Sam following their argument the night before. Zara is on a mission to blow Jez's royal presence at HCC and writes her article to accompany the picture of him snogging Steph. Tom is still refusing to go to school, what can Mandy and Max do with him? Frankie is feeling down after her disastrous date and having bill after bill she can't pay.

videos.title: April 21, 2005
videos.overview: Max and O.B. are fighting a losing battle to get Tom back to school. Jack hotfoots it round to apologise to Frankie. The halls are a hive of activity with the students looking forward to meeting the Queen - everyone except Zara, that is.

videos.title: April 22, 2005
videos.overview: Both Mandy and Max are finding their moving day stressful, especially since Max is saddled with the added stress of looking after Tom, who's still refusing to go to school. Max discovers Tom's little secret, which leads directly into Tony and Mandy's world. Nicole remains convinced that her mum and dad still love each other. Frankie puts an end to finding a new lover.

videos.title: April 25, 2005
videos.overview: Ben is worried he hasn't had a chance to tell Jake they're selling the house and despairs at the mess the Deans have made. Russ gets the all clear from the hospital. Zara is horrified when her article on Jez is published after she told the printers to cancel it. Tom refuses to go to school and locks himself in his room; he refuses to come out until he gets a dog. Mr. Osborne admits that hiring Frankie has certainly been a great help.

videos.title: April 26, 2005 - #1500
videos.overview: Jack isn't best pleased to have his house invaded by the Deans' - they're eating him out of house and home. Max is pleased with himself for finally getting Tom off to school without a fuss, helped by a little bit of bribery. Nicole is delighted when her dad turns up and is eager to hear how his meal with Carrie went the previous night. Elsewhere, the students plan their outfits for the Polo party on Friday, but Zara is refusing to go.

videos.title: April 27, 2005
videos.overview: Nicole confides in Ali how much she wants her mum and dad to get back together again. Tony remains convinced a poltergeist is haunting their new flat, how else can they explain the strange goings on? The students begin their preparations for Jez's forthcoming Polo Party when Lee offers to give them all makeovers. Craig turns to Darren for help over the Deans' homeless situation, and to his surprise, finds a willing listener.

videos.title: April 28, 2005
videos.overview: Justin is finding life boring and confides in Ali that he needs some excitement. Nicole remains convinced her mum and dad will get back together, but Russ, however, has reservations. Lee and Cameron's imaginations get the better of them when they fantasise over the posh girls they could meet at tomorrow's Polo Party. Darren and Frankie have a heart to heart and seem to be getting along splendidly, much to Steph's disgust. Mandy is being driven insane by Tony, who is still convinced that he's losing his mind.

videos.title: April 29, 2005
videos.overview: The day has arrived for the Polo Party and excitement is running high. Frankie is mortified having to face Darren after he made a pass at her. Sam continues to cause unease at the Owens' over his decision to block his dad out. Mandy and Tony both feel under the weather with a dramatic Tony fearing the worst over his mystery ailment.

videos.title: May 2, 2005
videos.overview: Mandy is shell-shocked to discover that she's pregnant. Ben is bored - it's Bank Holiday and he's got no plans. Will Sam join his brother and dad on their day out? Justin finds himself bullied into following Macki and his gang as they cause chaos at the May Day event.

videos.title: May 3, 2005
videos.overview: Sam and Russ prepare for their rock-climbing trip with Mr. Owen. Louise on her first day at work demands to know why Lisa is trespassing on college property and Darren is shocked to see Louise. Ali can't understand why Justin is still friends with Macki. Tony walks on eggshells around Mandy, not wanting to upset her.

videos.title: May 4, 2005
videos.overview: Nicole regales Justin with tales of her dad's heroic rescue of Sam. Dannii is sick of living in a dump, but Zara and Joe are more concerned about playing Jez's computer game. Tony is surprised to discover Mandy has wasted no time in booking her abortion as they both continue to hide their true feelings towards parenthood. The atmosphere is uncomfortable between Lisa and Ben after their near-kiss.

videos.title: May 5, 2005
videos.overview: Mandy and Tony continue to hide their true feelings over their unborn baby. Ben goes for a drink with Louise. She's just the distraction he needs to take his mind off Lisa. Macki intimidates Ali and Nicole. Cameron is wary of Bombhead's plans to help Russ; he's not sure it's a good idea to make Russ's life public!

videos.title: May 6, 2005
videos.overview: Darlene is furious when she sees Macki racially taunting Ali. Ben is put in an awkward position when Lisa arrives at his flat, with Louise still there from the night before. Sam and Russ resolve to try to put their troubles behind them. Mandy and Tony head off to the hospital, having decided not to have the baby... or any baby for that matter.

videos.title: May 9, 2005
videos.overview: Mandy and Tony are blissfully happy, although a little apprehensive having decided to keep the baby. Lisa quizzes Ben about Louise and is satisfied that nothing's going on between them, but she can't help ranting on about her. Darlene can't forgive Justin for standing by and watching Ali get abused by Macki. Darren feels a little awkward as he returns to The Dog in the Pond - it's the first time he's been back since he made a pass at Frankie.

videos.overview: The students continue their election campaign.

videos.overview: It all gets too much for Lisa.

videos.overview: Becca edges towards reconciliation with her ex.

videos.overview: Another round of sparring kicks off in the Village.

videos.overview: Jeremy beats some revision tips into Zara.

videos.overview: Sam's mum and dad struggle to keep their reunion a secret.

videos.overview: Lisa moves on to yet another new man.

videos.overview: Rehearsals for Steph's monologue take a dramatic turn.

videos.overview: Lisa and Ben are at loggerheads.

videos.overview: Steph isn't sure whether she's seeing double.

videos.overview: Frankie helps her daughter piece together the night before.

videos.title: In the Neck
videos.overview: Louise embarks on one last desperate gamble.

videos.overview: Ben has a ticket to ride.

videos.overview: Ben and Lisa take a turn in the freezing June surf.

videos.title: A Lou-sing Streak
videos.overview: It's panic stations when Louise suspects Ben's designs on Lisa.

videos.overview: Justin pays lip service to Becca.

videos.title: Tall Stories
videos.overview: Bombhead continues his quest to find his dad.

videos.title: The Odd Couple
videos.overview: Good feeling is not running on tap at The Dog.

videos.title: Chrome Alone
videos.overview: Craig single-handedly scoops a new set of wheels.

videos.title: Two's Company
videos.overview: There's a surfeit of coupling at the Hunters residence.

videos.overview: Craig falls foul of Old Man Osborne.

videos.title: Bottom of the Class
videos.overview: Becca frets about Justin's obsessive behaviour.

videos.title: The Bare Facts
videos.overview: Full disclosure lies in store for Tony.

videos.title: June 20, 2005
videos.overview: Tony is enlightened by the advice in the pregnancy book, but is taking it all a little too far. Lisa is in trouble with her parents when they find out about her behaviour at college - what was she thinking, attacking a member of staff? Russ is on a mission to get fit. Justin is determined to enter the adult world and there's nothing anyone can do to stop him.

videos.title: June 21, 2005
videos.overview: Mandy and Tony have their very own virtual baby. Joe and Jez have to find themselves somewhere to stay next year after they lose their place in halls. It's Lee's big day for his prize giving at college, but Lisa's problems are overshadowing him. Darren wonders how he got himself involved in the charity bike race, but is horrified when he realises just how far it is.

videos.title: June 22, 2005
videos.overview: Mandy and Tony have had a frantic night looking after their virtual baby, it's not as easy as they originally thought. Lisa and Ben try to make the most of their time together, but it's not exactly the time alone that Lisa was hoping for when Louise turns up. As Craig's cunning plan looks set to make the Osbornes the winners, has Jack destroyed any chance they might have had? After promising Liz, Becca has a word with Justin about his decision to leave school, but she's secretly relieved, if he does leave, she's off the hook.

videos.title: June 23, 2005
videos.overview: The Osbornes and the Owens continue on their journey as the charity bike race is in full swing. Mandy and Tony have settled into the virtual baby routine and everything is going well. Bombhead continues searching for his dad, but he's despondent as everything he tries leads to a dead end. Becca is angry when she finds out that Lisa stayed over at the flat with Ben and bans her from ever coming back.

videos.title: June 24, 2005
videos.overview: Lisa continues to feel betrayed by Ben's secret meeting with Louise. Becca realises the situation with Justin isn't going away, especially now he's informed her he wants to leave school so they can be together. Competition continues to grow between the Owens' and Osbornes' as the bike race moves into the second and final day. A stunned Jake is left reeling when Johnno makes a shock appearance back in Hollyoaks.

videos.overview: The reappearance of Mr Dean prompts dilemmas in The Dog.

videos.title: Salon Song
videos.overview: Lee gets infected by an irresistable idea.

videos.overview: Clan warfare breaks over the beer mats.

videos.title: Decline and Fall
videos.overview: Mandy reacquaints herself with the floor.

videos.title: Metal Mickey
videos.overview: Jake jovially jousts with Becca's emotions.

videos.title: July 4, 2005
videos.overview: Mrs. Taylor is on the warpath over her trauma at the Foxx Hunter Health Haven. An anxious Sam and Zara line up to get the results of their first year law exams. Resting is fast turning into a drag for Mandy. Ali is over the moon when Nicole says "yes"... little does he realise she doesn't think it's a proper date.

videos.title: July 5, 2005
videos.overview: Lee is devastated at the demise of the Foxx Hunter Health Haven. Mr. Owen comforts Sam about not getting his placement at the law firm. O.B. embarks on a new business venture at Drive 'n' Buy - a summer extravaganza with turf, brollies and barbies. Sophie and Darlene are job searching in Chester.

videos.title: July 6, 2005
videos.overview: Sam has set off to meet Jules in the park. It's only when Max explains Tony's to blame for her overspending - having her living like a prisoner - that Mandy's guilt relents. Ali is trying on his dad's tux when Justin walks in. Becca cleans the flat frantically, nervous about the arrival of Nancy.

videos.title: July 7, 2005
videos.overview: The school prom has arrived, and not before time for Ali, Nicole and Justin. It's Dannii, Russ and Joe's turn to pick up the results for their first year. Lee and Stacey are elated after a heavy night of rain has proved that their gazebo is waterproof. Mandy tells Max she can't face showing Tony the gold card statement.

videos.title: July 8, 2005
videos.overview: Becca wants to know where Nancy got the booze at the prom. It's no surprise to Mrs. Taylor that Mel hasn't got a present for her birthday. Joe and Dannii are still gutted about the cancelled college ball. Nicole notices a sign in Washed Up's window: 'Part-time Assistant Required'.

videos.title: July 11, 2005
videos.overview: Jake is still shell-shocked by Justin's claim that he slept with Becca. Is Mandy's love of shopping getting out of control? Lee tries to persuade his parents that beauty therapy is an honest profession. Max evicts his best friend O.B. from Drive 'n' Buy. The students prepare for the raft race.

videos.title: July 12, 2005
videos.overview: Rivalry is building between Russ and Sam, and Dannii and Joe ahead of the raft race. Frankie is desperate to know why Jake is still sleeping in the van. Lee finds it hard to focus on his work after a sequinned bra falls out of Stacey's bag. Sophie is mad with Mel for turning up to the raft race hung over.

videos.title: July 13, 2005
videos.overview: Bombhead is delighted that Stacey is out of the picture after yesterday's fiasco, but he's still feeling down with no news about his dad. Tony's constant smothering is making Mandy claustrophobic, so she shares her frustrations with Max. Craig has an idea when Jake talks passionately about his garden designs. Nicole is horrified when Frankie tells her she's leaving her on her own at Washed Up all day!

videos.title: July 14, 2005
videos.overview: Tony and Mandy are furious to discover the travellers have arrived en masse overnight and set up camp in the yard. Nancy plans to give Becca the best birthday ever, in the hope she'll let her stay on in Hollyoaks. The SU Bar is a hive of activity with Darren on a mission to make the Summer Ball a success.

videos.title: July 15, 2005
videos.overview: Mel wakes up hung over in a police cell and can't remember what happened last night. Nancy prepares a birthday breakfast for Becca - surely she'll let her stay after such star treatment. After guarding Il Gnosh from those pesky travellers, Tony awakes stiff-necked and tired, only to be confronted by a shark!

videos.title: July 18, 2005
videos.overview: Tony manages to control Mandy's spending, but has less luck with Sheba the dog. Joe is incensed to learn his mum is back with his drunken, violent dad; there's no way he's going home for the summer now. videos.title: Sean You Want To Do This?
Buxom Bad Boys Come to Blows
Would You Like a Bag With That?
Little Grey Riding Hood
videos.overview: Joe takes the new students around town, attempting to get them drunk so he can convince them to let Olivia, Jessica, and him stay at the flat. Sophie and Mel try to deal with the fact that Evissa has sprung a leak. Nicole dreads going back to school, and someone in a grey sweatshirt is stalking Russ, Sophie, Mel, and Nicole.

videos.title: Student Balls
videos.overview: Joe continues to try to convince the new students to let him stay in the flat, while Kris continues to clash with Jessica. Sophie and Mel spend some time together. Clare starts selling some iffy vodka at the Loft, and Justin and Sonny have a tension-filled run-in with Jake and Craig at the Union.

videos.title: And Bully's Special Prize
videos.overview: John Paul and Craig’s 1st meeting in the 6th form Common Room. John Paul observes Sonny bullying Craig, and later sets off the fire alarm when he sees Sonny and Justin follow Craig again as he didn’t think it was a fair fight.

videos.title: Clare's Black Belt
videos.overview: John Paul studies alone in a classroom when Craig enters. After initial justification of their own behaviour, the pair start to bond over their need to get the grades to escape from their families and Hollyoaks and go off to lunch together.

videos.title: Top and Tail
videos.overview: Clare is left running scared after discovering the evidence that O.B., Mel and Sophie have against her. Craig, Steph and Darren are left running The Dog in the Pond after Jake, who was left in charge, ends up getting drunk. Olivia finally gains the courage to stand up to Jess, but all are left shocked when Sam bursts into the pub, armed with a petrol canister and lighter!

videos.title: Episode 181
videos.overview: The customers in The Dog in the Pond are horrified when Sam bursts in holding a lighter, having doused the pub in petrol. As they struggle to find a way out, Calvin attempts to save Sophie from Sam's clutches by smashing a glass on his head, causing him to drop the lighter and the pub to explode. Sam is killed after being crushed by rubble, having been left to die by Russ. Joe goes to save a trapped Olivia, but they are killed when the alcohol from behind the bar falls and causes a second explosion, and Zoe learns of Joe's death by calling his cellphone - tracing it to one of the body bags. Sophie dies in Russ's arms, and just as Justin learns of Mel's death, he finds Sophie's body. Also, Calvin temporarily puts his problems with the Deans behind him as he saves Jake from the fire.

videos.title: O.B. Comfy
videos.overview: The aftermath of the fire at The Dog affects everyone in Hollyoaks. Justin mourns the loss of his sisters, Russ feels guilt over his actions regarding Sophie, Zoe regrets not telling Joe she had feelings for him, and Kris doubts the sincerity of Jessica's grief over Olivia. Meanwhile, O.B. remains unconscious, and Clare searches for the proof he had that she cheated on her husband. Jack, Frankie, and the Dean siblings have been displaced from their home, while they are grateful to Calvin for saving Jake's life.

videos.title: Bedside Manner
videos.overview: O.B. wakes up and is devastated to learn that Mel has died. Clare, meanwhile, tries to make sure that O.B. is unable to tell Max about her fling with Warren. Justin visits Louise to pack up his sisters' things to take with him on his trip to visit his mother. Sarah knows Amy is hiding something from her, but is ultimately distracted by discussions with Nancy about Rhys and Gilly.

videos.title: Face Off
videos.overview: Zak is assigned to Olivia's old room, and Jessica feels attacked by Kris, Zoe, Will, and Zak for their continued belief that she was not a good friend to Olivia. O.B. checks himself out of the hospital and stays with Tony while he still plans to expose Clare, not knowing that she has thrown out the evidence of her affair. Sarah still denies feelings for Gilly, but Nancy begins to believe otherwise.

videos.title: Head of the Table
videos.overview: Russ moves into the McQueens – at least till Jacqui is home from prison. John Paul comes in and eyes the snowboard and skis, immediately bonding with another bloke in the house. Myra and the girls prepare a meal for Russ. Jacqui arrives home unexpectedly and thinks Russ is a burglar.

videos.title: Art Ache
videos.overview: The McQueens prepare for Jacqui’s welcome home tea. Mercy is anxious over a deal she made with Jacq over the 300 quid shoes she nicked – if she can’t find them then Jacq gets to sleep with her boyfriend.. John Paul has nicked Michaela’s phone and is roped in to getting replacement shoes or Mercy will hell mum about the phone. Finishes with the presents and welcome home tea.

videos.title: Why Won't You Give Me Your Love?
Hello Conscience

John Paul later meets Craig who supports John Paul entering the competition. Sonny cheats by using a CD. In the toilets John Paul asks Sonny to leave Craig alone as it’s his brother who is guilty.. John Paul wins the competition and is made resident DJ.

videos.title: Home Sweet Home
videos.overview: John Paul goes to see Claire to sort out his first gig at the Loft. As he goes to school he sees Sonny bullying Craig in the village; he asks Craig if he’s still up for the football tryouts with him. The pair go to get changed and Craig finds his mum put in odd socks including one pink sock triggering more bullying from Sonny. John Paul is annoyed at the tryouts that Michaela is interested in Sonny. Michaela is annoyed he is so perfect, and John Paul says he’d swap shoes any day.

videos.title: Bills, Bills, Bills...

Craig decides he can’t handle Sonny and will leave school. When he has met John Paul, his mate questions why he’d return to school to just give up. The pair see Jake and Carmel outside the salon who give Craig ideas for jobs. By the end of the conversation he is ready to return to school!

videos.title: Queasy
videos.overview: Carmel asks Jake out for a date. Sarah asks Amy to move in with her and Mike. Becca and Justin try to make up after their fight about Justin's using her credit card for the engagement ring.

videos.title: Piggy in the Middle
videos.overview: Sonny jostles John Paul so he drops his records on the way in to the Loft. Sonny shows his annoyance that John Paul won, but John Paul stands his ground. Sonny takes over trying to act cool and knowledgable during the sound check – it seems Warren has offered him a second chance and he is told to return after JP has warmed up.  John Paul goes down a storm on his first gig much to Sonny’s annoyance, and Claire won’t remove JP from the decks.

Hannah invites her friends round to her house and is a bit full on with John Paul. Craig is desperate to ask Sarah out.

John Paul leaves Craig and Sarah as they are clearly getting on. After he goes they do get off together but are interrupted when Sarah receives an emergency phone call that Amy has been in a car crash.
