videos.overview: The new HCC students bond and get to know each other over drinks. As Jacqui's relationship with Rhys reaches crisis point over Gilly, and she moves back in with the McQueens. Meanwhile the Osbornes face trouble when Tom is bullied at school for his association with a supposed rapist. And Carmel wonders whether she will be able to resist Father Francis on the trip to Africa.

videos.title: September 29, 2011
videos.overview: A spot of soul-searching prompts Carmel to finally gives in to her desires, and Cindy pledges a large sum to Father Francis's cause, but Tony grows suspicious of the priest's intentions. Meanwhile, Gilly finds a new home with Cheryl, and Jacqui is devastated when Rhys tells her he needs some space.

videos.title: September 30, 2011
videos.overview: Father Francis attempts to go straight and ends up finding himself compromised between Carmel and Cindy. Neil and Jono are surprised to find out that the flasher student is Callum's big sister.

videos.title: October 3, 2011
videos.overview: Father Francis is honest with Carmel about his indiscretions with Cindy. Warren is worried that Seth could be about to ruin his chance to take part in a spot of blackmail. Carl will not allow a frustrated Jason take hormone blockers.

videos.title: October 4, 2011
videos.overview: Carmel ends up deciding to follow her heart and leave the village with Father Francis. Cindy attempts to ruin their plans though. Jason takes a picture of Mitzeee and Riley together in a compromising position. Ash is surprised after she finally tells...

videos.title: October 5, 2011
videos.overview: Jason has a brush with the law and ends up reacting by sending an incriminating picture of Mitzeee to Warren. Carmel is upset when Cindy ruins her chance of happiness with Father Francis. Will is concerned that Dodger is about to invade his new life.

videos.title: October 6, 2011
videos.overview: Mitzeee manages to protect Riley by convincing Warren that nothing happened between them. Jason is pleased when Carl agrees to let him use the hormone blockers. Dodger's antics frustrate Will.

videos.title: October 7, 2011
videos.overview: Mitzeee ends up having a crisis of conscience about attempting to destroy the Costellos. Jason ends up taking matters into his own hands after Carl goes back on his promise. Scott, Barney and Rob attempt to work out how to use a washing machine.

videos.title: October 10, 2011
videos.overview: Mitzeee is no longer welcome at the Costello wedding. She decides to try and get revenge by revealing what she knows about the affair between Carl and Mercedes in her book. Jason manages to get his hands on the hormone blockers.

videos.title: October 11, 2011
videos.overview: Warren is pleased after he learns that Mitzeee has included everything she knows about Carl and Mercedes' affair in her book. Rhys looks his job at Chez Chez for publicly saying that Gilly is a rapist. Duncan attempts to impress Kelly.

videos.title: October 12, 2011
videos.overview: Doug is told to say nothing about Mercedes and Carl's affair ahead of the wedding. He ends up asking Seth to tell his brother the truth. Jacqui and Rhys' rift widens after Gilly becomes the victim of a vicious hate campaign.

videos.title: October 13, 2011
videos.overview: Warren wantss £50,000 from Carl to keep quiet about what he knows about the affair. Seth is pressured by Doug to tell Riley the truth but he wants Warren to blackmail Carl to teach his father a lesson. Jacqui is shocked to find out that Rhys isn't being honest.

videos.title: October 14, 2011
videos.overview: The wedding is just a day away and Mercedes is surprised after Riley gives her their dream house. He bubble is soon burst though when she needs to get £20,000 to help pay Warren. Rhys and Jacqui discover a way to talk.

videos.title: October 17, 2011
videos.overview: The wedding day finally arrives and Riley remains unaware about Mercedes' big secret. Jacqui attempts to persuade her sister to be honest before getting married. Doug decides to ignore Warren's threats and goes to the ceremony.

videos.title: October 18, 2011
videos.overview: The events which happened at Mercedes and Riley's wedding leaves some of the guests feeling guilty. Warren makes plans to try gain ownership of Chez Chez.

videos.title: October 19, 2011
videos.overview: Amy makes up her mind about moving to New York with Lee, and has to break the news to Ste about her decision. Silas decides to teach someone a lesson. Warren puts more pressure on Brendan after he refuses to sell his share of Chez Chez.

videos.title: October 20, 2011
videos.overview: Ash ends up enjoying a 'quickie' with an unlikely person. Maddie takes Bart for a night out to in an effort to cheer him up. Amy attempts to find the courage to tell Ste she's taking the kids to New York, but Ste refuses to let them go.

videos.title: October 21, 2011
videos.overview: Silas warns Lynsey that he's planning something very dark for Halloween. Mercedes receives some shocking news. Ste ends up agreeing to allow Amy take the kids to New York, but after Lee sees how crushed Ste is, he wonders if he can really go through with it.

videos.title: October 24, 2011
videos.overview: Lynsey is set by Silas a terrifying challenge which sees her being forced to identify his next intended victim before midnight on Halloween. If she succeeds, he claims he will hand himself over to the police, but if she fails another girl will lose her life.

videos.title: October 25, 2011
videos.overview: Mercedes remains captive up in Silas's vault. Lynsey tells Doug about the deadly game she is being made to play. Theresa and Will finsd it hard to enjoy a romantic evening alone. Amy attempts to deal with the fact that Lee has given up on his dream.

videos.title: October 26, 2011
videos.overview: Lynsey is concerned that Theresa or Texas could be Silas's next target after she receives a cryptic clue. Rob and Annalise's reconciliation once again ruins Theresa and Will's efforts to spend time alone together.

videos.title: October 27, 2011
videos.overview: A desperate Lynsey attempts to work out who the next victim will be before it is too late. Will and Theresa finally enjoy an evening alone together.

videos.title: October 28, 2011
videos.overview: Chez Chez hosts Fright Night and most of the residents of Hollyoaks have gathered to celebrate in fancy dress. Nobody believes Lynsey's claims of what's is going to happen. Texas finds out about the bet between Scott and Dodger and gets even with them.

videos.title: October 31, 2011
videos.overview: Fright Night continues at Chez Chez with Dodger attemting to charm Texas into returning to the party. Bart watches from the sidelines as Gaz and Sinead have fun together and becomes even more jealous. Cheryl leaves early.

videos.title: November 1, 2011
videos.overview: Hollyoaks' residents are shocked to find out that the serial killer has struck again. Riley starts to question his grandfather's innocence. Cheryl finds some comfort with Gilly. Silas's deadly games continue.

videos.title: November 2, 2011
videos.overview: The village grieves following everything that has happened but the spate of tragedies is not over for the McQueen family. Maddie ends up finding herself in a compromising position after Gaz reveals he prefers her to Sinead.

videos.title: November 3, 2011
videos.overview: The McQueen family are determined to see justice being done. Gilly turns to Frankie for advise about his growing relationship with Cheryl. Duncan makes plans to take his relationship with Kelly to the next stage.

videos.title: November 4, 2011
videos.overview: The McQueen family rally around as Silas plans his last move. Sinead has some difficult questions for Gaz.

videos.title: November 7, 2011
videos.overview: The sixth form students attempt to bring the village together as they pay tribute to the serial killer's latest couple of victims. Brendan is determined to get even with Warren. Bart thinks about telling Sinead how he really feels.

videos.title: November 8, 2011
videos.overview: Bart tries to warn Sinead to end her relationship with Gaz. Rob ends up panicking after he realises that Annalise expects him to celebrate their two-year anniversary instead of partying with Ash. Duncan enjoys his romance with Kelly.

videos.title: November 9, 2011
videos.overview: Sinead sees a job advert needing someone to come on tour to sell gig merchandise. Sinead want the job for her and her boyfriend. Gaz shows up to dump Sinead, but hears the man agreeing to give him the job.

videos.title: November 10, 2011
videos.overview: Sinead informs the sixth-formers and the she is leaving because she and Gaz are working at a gig tonight and then going on tour. Maddie has a chance to warn Sinead about Gaz but decides not to as she wants Sinead gone. Bart ends up telling Sinead.

videos.title: November 11, 2011
videos.overview: Bart attempts to get into the gig to find Sinead. Tilly urges Maddie to stop Sinead making a huge mistake. Gaz sees Bart and has him thrown out. Bart ends up making one last-ditch attempt to win Sinead back.

videos.title: November 14, 2011
videos.overview: After Ethan returns to the village, he ends up feeling more isolated than ever. As he attempts to find some reassurance it ends up leaving new guy Rob's life in jeopardy after he texts while driving.

videos.title: November 15, 2011
videos.overview: Ethan ends up turning to Theresa for help. A new Savage family member shows up in the form of Dodger and Will's cousin, Dennis.

videos.title: November 16, 2011
videos.overview: Time is starting to run out for Ethan when Theresa finally sees his true colours and refuses to keep his secret.

videos.title: November 17, 2011
videos.overview: Rob desperately tries to remember what happened on the night of the accident, while Dodger's womanising ways finally catch up with him.

videos.title: November 18, 2011
videos.overview: Annalise struggles with her feelings for Scott and the part she played in Rob's accident. Warren enjoys making Ethan squirm. Michaela's first rehearsal with the band doesn't go too well.

videos.title: November 21, 2011
videos.overview: A confused Gilly turns up at Rhys and Jacqui's flat. In a tense, emotional real-time episode, these three characters - bound together by events of the past - try to make sense of it all.

videos.title: November 22, 2011
videos.overview: Mitzeee is avoiding Warren, while sparks fly as feisty Maddie takes on enigmatic Callum for a debate at college.

videos.title: November 23, 2011
videos.overview: Maddie, Tilly and Sinead enjoy a great night out. Maddie attempts to make Callum jealous when she flirts with DJ Joel. The evening ends up finishing in disaster.

videos.title: November 24, 2011
videos.overview: An upset Maddie is rescued by Callum. The unlikely couple attempt to get beyond their spikey banter.

videos.title: November 25, 2011
videos.overview: Brendan is still AWOL after being let out of prison, which fuels Warren's paranoia. New boy Joel is curious to get the low-down on Warren.

videos.title: November 28, 2011
videos.overview: Mercedes attempts to make Riley spend time with her and the baby but things don't go to plans after he announces that he wants to know the truth with a paternity test.

videos.title: November 29, 2011
videos.overview: Warren finds it hard to deal with terms with Joel's presence in the village. Theresa attempts to convince him to find out exactly who Joel is.

videos.title: November 30, 2011
videos.overview: Joel ends up freaking out after he sees another side to Warren that he doesn't like. Warren is concerned that he may have made a costly mistake.

videos.title: December 1, 2011
videos.overview: Mercedes waits to discover who the father of her child is and hopes she will get the answer she is looking for.

videos.title: December 2, 2011
videos.overview: Mercedes has to deal with the results of the paternity test. Ash attempts to work out exactly what's going on between Scott and Annalise.

videos.title: December 5, 2011
videos.overview: After Brendan attempts to get his claws into Joel, Warren is furious. Sparks start to flow between Theresa and Joel.

videos.title: December 6, 2011
videos.overview: Ethan is pressured by Warren to give him with an alibi so that he can get rid of Brendan for good. Louis, Danny and Laurence are warned off Ruby by Jack. Ruby ends up taking a huge risk to try and win Sinead's favour.

videos.title: December 7, 2011
videos.overview: After Jack finds out that he's missing some money, Ruby's in trouble. Warren is confronted by Theresa about Ethan's confession.

videos.title: December 8, 2011
videos.overview: Callum attempts to get Maddie to learn more about him as they enjoy their proper date. Mitzeee finds out that Warren has been lying to her about Ethan. Nancy issues Mitzeee with a warning.

videos.title: December 9, 2011
videos.overview: Nancy is left reeling after she gets a warning visit from Brendan. Mitzeee ends up coming to the conclusion that there is no escaping Warren. Brendan ends up coming up with a shocking solution.

videos.title: December 12, 2011
videos.overview: Tara's return ends up causing trouble for Callum and Maddie's relationship after Tara refuses to give up on Callum. Warren's efforts to try and keep Mitzeee on side leave her feeling more scared than ever.

videos.title: December 13, 2011
videos.overview: Maddie ends up having a go at Callum which could see him ending up back in Tash's arms. Dennis attempts to impress Leanne, but she has her sights on somebody else.

videos.title: December 14, 2011
videos.overview: Maddie begins to self-destruct as she tries to get rid of her feelings for Callum. Leanne has no clue about Dennis' true feelings after she asks him to help her ensnare Matt.

videos.title: December 15, 2011
videos.overview: George's efforts to get Maddie and Callum back together end up failing when Maddie starts to isolate herself from the group. Ash's meddling ends up making Callum give Tara an ultimatum.

videos.title: December 16, 2011
videos.overview: Mitzeee returns following a trip with Warren. Leanne's efforts to try and make make Matt jealous end up leaving pleasing Dennis.

videos.title: December 19, 2011
videos.overview: Brendan and Mitzeee continue with their plot against Warren. Mercedes attempts to convince Seth to talk about Riley.

videos.title: December 20, 2011
videos.overview: Doug and new student Jodie go out on a date but sparks end up flying after she meets Dodger. Riley is surprised to learn that Mercedes has left baby Bobby at home with Bart. Joel becomes suspicious about Mitzeee after he catches her crying to Brendan.

videos.title: December 21, 2011
videos.overview: Brendan and Warren end up fighting when Nancy finds it hard to contain a shocking revelation. Mitzeee attempts to win Warren over. Riley and Mercedes plan a Christmas meal for Bobby.

videos.title: December 22, 2011
videos.overview: Mercedes finds it hard to create the perfect Christmas meal with Riley and calls for back-up from the rest of her family. Cracks begin to form in Mitzeee and Brendan's plans which end up having deadly consequences.

videos.title: December 23, 2011
videos.overview: Things end up coming to a dramatic conclusion on Christmas Eve when Warren takes Mitzeee to the place where he buried Louise's body. Brendan finds himself in a race against time to find them before history repeats itself.

videos.title: December 26, 2011
videos.overview: In a special It's A Wonderful Life homage episode, as Doug finds himself on a bridge at his lowest, and after jumping into the river he gets a visit from the much loved and missed Stephanie Del A Dean who shows him what life in the village would've been like had Doug never been there. He's then left with a choice to either join his girlfriend Bec's in heaven or to return to his life.

videos.title: December 27, 2011
videos.overview: Texas and Jodie deal with the fallout from the previous day's events. As Joel is left wondering if he has any place in Hollyoaks. And, Mercedes questions whether she can bring up Bobby on her own.

videos.title: December 28, 2011
videos.overview: The students prepare to travel to Barney's, but Theresa and Will feel further apart than ever. Meanwhile, Mercedes is gutted when Riley snubs her, but he soon regrets it when she stops him from seeing his son.

videos.title: December 29, 2011
videos.overview: The students are in high spirits, intending to enjoy their impressive surroundings, but an unexpected arrival threatens to spoil the party. Meanwhile, Jacqui tells Mercedes to move on and put the past behind her, leading her to do something drastic. The ongoing love-games between Jodie, Doug and Dodger continues. And the Daytona Lights set upon catching their big break when a record label label exec comes to see them perform at the SU Bar but not all goes quite to plan.

videos.title: December 30, 2011
videos.overview: Mercedes finally prepares to let go of Riley, but when she realises just how much this will cost her, she's not sure whether she can bring herself to go through with it.

videos.title: January 27, 2012
videos.overview: Mercedes starts blackmailing Dr Browning - could this be what Lynsey needs to get her old job back?

videos.title: February 22, 2012
videos.overview:
Mercedes is unapologetic for her actions last night, but Theresa is determined to give Mercedes another chance and suggests she could look after Kathleen Angel for a while. 

However, when Theresa returns to an empty house, she panics - where the hell is Mercedes?!

videos.title: February 23, 2012
videos.overview: A frustrated Mercedes tries her best to make amends, but things go from bad to worse when the McQueens end up in A&E. As Mercedes spirals further out of control, Jacqui decides that they have to do something - and soon!

videos.title: February 24, 2012
videos.overview: Jacqui pays a visit to a face from the past, determined to do what she can to help Mercedes. But while she's away, Rhys is shocked when Mercedes hits a new low. Is it too late to help her?

videos.title: February 27, 2012
videos.overview: Rhys reels in horror from Mercedes's kiss. Mercedes begs Rhys not to say a word, but will he or won't he tell Jacqui?

videos.title: February 28, 2012
videos.overview: Blood-thirsty Jacqui arrives at the McQueens to take Mercedes to task for snogging Rhys. Jacqui, Carmel and Myra tear a strip off home-wrecker Mercy and for once mild-mannered Carmel truly lets rip. It looks as if it's all over for the McQueens, until Mercy reveals a dreadful secret.

videos.title: March 21, 2012
videos.overview: Jacqui surprises Rhys when she invites Phoebe to stay the night.

videos.title: March 22, 2012
videos.overview: It is chaotic as everyone prepares for Bobby's christening, but the McQueens panic when they realize Mercedes and Bobby are missing. Following her discovery, Mercedes is ready to kill and Mitzeee is at the centre of Mercedes' scorn. And Jacqui and Rhys are fuming when they realise the cost of their kindness.

videos.title: April 16, 2012
videos.overview: Jacqui reluctantly goes to the McQueens' for dinner when Myra insists Mercy is out. However, it's not long before talk turns to her feud with Mercy and they're back to square one.

videos.title: April 18, 2012
videos.overview: Jacqui is determined to help Phoebe, but Rhys is less than enamored when he realises exactly what she has in mind.

videos.title: April 19, 2012
videos.overview: George washes his hands of Phoebe, while Jacqui is determined to help her. However, Rhys is less than enamoured when he realises exactly what she has in mind.

videos.title: April 20, 2012
videos.overview: Rhys makes Phoebe less than welcome when she moves into her new home, and enlists the aid of the other McQueens to talk some sense into Jacqui. However, the plan is derailed when Mercedes turns up, and the feuding sisters end up coming to blows again.

videos.title: April 23, 2012
videos.overview: Phoebe’s mum Mel turns up unannounced at Jacqui & Rhys’ determined to get her daughter back, while Mercy gives Phoebe money to buy Jacqui something nice… But what’s she up to?

videos.title: April 24, 2012
videos.overview: Phoebe runs away, giving Mercedes and Jacqui a chance to make amends as they try to track her down.

videos.title: April 25, 2012
videos.overview: Rhys is shocked at Phoebe's revelation that her mum is a prostitute. Mercy and Jacqui have realised the same thing and Jac is at loggerheads over Phoebe living with Mel. Will they all reach an agreement over what to do with Phoebe?

videos.title: May 7, 2012
videos.overview: It’s the opening day of Ste and Doug’s deli. To celebrate, Doug heads to the pub, but a few drinks lead to something more with Texas as his determination to play it straight continues. Still terrified of her stalker, Mitzeee is unsure whether she can handle a public appearance. However, Mercedes gives her just the push she needs to get back out there. Jacqui is determined that Phoebe has an education, but a meeting with a prospective school doesn’t quite go according to plan. Ruby is overjoyed not to be grounded anymore - until she discovers that not all of her friends are pleased to have her back.

videos.title: May 8, 2012
videos.overview: Texas and Doug agree that their night together was a drunken mistake. However, when they go for a drink to talk, things go from bad to worse for Doug. Could this have something to do with Ste? A furious Riley confronts Mitzeee about her lies, so when she gets an offer of work abroad, it seems like the perfect solution for them both. Later, when Lynsey calls time on their fledgling romance, Riley realises that she might be the one for him - can he convince her to take things to the next level? A contrite Jacqui is forced to undo the damage she did yesterday to get Phoebe into school. Esther is determined to get Ruby and Jono talking again.

videos.title: May 9, 2012
videos.overview: Doug and Ste’s professional relationship is put under strain when their personal lives get in the way. Later, Doug finally cracks and confesses his love. It’s the college open day and queen bee Maddie is in her element showing the newbies around, but she’s disturbed to find Ruby a potential threat to her status. Elsewhere at college, a shocked Esther discovers Jen and Tilly’s secret - and that kind of gossip is hard to keep quiet… Lacey finds herself attracted to a student, but is disappointed when their time together is cut short. When will she see him again?

videos.title: May 17, 2012
videos.overview: While Joel fights for his life, Brendan is hell bent on revenge. However, when Cheryl overhears a conversation between Brendan and Walker, she insists that there's only one person responsible - Brendan. Meanwhile, a heart-to-heart between Dennis and Dodger prompts Dodger to reach out to Texas, but will it be enough? Elsewhere, an old friend helps Amy realise she has to take a few risks. She heads off to tell Ally how she really feels before it's too late.

videos.title: June 4, 2012
videos.overview: The McQueens aren't letting Myra's court date get them down - it's party time for the family with Michaela's 21st and the Diamond Jubilee celebrations. Lynsey and Riley are also at the party and they struggle with how to tell Mercedes about their relationship. Mercedes finally turns over a new leaf, but when a drunk Mitzeee drops a bombshell, can her positive outlook survive this devastating news? Meanwhile, Ste and Doug deliver a cake to the celebration as well as the news that they are a couple. Later, the McQueens are sent into disarray when Bart returns from court with some devastating news…

videos.title: June 5, 2012
videos.overview: A jealous Brendan can't handle Ste and Doug's relationship, but before he can do anything, Doug comes clean to Ste about the money behind the deli. Meanwhile, Mercedes struggles with the news of Lynsey's betrayal, but can she find it in herself to forgive her friend? Elsewhere, with Jacqui taking control at the McQueens', Liberty finds herself homeless like Dirk and Dodger. Can the Savages raise enough money to buy a new home, or will they be forced to leave Hollyoaks forever?

videos.title: June 6, 2012
videos.overview: Manipulative Brendan presents Ste with a promising business proposal, but is that all he wants from his former flame? Meanwhile, Texas and Leanne help Doug find a way to win back Ste, but is he too late? Elsewhere, testosterone is flying high in the Savage household. Over the last few weeks, the sibling rivalry has been out of control and now it peaks when Dodger and Will find themselves in a race to raise enough cash to save their family. However, when the competition heats up, Will refuses to join forces with Dodger and instead makes a big decision that could cost him everything.

videos.title: June 7, 2012
videos.overview: Joel is seething when he discovers that Walker is back and wants to know exactly what Brendan is up to. Meanwhile, spurred on by Mercedes, a jealous Lynsey challenges Riley over his feelings towards Mitzeee. Desperate to prove his love for Lynsey, Riley suggests they should take their relationship to the next level. Elsewhere, Dennis is gutted to discover that the Savages have left. Also today, Lacey thinks she's found a new friend.

videos.title: June 8, 2012
videos.overview: Ste finally declares his love for Brendan, as long as he wipes out the deli's debt. Doug is devastated and makes a rash decision. Meanwhile, with no headliner, Will is forced to face the baying crowds at his party - but will a shock arrival save the day? Elsewhere at the event, Dodger is rocked to the core when he discovers a shocking family secret.

videos.title: June 11, 2012
videos.overview: Cheryl is unnerved when she sees an old face return to the village and fears that Brendan may be up to no good. Meanwhile, the Savages are in a celebratory mood after their festival success, but their high spirits are crushed when they discover that their profits have been stolen. Barney is horrified when the finger of suspicion points at him, but can he prove his innocence? Elsewhere, Mercedes makes the most of an opportunity to stir things with Lynsey. Also today, Phoebe is stunned by a revelation from Lacey.

videos.title: June 12, 2012
videos.overview: Ste finally declares his love for Brendan, as long as he wipes out the deli's debt. Doug is devastated. And with no headliner, Will is forced to face the baying crowds at his party.

videos.title: June 14, 2012
videos.overview: Lynsey and Riley host the dinner party from hell and no matter how much Riley tries to prove otherwise, Lynsey fears she still has cause to worry about him and Mitzeee. Brendan confronts Walker about Joel's discovery, but Walker insists that Joel doesn't know the full story and reveals a new side of himself to Brendan. Martha tries to buy Lacey's silence, but the tables are turned when Martha discovers Lacey's far from innocent. Carmel worries that her dreams of becoming the Face of Attwells could be over before they've begun.

videos.title: June 15, 2012
videos.overview: Joel's unnerved by Walker's continued presence in the village, while Lynsey calls time on her relationship with Riley, admitting that she can't be second best to Mitzeee. But with Mitzeee heading away on business, will Riley tell her the truth before it's too late? Carmel pulls out all the stops to prepare for the Face of Attwells competition, but her actions have horrifying results. Meanwhile, the Savages make a surprise return.

videos.title: June 18, 2012
videos.overview: Mitzeee's sudden return from New York makes Nancy suspicious, but then they meet gorgeous footballer Jay... could he be everything Mitzeee has ever wanted? Carmel struggles to come to terms with the news that her injuries will never fully heal and ends up on the hospital roof. Doug's confidence with Ste is shaken when a bitter Brendan makes his presence felt. Texas is pleased that Dodger has returned to Hollyoaks but is shocked to discover he hasn't questioned Dirk about his true parentage. The Savages' return infuriates Jack when they make it clear they're here to stay. And Brendan won't listen to Joel's warnings about Walker; is there someone else who might be able to get through?

videos.title: June 19, 2012
videos.overview: When a sick Riley needs help, Mitzeee is torn; should she choose the man she loves or a dream date with Jay? Lynsey finds a distraught Carmel on the hospital roof; can she talk her down in time? Doug feels increasingly emasculated when he realises that Ste used to fancy Ally; is he man enough for his boyfriend? The Savages come up with a plan to keep their boat outside The Dog, but will Jack fall for it?

videos.title: June 20, 2012
videos.overview: Mitzeee puts it all on the line when she declares her love for Riley, but his reaction isn't what she expected. Will Riley have a change of heart when he finds out about Mitzeee's sacrifice? Darren and Rhys feel taken for granted by their wives, so they head to The Dog, determined to show them who's boss. Brendan continues to mess with Ste and Doug.

videos.title: June 21, 2012
videos.overview: Tensions rise to the surface during a lads' night out as Brendan taunts his friends and neighbours. Determined to put an end to the problem, Rhys, Dodger and Darren decide to stand up to the crook, but drunken posturing gets them in trouble. Meanwhile, a few too many drinks prompts Riley to compose a revealing text message to one of the three women pursuing his affections - but he ends up sending it to the wrong person.

videos.title: June 22, 2012
videos.overview: Riley goes all out to declare his feelings for Mitzeee, little knowing that Mercedes has misunderstood and thinks he loves her. How will this love triangle be resolved? Phoebe tries to play marriage counsellor to Jacqui and Rhys, but is their relationship beyond repair? Newly empowered Doug finally sleeps with Ste, but their happiness is destroyed by an unwelcome visitor. Elsewhere, Joel shares his doubts about Walker with Lynsey and she decides to tackle him. Has Walker misjudged where Brendan's loyalties lie?

videos.title: June 25, 2012
videos.overview: A loved-up Mitzeee and Riley prepare to go public, but a humiliated Mercedes is determined to put an end to their happiness and decides to turn the heat up on Mitzeee. Walker warns Ally to keep schtum about his past, but when a passing Lynsey witnesses it, Walker's oblivious to the fact that he's put someone else on his trail. Doug and Ste break the news of their new landlord to Amy, while a rebellious Lacey decides she's had enough of Martha's hypocrisy.

videos.title: June 26, 2012
videos.overview: With the return of her stalker, Mitzeee starts to lose her grip on reality and a night out with the girls descends into chaos as her paranoia reaches new heights. Riley is horrified when he realises the true extent of the situation, but when a faux-concerned Mercedes learns that her plan is working, she decides to pay Mitzeee a visit. Tensions heighten between the two women with horrifying consequences... Elsewhere, Nancy is nervous as she braces herself for the scan, and Callum's frustrations grow as he feels totally alone.

videos.title: August 3, 2012
videos.overview: Will has a difficult decision to make when a journalist offers him a large sum of money for his story but his choice has consequences for Dodger. Forced to reconsider her religion, Carmel feels her dysfunctional family aren't taking her crisis of faith seriously. Tilly and Jen continue their secret love affair, but when Tilly feels torn between her friends and her lover, who will she choose? Leanne is enjoying working with Rob at the gym and tries to put him under her spell.

videos.title: August 21, 2012
videos.overview: Jacqui's concerns for Mercedes grow as Doctor Browning struggles to convince Mercedes that they have a future together - is Mercedes falling for him in spite of herself? Later, Mercy lands herself in even more trouble when she's kidnapped… Meanwhile, Tilly is comforted by Neil as she struggles to accept Jen's news. But is Tilly prepared to roll over so easily? Elsewhere, Dodger struggles to regain his mojo, while Texas makes plans for a future away from Hollyoaks. Also today, Phoebe's efforts to force a wedge between George and Ryan don't go according to plan, while Ally gains Ash's forgiveness - but Walker has bigger plans for him.

videos.title: August 22, 2012
videos.overview: Still hurting following Jen's revelation, Tilly acts out and finds herself in trouble with the police after stealing Jen's car. Meanwhile, struggling to get her head around recent revelations, Mercedes focuses her attentions back on Riley. Elsewhere, Texas's leaving party forces Dodger to take action, but are his words enough to stop her from leaving? Also today, Joel and Cheryl begin to build bridges as they unite in their grief for Lynsey, while Ryan's arrival leaves Phoebe out in the cold.

videos.title: August 24, 2012
videos.overview: Riley makes a surprising proposition that opens up the possibility of Mercedes' dreams coming true, and Dodger reels from the previous day's events. A newly returned Maddie turns the group against Esther, and Myra settles back into the family fold, but Jacqui suspects something is amiss.

videos.title: August 27, 2012
videos.overview: Tensions run high in the village as the day of Mitzeee's hearing arrives, and as the would-be Wag prepares to meet her fate, Mercedes continues to plot against her. Meanwhile, the newly released Myra appears to be hiding a secret, and Phoebe furthers her agenda by giving unreliable relationship advice to George. Callum tries to reconcile Martha and Lacey, and Bart's lie about his academic success proves hard to maintain.

videos.title: August 28, 2012
videos.overview: Dirk tries to offer Dodger some fatherly advice, but the gesture only serves to irritate him further. Martha struggles to resist toasting Lacey's 16th birthday, and Jacqui begins to notice something unusual about Myra's behaviour. Meanwhile, Nancy inadvertently gives Mercedes just what she wants when she questions Riley about his affections, and Theresa is tempted by an offer guaranteed to bring in easy cash.

videos.title: August 29, 2012
videos.overview: Dodger finds a scrap of evidence about the identity of his real father, while Ash confronts Martha about her behaviour and its impact on the rest of the Kanes. A jealous Joel delivers an ultimatum to Theresa after hearing about her new job, and Jacqui comes up with an unusual way of getting through to Myra.

videos.title: August 30, 2012
videos.overview:
Dodger will take a turn for the worse and drown his sorrows, worried he will never find his true father. The Kane family will be in tatters following Martha's disappearance, did Ash push things too far?

Myra will get back to her old self, and find an unusual way of letting out her anger. Elsewhere, an angry Theresa will look to someone new for comfort... will she be making a huge mistake?

videos.title: August 31, 2012
videos.overview:
A red mist will descend on the vision of a young Scottish Foxy, following the events of the night before. Will he be able to forgive Theresa?

A guilty Ash will refuse to stand by and watch her family fall apart, but is it too late for her to save them? 

Meanwhile at the McQueens, a surprise visitor will persuade Michaela not to give up a fantastic opportunity, while Myra will decide it's time for someone to move out...

videos.title: September 3, 2012
videos.overview: With the start of term looming, Esther and Ruby are dreading their first day at college, but will they be able to overcome their fears? The Kanes realise their cupboard is truly bare and are offered help from a budding friend.

videos.title: September 4, 2012
videos.overview: Following a nightmare first day at college, things go from bad to worse for Esther when Jack catches her skiving. And, with wedding preparations in full swing, Ste and Dennis are united in their misery.

videos.title: September 5, 2012
videos.overview: Dennis saves the day for Leanne, but Ste is at the end of his tether. How will Jen cope with a surprise new addition to her class?

videos.title: September 6, 2012
videos.overview: As the wedding day approaches, Dennis proves indispensable in keeping secrets, but he is having serious doubts. And, as Doug digs deeper, Ste issues an ultimatum.

videos.title: September 7, 2012
videos.overview: Mercedes is causing chaos in the village again, but has she pushed Nancy too far this time?

videos.title: September 10, 2012
videos.overview: An unscrupulous Mercedes threatens Nancy and her baby, but will it be enough to stop Nancy's quest for justice? Leanne is still in the midst of wedding fever and Walker gets defensive when the doctor makes it clear that Cam's prognosis isn't good.

videos.title: September 11, 2012
videos.overview: Darren urges Nancy to take it easy. Mercedes puts on the performance of her life when Mitzeee hears the outcome of her trial. Theresa's frustrated that she's not getting any alone time with Joel.

videos.title: September 12, 2012
videos.overview: Joel's mum begs Theresa not to tell him her secret. The Kanes are soon struggling when Ash is unable to pay the rent. Jacqui seeks help from Frankie about Phoebe.

videos.title: September 13, 2012
videos.overview: Theresa plans a birthday surprise for Joel. Lacey devises a fun-filled money making scheme to help pay the rent. Bart and Neil play a prank on Jono.

videos.title: September 14, 2012
videos.overview: There's chemistry in the kitchen when Ste helps Brendan prepare Joel's birthday dinner party. A bitter Maddie tells Ruby that Jono has a new girlfriend.

videos.title: September 17, 2012
videos.overview: The aftermath of the party causes ripples for the Kanes. While Rhys is busy trying to hold his family together, Jacqui and Myra enjoy a night on the town, and Cindy is left feeling neglected when Tony leaves her to spend an evening with the students.

videos.title: September 18, 2012
videos.overview: As Ally continues to get the Kanes back on track, Callum is left wondering if he's too good to be true. Phoebe and Esther bond over their shared hatred of Maddie and, in an attempt to make Tony notice her, Cindy flirts with Rhys.

videos.title: September 19, 2012
videos.overview: Callum is given reason to suspect that Ally isn't all he seems, while Maddie makes an effort to befriend Phoebe - but does she have an ulterior motive?

videos.title: September 20, 2012
videos.overview: Callum's efforts to expose Ally lead to some major revelations. Meanwhile, Esther's fashion showcase ends in humiliation.

videos.title: September 21, 2012
videos.overview: Phoebe determines to make Maddie pay, while Leanne attempts to heal the growing rift between Doug and Ste.

videos.title: September 24, 2012
videos.overview: Doug makes a life-changing decision when he realises he needs to accept Ste's history with Brendan or move on, while the students find their dream apartment but are bound by Tony's tenancy agreement.

videos.title: September 25, 2012
videos.overview: Riley is shocked by a surprise visitor, while Bart decides it's not quite time to face reality.

videos.title: September 26, 2012
videos.overview: Mercedes makes a horrifying discovery, while Bart lies about his antics in an effort to win back Sinead.

videos.title: September 27, 2012
videos.overview: A devastated Mercedes and Riley struggle to cope with events, while Darren realises Nancy is in touch with Mitzeee and begs her to go to the police.

videos.title: September 28, 2012
videos.overview: Mercedes makes a shocking accusation on live TV, while Nancy agrees to help a frightened Mitzeee.

videos.title: October 1, 2012
videos.overview: Riley comes up short of funds, so the village pulls together to help his cause.

videos.title: October 2, 2012
videos.overview: Riley is forced to break Mitzeee's heart, while Ste is caught in the crossfire of an on-going feud.

videos.title: October 3, 2012
videos.overview: Nancy and Darren fear for the future of their tiny baby. Jacqui can't believe that Myra has remained loyal to Mercedes, knowing what she did.

videos.title: October 4, 2012
videos.overview: There's tension between Nancy, who is scared, and Darren, who is angry. Ste points the finger of blame at an unsuspecting resident for the recent trauma.

videos.title: October 5, 2012
videos.overview: Darren's temper flares as he realises how much danger his wife exposed their child to.

videos.title: October 8, 2012
videos.overview: Struggling to deal with the loss of Mercedes and Bobby, Myra becomes a cause for concern to Dirk. Darren goes full throttle and tells Nancy what he really thinks, but can Jack talk him round? Rhys tries his best to lure Cindy into some bedroom shenanigans. Despite her best efforts to please everyone, Esther is made to look a fool.

videos.title: October 9, 2012
videos.overview: Cindy is getting frustrated with Rhys's pestering and heads to the McQueens' to call it off, but can she resist temptation? Meanwhile, Nancy is buoyed by a visit from Tom, but wonders what's got into Darren when he goes AWOL. Elsewhere, Myra decides it's time to remedy her wrongs and heads to Nana McQueen's. Also today, Esther is mortified when videos of her appear on Dylan's website, while Tony decides he's going to get his hands on Atwell's - but a mystery bidder gives him a run for his money.

videos.title: October 10, 2012
videos.overview: Darren and Nancy are anxious as their baby fights a serious infection. Rob and Liam develop a rivalry when Atwell's new manager is revealed. While Tony is away, Rhys and Cindy decide to play, but will they get found out? Myra resolves to get the McQueens back together, while Esther is further divided from her friends as the video publishers become known.

videos.title: October 11, 2012
videos.overview: Darren and Nancy appear to be back on track when the family gather together at the baby's christening. Tony's suspicions are misplaced after a rather green Cindy makes her escape. Jacqui confronts Rhys about his antics, while Esther is further ostracised when she is blamed for breaking Jen's sculpture. Ash's decision to prove her domestic goddess status to Ally doesn't last long.

videos.title: October 12, 2012
videos.overview: Darren and Rhys unwind at Ash and Ally's party. Stood up by Bart, Sinead drowns her sorrows and catches the eye of Rob and the guys. George bears the brunt of Esther's wrath when she realises the gang have read her personal letter, while Tony believes his suspicions about Cindy are confirmed.

videos.title: October 15, 2012
videos.overview: Rhys distances himself from Cindy when rumours surface that she's pregnant. Esther decides to skive college, but is mortified by Jack's punishment.

videos.title: October 16, 2012
videos.overview: As Tony's world comes crashing down he decides it's time for action and won't take no for an answer... Ally plays cupid for Lacey and Dylan, while Esther attracts unwanted attention.

videos.title: October 17, 2012
videos.overview: Tony is determined to prove his love for Cindy, while Ash, Callum and Lacey are devastated when Martha doesn't show up for coffee.

videos.title: October 18, 2012
videos.overview: A forlorn Ruby is left out of the fold, but desperate to get back in with Sinead and Maddie.

videos.title: October 19, 2012
videos.overview: Lacey decides to play it cool with Dylan, but will she end up regretting it? Brendan tries to help with Lynsey's funeral but Cheryl keeps him at a distance.

videos.title: October 22, 2012
videos.overview: Lynsey's brother Eoghan arrives in the village, leaving Ste wondering about his past with Brendan and Cheryl. Meanwhile, Rhys is surprised by Cindy and Tony's engagement, and Cindy's necklace causes confusion. Elsewhere, spurred on by Ally, Lacey and Dylan share a kiss - but Lacey wonders if he's the only one who fancies her. Also today, Jacqui discovers Joel and Theresa's loot and demands the pair put it back, while Martha tries to help Ash - but will it do her any favours?

videos.title: October 23, 2012
videos.overview: Cheryl goes in search of answers from an unlikely source. Ste offers a saddened Brendan a shoulder to cry on and Lacey snubs a confused Dylan in pursuit of another beau.

videos.title: October 24, 2012
videos.overview: Brendan tries to be there for his sister but will Cheryl let him? Darren's mouth gets him into trouble and a dejected Cindy wants attention, but is Tony the man for the job?

videos.title: October 25, 2012
videos.overview: Dodger gives Tom advice on women, not realising who the true object of his affection is. Jono and Bart are at loggerheads and battle it out on the army assault course. Finally, Jen attempts to boost Esther's self-esteem, but is it in vain?

videos.title: October 26, 2012
videos.overview: Darren is wary as Tom finds excuses to hang out with Texas and Dodger, while Jono makes a surprising decision. Meanwhile, Esther is given food for thought by her online chum.

videos.title: October 29, 2012
videos.overview: Neil and Bart join forces to try to convince Jono not to join the army. Esther decides to stand against Maddie at college and Jacqui's stunned as Rhys makes a shocking declaration.

videos.title: October 30, 2012
videos.overview: A surprise visitor causes tension between Ste and Doug, while Myra worries about her daughter's marriage.

videos.title: October 31, 2012
videos.overview: As Cindy is offered a chance to escape, a call from the hospital makes her question everything. Esther is left humiliated when the teenagers plot a prank against her and Doug is stunned as Brendan continues to come between him and Ste.

videos.title: November 1, 2012
videos.overview: As things look bleak for Tony, he offers Cindy a way out. Doug is incensed as Brendan saves the day for Ste again.

videos.title: November 2, 2012
videos.overview: Cindy faces a tough choice, while Jono asks Ruby to make a life-changing decision.

videos.title: November 5, 2012
videos.overview: The village is reeling with excitement from the unexpected arrival of a familiar figure. Lacey develops an illicit crush, but are her feelings returned? Frankie goes to extreme lengths to stop Ruby from making a horrible mistake.

videos.title: November 6, 2012
videos.overview: There's trouble in town as a mischievous newcomer arrives in Hollyoaks. Joel finds himself in a precarious situation, and Cheryl admits to Tony that there is a slight complication with their big day.

videos.title: November 7, 2012
videos.overview: Mitzeee finds out there's still a hidden secret that could change her life for ever. Myra struggles financially, finding charity from the most unlikely source. Callum is surprised at Martha's honesty.

videos.title: November 8, 2012
videos.overview: Mitzeee is dealt some difficult news and, at the Kanes', things heat up for Lacey. As Esther offers Ruby a heartfelt gift, she is once again thwarted by Maddie.

videos.title: November 9, 2012
videos.overview: With Jacqui believing her relationship with Rhys is on the mend, will Rhys be able to tell her the truth, or will he leave Hollyoaks for ever? Jono is faced with an important decision and, either way, he will hurt someone.

videos.title: November 12, 2012
videos.overview: Who will Tony reveal his secret to? And, with her big day looming, will Ruby get cold feet?

videos.title: November 13, 2012
videos.overview: On the morning of the wedding, Ste makes a shocking discovery and Esther faces the threat of Maddie's wrath.

videos.title: Enjoy the Ride
videos.overview: A catastrophic accident threatens to destroy lives in the village as Esther and Bart's antics push Maddie to the limit. While Doug can't let go of the past, Ste finally discovers the truth about Brendan. Is Hollyoaks destined for any happy endings?

videos.title: November 15, 2012
videos.overview: In the aftermath of the accident, Hollyoaks falls into disrepair. Things are put in perspective for many in the village, but how much longer can the truth stay buried?

videos.title: November 16, 2012
videos.overview: One resident hears life-changing news, but can they live with the consequences? And just when they thought they were safe, tragedy strikes for one much-loved couple.

videos.title: November 19, 2012
videos.overview: In the aftermath of the devastating crash, Phoebe struggles to retain her silence about what she knows, and Lacey seeks solace in an unlikely friend.

videos.title: November 20, 2012
videos.overview: As Ash struggles to articulate her emotions, and Lacey's illicit feelings intensify, are the Kanes headed for disaster? And when Dodger receives a piece of life-changing information, he is once again left torn.

videos.title: November 21, 2012
videos.overview: Dodger makes the bold choice to meet his real dad as one resident's grief causes havoc in the village.

videos.title: November 22, 2012
videos.overview: Dodger is faced with a shocking revelation, and Lacey's forbidden infatuation escalates.

videos.title: November 23, 2012
videos.overview: Barney arrives back in the village but someone has a proposition for him. Will Carmel's first day at work help her confidence?

videos.title: November 26, 2012
videos.overview: Martha becomes increasingly suspicious of Ally's behaviour, while Nana McQueen takes it on herself to play matchmaker for Carmel.

videos.title: November 27, 2012
videos.overview: Martha confirms her worst fears. Texas makes a decision that could change things for ever. Carmel faces her own insecurities, while Nana wonders if she's done the right thing.

videos.title: November 28, 2012
videos.overview: With Sienna's help, Dodger tries to set matters right, while things heat up in Barney's love life.

videos.title: November 29, 2012
videos.overview: Dodger plans a surprise in order to bring his family together. Mitzeee tells Maxine to find a job, but her sister has other ideas, while Ash considers giving Martha another chance.

videos.title: November 30, 2012
videos.overview: Jacqui is on self-destruct, while Dodger and Dirk face a difficult choice. Maxine decides Mitzeee needs her support, but can she remind her sister how to have fun?

videos.title: December 3, 2012
videos.overview: Sinead is faced with a monumental decision, while it's time for Mitzeee to face Mercedes again.

videos.title: December 4, 2012
videos.overview: As lawyer Jim paints a very black and white picture for Mercedes, is Mitzeee strong enough to take her on? Diane and Bart learn of Sinead's plans, but can they change her mind?

videos.title: December 5, 2012
videos.overview: Jim unknowingly complicates things when he welcomes a star witness in the dock. Doug and Ste struggle to cope with the stress of family life.

videos.title: December 6, 2012
videos.overview: It's judgement day for Mercedes, and Carmel receives attention from an unlikely figure, but are his feelings reciprocated?

videos.title: December 7, 2012
videos.overview: Surprise arrivals in Hollyoaks deal Doug some shattering news. Sienna and Texas attempt to cast aside their differences for the sake of Dodger.

videos.title: December 10, 2012
videos.overview: On the day of the crash inquest, Esther's world comes tumbling down, while Doug and Ste are in utter turmoil when they face a life-changing decision.

videos.title: December 11, 2012
videos.overview: Doug pushes Ste to the limits, while Esther is faced with Maddie, Jono and Neil's memorial. Jacqui enlists Cindy's help with the funeral.

videos.title: December 12, 2012
videos.overview: It's the day of Rhys's funeral. When Tony is asked to give a speech, can he bring himself to praise the man who was sleeping with his wife? Or will he publicly expose Rhys's infidelity? Meanwhile, Jacqui seeks solace in an old friend as Cindy prepares to say a painful goodbye to the man that she loves. Elsewhere, as Frankie and Jack despair over Esther, Ruby confides in them - are things finally looking up for Esther? Also in the village, Ste's world comes crashing down, and Nancy struggles to control her jealousy. (Jacqui and Tony share a kiss!)

videos.title: December 13, 2012
videos.overview: Jacqui finds a clue which leads her directly to the heart of Rhys's disloyalty, only to be met with a devastating discovery. Meanwhile, cracks begin to form among the Savages, but can anybody help Dodger and Dirk see sense? Elsewhere, Theresa prepares for Joel's release from prison before being dealt some shocking news.

videos.title: December 14, 2012
videos.overview: As the differences between his two families transpire, how will Dodger cope? Meanwhile, Texas is left confused and reeling when Sienna attempts to stir trouble within an already fractured family. Elsewhere, at the Christmas lights switch-on, Maxine has her eyes set on one guy only, but are the feelings mutual?

videos.title: December 17, 2012
videos.overview: As Doug and Ste bid farewell to the village, Cheryl is left questioning Ste's affections, but is it too late? Meanwhile, Texas's fear mounts as Sienna and Dodger spend time alone, knowing her secret is a ticking time bomb. Can Texas bring herself to tell Dodger the truth? Elsewhere, seeing Bart shattered by Sinead's rejection, Jacqui makes a devastating decision. Also today, with money tight, will Joel give into temptation?

videos.title: December 18, 2012
videos.overview: Cheryl makes a revelation that leaves Doug in utter turmoil. As Theresa maps out the future, Joel makes an executive decision.

videos.title: December 19, 2012
videos.overview: Leanne is overjoyed when an old friend returns to lend a helping hand, and Maxine and Mitzeee make a deal that can only lead to disaster.

videos.title: December 20, 2012
videos.overview: Nancy fears the worst when she receives a call from the hospital. When Maxine struggles to stick to her promise, can she keep another secret from her sister?

videos.title: December 21, 2012
videos.overview: Maxine and Mitzeee make a scandalous discovery, and Nana McQueen is dazed by a shock confession from Barney.

videos.title: December 24, 2012
videos.overview: It’s the day of the Christmas ball! After confiding in a friend about his secret arrangement, Barney prepares to admit his true affections to Carmel... will she get the fairy-tale ending of her dreams? Elsewhere, Brendan struggles to cope with his overwhelming situation, while an isolated Mercedes gets a surprise visitor knocking on her door.

videos.title: December 26, 2012
videos.overview: The McQueen's world is rocked when a mystery bundle arrives with no explanation. On her first Christmas without Rhys, Jacqui's emotions run high as she makes a heart-breaking discovery, with disastrous consequences... Worried for Carmel, Myra overhears the events of last night and throws one McQueen out in the cold. Is Christmas over for this lonely figure? Elsewhere, John Paul struggles to adapt to Christmas back at the McQueen's.

videos.title: December 27, 2012
videos.overview: As Jacqui learns the full extent of Rhys's infidelity, she leans on Tony for support. Could there still be a spark between the pair? Meanwhile, Darren and Nancy are struggling with parenthood, but could there be an underlying issue? Elsewhere, seeing Mercedes upset, Browning concocts a plan to get back in favour with the McQueens'.

videos.title: December 28, 2012 #1
videos.overview: Darren and Nancy's worry increases as they seek professional advice at the hospital over their fears that Oscar could be deaf. Meanwhile, Myra's fears for the future escalate as she finds out what she thought was a hangover could be something worse.

videos.title: January 2, 2013
videos.overview: When a social worker turns up to look into the situation at the Osbornes' following Charlie's disappearance, they soon realise they can't continue to go on the way they have been.However when Ruby blames Esther for not watching Charlie she finds solace at Mitzeee's. Cheryl tries to get Brendan and Seamus to bond over a lunch at the dog, however when Brendan storms out she gives him a ultimatum. And Leanne doesn't remember anything from the night before much to Dennis' dismay.

videos.title: January 3, 2013
videos.overview: Things end up becoming even more tense for the Osbornes. Esther manages to find friendship in a trusted source.

videos.title: January 7, 2013
videos.overview: Cheryl's concern escalates over Seamus's disappearance. Can Brendan keep his terrible secret? Meanwhile, a harassed Joel deals Theresa heartbreaking news, but can she change his mind? Elsewhere, Mercedes manages to make inroads with Myra, but there's trouble ahead when Mercy jumps to the wrong conclusion. Also today, Bart fears that he'll never be able to turn over a new leaf. Finally, as Esther is pushed to the limit, she makes a decision that will affect all of the sixth formers.

videos.title: January 17, 2013
videos.overview: It's the day of Myra's fundraiser, and a familiar figure arrives back to hear of recent events at the McQueens'. Meanwhile, Dodger is left reeling from yet another shocking discovery. Elsewhere, as Esther's bullying continues, nothing can prepare her for what she is about to see.

videos.title: January 28, 2013
videos.overview: As Tilly vows to expose the truth, Jen takes drastic measures to stop her. Things go from bad to worse for Phoebe, and Brendan surprises himself and Ste as he looks after Leah.

videos.title: January 29, 2013

Elsewhere, with the truth laying heavy on Jen's conscience, can she bring herself to expose it and risk her career? Also today, Phoebe struggles to be heard in the McQueens', but things look up slightly when John Paul finds out about her suspension from college and offers to tutor her. Finally, Jacqui is left reeling by Myra's actions when she discovers that her mum is £7,000 in debt.

videos.title: January 30, 2013
videos.overview: Ste is rattled when Brendan questions his commitment. Can Ste reveal the truth about his relationship to Amy? At the same time, as Mitzeee encourages Brendan to face up to his past, a shady figure intervenes… and an old enemy returns. Meanwhile, following yesterday's revelations, Jacqui rallies the McQueens into action - but the news that Carmel has some savings doesn't provide relief for long as the dizzy blonde decides to buy a car! Elsewhere, Theresa proves she's more than just a pretty face, but has Dodger got more than he bargained for? Also today, Ash and Barney plan a party for Will, but there's a spanner in the works when they hear that he won't be allowed out of hospital.

videos.title: January 31, 2013
videos.overview: Ste worries about his future with Brendan, but Brendan makes the bold choice to live with Ste. Meanwhile, Ash and Barney come up with a daring plan to help Will, disguising him as an old woman to break him out of the hospital. But could the plan backfire? Elsewhere, the McQueens' attempts to go straight have disastrous consequences for everyone as they end up in a massive bar brawl. Also today, an increasingly dejected Phoebe makes a tough decision as she steals £50 from the cash tin and prepares to tell Jacqui that she's leaving. But will the bar brawl interrupt her plans?

videos.title: February 1, 2013

Meanwhile, as John Paul struggles with the pressure of being a job-seeking single parent, a shock visit turns his world upside down. Elsewhere, panic strikes the village as time is ticking for Will, who has disappeared amid the chaos of his party. But as a guilty Dodger wishes to reconcile, is it too late?

videos.title: February 21, 2013

Meanwhile, chaos reigns in the Osborne household as Nancy is forced to confront her worst nightmare, but is there more heartache yet to come? Elsewhere, Jacqui sees an opportunity to improve the McQueens' dire financial situation when she spots a "cleaners needed" flyer. However, she already knows the interviewer Trudy from her prison days...  Also today, Texas realises that her feelings for Will aren't real when Dodger gives her a 'goodbye kiss'. Can she ever be honest with Will?

videos.title: February 22, 2013

How much longer can Darren hide the truth for, and at what cost? Meanwhile, Brendan returns to the village from Ireland but doesn't receive a warm welcome from Ste. Elsewhere, Jacqui is pushed to the limits by Trudy, who wants revenge for their time in prison and is going to make Jacqui pay. Can Jacqui get through this cleaning job without losing her temper? Will Doug finally admit his true feelings?

videos.title: February 25, 2013
videos.overview: Darren concocts an elaborate plan to secure his family's future. Can things between Trudy and Jacqui get much worse? And can Ste and Brendan overcome the obstacles in the way of taking their relationship to the next level?

videos.title: February 26, 2013
videos.overview: As tension mounts, can Leanne resolve the chaos she's caused before it's too late? Darren panics under pressure, but can he save the day?

videos.title: February 27, 2013
videos.overview: How will the Osbornes cope with the consequences of the previous night? Tony steps in to save the day. Is Cheryl having reservations about Nate?

videos.title: February 28, 2013
videos.overview: Leanne gives some controversial advice, but will her idea work? Seamus grows suspicious of his daughter's new man.

videos.title: March 1, 2013
videos.overview: Seamus reveals his uncertainties about Nate. Will Dodger admit how he really feels to Theresa?

videos.title: March 4, 2013

Ruby prepares for her first day back at college, but will this former bully be easily forgiven? Will manipulates an awkward situation. Precisely what is he planning?

videos.title: March 8, 2013

Elsewhere, Sinead is forced to make a serious life decision, and the full horror of Kevin’s dishonesty is unveiled. Things go from bad to worse for the McQueens, but is there more to Trudy’s cleaning company than she’s letting on? Meanwhile, Cindy unwittingly pushes Holly further away.

videos.title: March 11, 2013
videos.overview: Sinead anxiously awaits Diane's life-changing decision. Has a concerned Leanne isolated a resolute Texas even further? Jacqui's day takes a shocking turn as she is confronted by her worst nightmare.

videos.title: March 12, 2013
videos.overview: Will Jacqui open up to anyone about her ordeal? As Kevin understands the full repercussions of his actions, can he hide such a big secret from Walker? When Cheryl's surprise to Nate backfires, will she lose everything she's ever dreamed of?

videos.title: March 13, 2013

Brendan decides to take matters into his own hands after lawyer Jim McGinn reveals the dire truth about his case, and a terrified Kevin finds himself cornered.

videos.title: March 14, 2013
videos.overview: Seamus offers Cheryl an offer to rival yesterday's, but which will she choose? The Osbornes hear some shocking news. As Walker learns the magnitude of Kevin's deceit, could Kevin be in mortal danger?

videos.title: March 15, 2013
videos.overview: Things heat up for Walker, but what exactly does he have planned? Is it game over for Kevin? Could there be more to Ellie than Will is aware of?

videos.title: March 27, 2013
videos.overview: A nostalgic Tony attempts to rekindle his relationship with Jacqui, but has he missed his chance? Meanwhile, to what extremes will Nancy go to fuel her addiction? Elsewhere, Jacqui reveals heartbreaking news to Doctor Browning, but will he believe her? Also today, Myra is horrified to learn of her mother's betrayal.Finally, Phoebe urges an anguished George to divulge the truth about his one-night stand.

videos.title: March 28, 2013
videos.overview: A mystery woman in red posts a photo of a gagged Mercedes to Browning, shortly followed by the return of Clare Devine. Has she done something to Mercy? Meanwhile, wrongly assuming that George's one-night stand was with John Paul, Phoebe decides to teach JP a lesson by mugging him. Will her actions prove costly? Elsewhere, Darren's suspicions grow when he finds Nancy frantically picking spilt pills up from the floor. Also today, Tony struggles with his affections, but will he make a mistake by pursuing Diane? Finally, the McQueens host an unconventional baptism.

videos.title: March 29, 2013
videos.overview: Doctor Browning is confronted by an unwanted visitor, but how does he know them? Meanwhile, Jacqui and the McQueens beg John Paul to withdraw his statement to protect Phoebe, but it's too late as she already has a court date. Worried over her uncertain future, Phoebe hits the bottle. Elsewhere, Tony questions where his heart truly lies, and Diane is crushed when she sees that Jacqui is still the object of his affections. Also today, Nancy makes a shock admission to Sienna.

videos.title: April 2, 2013
videos.overview: Jacqui is on the warpath in the fallout from Phoebe's collapse. With Trudy refusing to take the vodka off the shelves, Jacqui decides to get rid of it all in her own way - by smashing it up. Meanwhile, new boy Robbie Roscoe is introduced to Patrick at college. It's clear there's a devilish side to this newcomer, but Patrick is up for the challenge. When Robbie trashes a display at the deli and frames Callum, it's up to Cal to face the wrath of Patrick. Elsewhere, Esther struggles to overcome her demons as the sixth formers plan a fashion show in her honour. Is she ready to face up to her past? Also today, Tony finds himself in the midst of a love triangle, but who will he choose?

videos.title: April 3, 2013
videos.overview: Tilly has planted Esther's tell-all diary in John Paul's pigeon hole at college, with details of her and Jen's affair in it. At the college open day, Jen is proud to be giving a speech to the prospective parents, but she's humiliated when images of her and Tilly in various romantic clinches are projected behind her – busted! Meanwhile, Jacqui is in a moral quandary when Trudy offers her the chance to get Phoebe off any charges, but at what cost? Elsewhere, Maxine and Liam break into Chez Chez to recover the abandoned alcohol following the Bradys' departure and plan a themed cocktail night. The entrepreneurial pair decide to buy Chez Chez and run it together. Also today, Callum has a new partner in crime and they are intent on exacting revenge!

videos.title: April 4, 2013
videos.overview: Romance blossoms for Tony, but his recent sacrifices threaten to scupper the success of his new business. Later, Jacqui decides that it's time Tony knew what really happened between her and Trudy in prison, so she makes a shock confession. Meanwhile, Tilly finds an unlikely ally as she attempts to rid the village of Jen for good. Elsewhere, John Paul turns to Doug for solace as he is forced to evaluate his future. The pair get drunk and end up sticking post-its all over Patrick's car, unaware they're being photographed by Cal and Robbie. Also today, Callum and Robbie continue to ruffle feathers in the village. Is this the start of a destructive friendship?

videos.title: April 5, 2013
videos.overview: Chez Chez is up for auction and it's a race to the finish line for the prospective bidders. Despite Liam's departure, Maxine hopes to be able to afford the club thanks to a loan from Mitzeee. At the same time, Clare is still hopeful that Browning will step up and invest in the club. However, Doctor Browning has some reservations about Clare, especially when Jim tells him that 'Cassandra' doesn't exist. Will he see through her devious plans? And who will succeed in securing the club? Meanwhile, things appear to be on the up for John Paul, but a harmless prank may be the undoing of him. Elsewhere, Tilly and Esther grow closer as recent events draw them together.

videos.title: April 11, 2013
videos.overview: Leanne confronts Will and is further shocked when she discovers a shoebox filled with CCTV DVDs - what kind of sick person is he? Can Leanne bring herself to tell her Texas the ghastly truth? Meanwhile, the McQueens fall into despair as the stakes are raised, with a £200,000 ransom being demanded in exchange for Mercedes's safe return. But does Jacqui have an idea up her sleeve? Elsewhere, Maxine finds a unique way to improve her academic skills. Also today, Theresa receives relationship advice from an unlikely acquaintance.

videos.title: April 12, 2013
videos.overview: Pushed to the extremes in order to secure Mercy's safe return, will Jacqui shake hands with the devil? Meanwhile, Leanne leans in to kiss Will, but will it prove to be a costly mistake? Elsewhere, Maxine is jubilant after receiving fantastic news, but for how long can her good mood last? Also today, Carmel offers a shoulder for petrified Myra.

videos.title: April 15, 2013
videos.overview: The McQueens concoct a plan to save Mercedes, but to what extremes are they willing to go? Meanwhile, as Callum is left feeling dejected, who will he turn to? Elsewhere, Sinead and Diane are gobsmacked when Sinead's dad Rob returns and delivers the shocking news that Finn has gone missing. Also today, Tony is left questioning his future as his Decree Absolute arrives.

videos.title: April 16, 2013
videos.overview: Jacqui prepares to meet with Trevor and trick him into buying a supposedly vodka-laden truck for £50,000. She is shocked when Phoebe jumps into the van with her - she's not budging. Later, when Jacqui hears a crash from the back of the van, she is alarmed to find five illegal immigrants smuggled away. What will she do about it? Meanwhile, on the way to an all-night gig, Sinead, Callum and Robbie are horrified when they knock someone over and jump out to find a motionless body in the road. Elsewhere, Diane privately makes a surprise decision.

videos.title: April 17, 2013
videos.overview: Sinead is horrified after being involved in running over her own brother Finn. With Finn's memory hazy, can Sinead cover for deceitful Robbie despite their wrongdoing? Meanwhile, with extremes of life or death, how much are Phoebe and Jacqui prepared to risk? Elsewhere, Tony is left with tough decisions to make. Also today, Diane is stunned to the core by a piece of life-changing news.

videos.title: April 18, 2013
videos.overview: Jacqui is offered one final opportunity to save her sister, but is it too late? Meanwhile, Nancy has arranged for Darren to do an interview with the Herald about his win on the horses, but he refuses to do it. Nancy questions her husband and is horrified when he tells her the truth about the betting slip.

videos.title: April 19, 2013
videos.overview: Jacqui's day takes a terrifying turn. Later, after planning her getaway, Jacqui says an emotional goodbye to Phoebe and departs the village alone. Meanwhile, can deceived Nancy find it in her to forgive and forget? Or will she finally admit to her own dishonesties?

videos.title: April 24, 2013
videos.overview: An unwelcome figure from Tom's past returns to Hollyoaks, while Carmal begins to see Jim in a new light.

videos.title: April 25, 2013
videos.overview: Secrets and lies are revealed at Texas' hen du, meanwhile, Mercedes is wracked with guilt.

videos.title: April 26, 2013
videos.overview: Texas is faced with a difficult decision when Will tells her that he has a life-threatening aneurism. But what will she choose - her head, or her heart? Meanwhile, Myra feels compelled to tell Carmel the truth, but will she break Carmel's heart? Elsewhere, Mercedes goes to extreme lengths to settle her debts with a family member.

videos.title: April 29, 2013
videos.overview: A familiar face  turns up on Maxine's doorstep, Sinead goes into labor and Ste returns to Hollyoaks, but it doesn't take long before he loses control.

videos.title: April 30, 2013
videos.overview: Patrick's hostility towards Maxine's new flatmate pushes him to extremes. Meanwhile, Finn makes a plan that could save his family and Ste makes a shocking confession to Doug.

videos.title: May 1, 2013
videos.overview: Ste and Doug need to put there differences aside in order to win a prestigious food competition. Callum gets on Robbie's bad side and Maxine tries to deal with her true emotions.

videos.title: May 2, 2013
videos.overview: Ste may have finally found a solution to his financial problems, while Robbie throws a rave at Chez Chez. Phoebe is shocked when she sees a familiar face from her past. Meanwhile, Robbie tries to get revenge on Callum, but when his plan goes badly it means life or death for someone else.

videos.title: June 6, 2013
videos.overview: It's the day of Tony's operation, so Darren decides to tell Cindy about Tony's condition. She rushes to the hospital and reassures Tony that he's not alone anymore. Meanwhile, Ste is desperate to get back into Freddie's good books, but the newcomer is refusing to supply him. However, Sinead swipes Freddie's phone, finds the name of his supplier and sends Ste off to meet him - unaware that it's evil Trevor. Elsewhere, Sinead fills a bag with painkillers to sell. Later, Sinead is trapped in the alleyway and attacked by a student who she sold a dodgy pill to. Also today, Tilly has a heart-to-heart with a distraught Esther.

videos.title: Plots and Plans: Myra's Final Week
videos.overview: As the McQueens become aware of Dr. Browning’s evil plan, is there anything they can do to save their family? Meanwhile, Ziggy is desperate to prove that he’s not under the thumb when it comes to Ruby, Vincent thinks he might have found the answer to his prayers and Cindy struggles to control her agoraphobia.

videos.title: Risky Games
videos.overview: Mercedes is devastated at the risky, extreme lengths she has to go to protect her mum, but will her efforts be in vain? Or will Dr. Browning get his own way, with devastating consequences? Elsewhere, George can’t deny his feelings any longer, but how will Vincent respond?

videos.title: Danger and Distress
videos.overview: A distraught Mercedes seeks the ultimate revenge on Dr Browning, but will she put herself in danger? George and Vincent settle their differences, whilst Phoebe gets the shock of her life. Sandy is speechless as an old face arrives back in the village, and the McQueens realise that life will never be the same again.

videos.title: A Glimmer of Hope
videos.overview: The McQueens are left utterly broken by the week’s events, but can Jim provide a glimmer of hope to one family member? Meanwhile, the Roscoes are aghast to hear of their brother’s recent torment, and the threat of Trevor still looms over the village.

videos.title: Difficult Decisions
videos.overview: The Roscoes are dealt some shocking news, but, despite wanting to think the best of her sons, Sandy’s suspicions are piqued. Vincent is forced to make a difficult decision, but who will he choose: George or Phoebe? Elsewhere, Sinead is interrogated by the police.

videos.title: Dangerous Actions
videos.overview: Will's jealousy and paranoia continues to increase. Can anybody stop him from murdering again? Jack tries to hide his dishonesty from his wife, but will Frankie realise his deceit? The McQueens struggle to come to terms with the loss of their loved one. Meanwhile, Patrick makes a devastating discovery that could shatter his family forever.

videos.title: Guilt and Suspicion
videos.overview: A guilty Will struggles to deal with the consequences of his actions, but has he done enough to cover his tracks, or will he find himself caught out? Patrick receives yet another blow as he is held fully accountable for yesterday's events. The McQueens receive yet more distressing news, but do they have an illicit idea up their sleeves? As Frankie's suspicions are raised, will she get to the bottom of Jack's treachery? Meanwhile, Leanne and Dennis are planning their dream wedding, but can they afford it?

videos.title: Tragedy
videos.overview: As a furious Jack makes an emotional Frankie apologise to Sandy for her behaviour, Lindsey is in the wrong place at the wrong time - with devastating consequences. As those that surround him become suspicious, are the walls finally closing in on Will? Dennis is roped into Nana McQueen's risky plan, but can he go through with it?

videos.title: Broken Hearts
videos.overview: As tensions run high, could Dennis and Leanne's wedding be called off? Lindsey is rushed into hospital, leaving Joe utterly distraught. Could Frankie be to blame for this tragedy? Old feelings are resurrected for Carmel, and elsewhere, Trevor is given food for thought. Meanwhile, Patrick comes to a shocking realisation.

videos.title: New Beginnings?
videos.overview: Emotions escalate for the Roscoes as Frankie refuses to lay old worries to rest, but has Jack done enough to convince everyone otherwise? Freddie struggles to keep his distance as he watches a loved on grieve. Trevor decides to get pay back, but how far will he go? Meanwhile, a proposal leaves smiles all round.

videos.title: A Day To Remember
videos.overview: It's finally the day of Frankie and Jack's wedding vow renewal, but can they put the problems of the past behind them to ensure they have a day to remember? As trouble erupts in The Dog, Sandy makes a gobsmacking admission, while Joe gets the shock of his life. Meanwhile, Trevor and Fraser plot the ultimate revenge of a deceitful Jim.

videos.title: Breaking Point
videos.overview: With recent events hanging heavy in the air, could this be the end of an era for the Osborne family? Or will Jack's desperate attempts to reconcile prevail? Elsewhere, still reeling from yesterday's shocking news and coming to terms with his recent grief, is Joe nearing breaking point? His brother Freddie isn't fairing much better, as his jealousy hits a raw nerve with Sinead.

videos.title: Surprise Surprise
videos.overview: With her relationship on the rocks, Frankie surprises herself as she seeks comfort in the arms of a family acquaintance. Freddie is forced to perform a terrifying task, but will it go to plan? Meanwhile, Sienna asks Darren to take their relationship the next step.

videos.title: Trapped In The Closet
videos.overview: Freddie watches on aghast as his mission doesn't quite go as planned, especially when he discovers who has been trapped inside! Meanwhile, feeling flustered and embarrassed, Frankie is desperate to keep her actions a secret, but will she succeed? Will Fraser pull off his cruel plot to frame Jim? And Sienna shows her true colours while fighting to keep Darren happy.

videos.title: High and Dry
videos.overview: Backed into a corner by Fraser and faced with a moral predicament, what will Jim decide to do? Freddie admits to his demons, but will he lose the love and respect of those close to him? Elsewhere, as Maxine is left high and dry, who will she turn to for support? Sienna is overjoyed as her plan begins to fall into place, but Frankie's ruin serves as a cold reminder to her malicious actions.

videos.title: An Illicit Arrangement
videos.overview: A guilty Maxine is overwhelmed by Patrick's persistence to win her back, but will she reveal whose bed she was in last night? As Jim desperately tries to get out of his illicit arrangement, will he succeed? Meanwhile, despite his best efforts, nothing can prepare Joe for Lindsey's heart-breaking revelation and Ste is stunned to receive help from an unlikely source.

videos.title: How Do You Plead?
videos.overview: It's the day of Ste's court hearing and Doug pulls out all the stops to keep his friend out of jail; but still feeling an overwhelming sense of guilt, how will Ste plead? Elsewhere, Maxine is desperate to save her relationship, but will she succeed? Joe and Lindsey are on the rocks, but can they sort out their differences? Meanwhile, Leanne's babysitting ends in disaster, and is Tony setting himself up for a fail?
