videos.overview: Lindsey’s on a mission at the prison, while Ste panics when he can’t remember what happened last night at the college fancy dress disco. Elsewhere, Sienna is oblivious to Nico’s secret rendezvous, and its exam results day - will Esther and the Roscoe boys pass with flying colours?

videos.title: Broken Promises
videos.overview: Sienna panics when she discovers where Nico’s gone, but is she too late? Lindsey’s heart sinks when she gets a call about Joe, and a guilty Ste begs John Paul not to give up on him. Meanwhile, Jason struggles to cope under pressure and Holly despairs when he fails to live up to his promises.

videos.title: Confrontation and Consequences
videos.overview: Cameron attempts to stop an out of control Peri from doing something reckless, while Jason finds himself in hot water with Stan after reconciling with Holly. Elsewhere, Freddie confronts Joe and is shocked by what his brother reveals: what dangerous consequences will Lindsey's lies have?

videos.title: Shock Decisions
videos.overview: Stan gives Jason more time, but as that starts to run out, will he hurt his loved ones to save his own back? Meanwhile, Blessing shocks Dennis with a surprise decision, and Mercedes and Lindsey team up to get justice.

videos.title: Release
videos.overview: As Blessing re-visits her past, she is left heart broken and in need of a release. Elsewhere, Freddie’s world is on the brink of crashing down, and will John Paul be there for Ste in his hour of need?

videos.title: Desperation and Devastation
videos.overview: Sienna’s desperation to keep Dodger for herself grows, while Blessing’s self-harming leads to health problems which threaten her hopes for the future. Elsewhere, Dodger gets a lot more than he bargained for when Dennis asks him for help…

videos.title: Protection
videos.overview: Patrick’s return causes trouble for Dodger; Sienna tries to protect her brother, but can she get round her controlling father? Meanwhile, Dodger is desperate to make Maxine stay, but other forces are out to prevent him. Elsewhere, there’s heartbreak for the Roscoes...

videos.title: Unwanted Visitor
videos.overview: Theresa sends an order for Kathleen-Angel to visit the prison, but to her dismay, Sonny visits her instead. Finn’s shocked when a familiar face returns to the village, but do they have good intentions? Sienna engineers an incredibly awkward meeting between Maxine and Patrick and, in true Sienna fashion, she tells an unforgivable lie to get what she wants - to keep Dodger by her side. Elsewhere, Nancy is stressed about her impending nuptials, while Darren refuses to lift a finger, and Rick tries to be her knight in shining armour.

videos.title: The Lie
videos.overview: Nico is outraged when she finds out about her mother’s deception and swears to tell Dodger the truth. Finn and Amber ask Diane for a deposit so they can get their own place, but Diane is suspicious. Rick makes a promise to Nancy, but being as slippery as he is, will he actually stand by it?

videos.title: Dangerous Mistakes
videos.overview: It’s the night of Darren’s fancy dress stag do and everyone’s dressing up. Dodger confides in Patrick about Nico, while Maxine is scared about what she finds on the boat. Meanwhile, Finn shows his true colours when he catches Amber trying to leave the village, and it’s up to Nancy to save the day. Has she put herself in danger?

videos.title: Backed into a Corner
videos.overview: Ste is reunited with a face from the past; will they spoil his chances with John Paul? Robbie is determined to make sure justice is served, and will do everything he can to succeed. Darren races to be by his wife’s side after her attack, while one resident tries to hide their terrible deed…

videos.title: Wedding Day
videos.overview: The village is shocked by the recent arrest, while Nancy is absolutely set on going through with her wedding to Darren. A proud John Paul walks Nancy down the aisle; will it be second time lucky for the bride-to-be?

videos.title: Heartbreaking Revelations
videos.overview: Nana is heartbroken when she finds out that John Paul was raped and the shock takes its toll on her. Sinead forgives Diane for not supporting her when Katy was ill, while the net is closing in on another family member.

videos.title: Grief and Guilt
videos.overview: Mercedes is on the warpath after discovering the truth about John Paul’s attack, and Grace rushes to Nana McQueen’s aid. Meanwhile, Tony has a proposition for Sinead and Nico is plagued with guilt when Dodger and Maxine decide to throw her a party.

videos.title: Home Truths
videos.overview: Esther hits the jackpot, but could she be putting herself in serious danger? Elsewhere, Big Bob continues to hassle Trevor and Grace, while Nana makes a terrible mistake. Nico can’t play along with Sienna’s sick lies anymore, and Sinead is forced to tell someone close a shocking truth.

videos.title: Fearful
videos.overview: Maxine fears for her safety and decides she has to leave, but how far will Sienna go to stop Dodger going with her? George urges Esther to do the right thing and Jason resorts to desperate measures to earn some cash, leaving Holly alarmed by the dark route he’s taking.

videos.title: Decisions, Decisions
videos.overview: The Blake/Savages must choose whether to unite to avoid disaster, as a life hangs in the balance. While Esther announces a new business venture to her surprised family, Holly takes control in a bid to save Jason, but is there another surprise in store for her?

videos.title: Difficult Decisions
videos.overview: Freddie threatens to tell Joe the truth unless Lindsey takes a paternity test, while Sienna’s disappearance causes Nico to worry sick. Elsewhere, Grace leaves Sonny with a lot to think about, and Rick saves the day for Jason, but it comes at a price.

videos.title: Shocks and Secrets
videos.overview: Rick’s debts start to catch up with him, causing potential danger for his family. Will they have to suffer for his mistakes? Meanwhile, the results of Lindsey’s paternity test leave Freddie in shock, and Kathleen McQueen discovers a secret about Sonny which could bring him down, but is Phoebe hiding something?

videos.title: Discoveries
videos.overview: The garage re-launch is almost ruined when Freddie’s frustrations about Lindsey erupt, while Carmel is forced to face some hard evidence against Sonny, and Rick discovers a family secret.

videos.title: Tainted New Beginnings
videos.overview: Esther begins her new business venture, but a looming threat could destroy her dream. Elsewhere, Sonny plans to get rid of meddling Kathleen, while Mercedes, Phoebe and Theresa concoct a plan of their own in order to save her. Meanwhile, things start looking good for Trevor and Grace’s dreams of a family.

videos.title: Happy Reunions
videos.overview: The return of a familiar face comes just in time, as Nana tries to put an end to her family’s schemes, but stubborn Mercedes goes ahead with her big plan. Meanwhile, Carmel has a heart-breaking decision to make.

videos.title: Shocks and Confessions
videos.overview: Carmel has some shocking news for the McQueens, while Trevor receives a mystery package that causes him to worry about Grace. Elsewhere, George and Esther have a fall out after Esther turns into a nightmare boss, and Ste makes a confession to Tony.

videos.title: Against the Clock
videos.overview: Trevor and Freddie are racing against time on a tense rescue mission, while the Lomaxes are shaken up after a threatening encounter. Elsewhere, there’s a development in Finn’s case, but is it enough to get him convicted?

videos.title: Plea for Help
videos.overview: Leela, Tegan and Peri make a police appeal in a desperate attempt to find the driver who killed their parents. Meanwhile, Esther is worried when it looks like the source of the £50,000 is about to be revealed, and it’s the day of Finn’s plea, so everyone gathers at the court. Elsewhere, Phoebe is shocked to see that Vincent has returned.

videos.title: Face-to-Face
videos.overview: George and Vincent come face-to face, despite Phoebe’s efforts to keep them apart. Meanwhile, Ziggy is caught red-handed, and Tony has to decide where loyalties lie.

videos.title: Determination
videos.overview: Sienna puts herself in danger by trying to escape the boiler room, while Patrick attempts to regain control over Maxine and Dodger. Elsewhere, Dirk is left heart-broken after visiting Cindy, and Nancy worries that her affair with Rick is going to be exposed.

videos.title: Wicked Irony
videos.overview: Nico gets very close to rumbling Patrick’s big secret, while Dodger takes matters into his own hands when Patrick gets too close for comfort. Myra lends Holly and Dirk a shoulder to cry on, but her good intentions end with heart-breaking consequences. Meanwhile, Tom makes a shock discovery.

videos.title: Urgency
videos.overview: Holly is left to pick up the pieces after Myra’s betrayal, and a discovery by Kathleen-Angel rings alarm bells for the McQueens. A desperate Patrick turns to Maxine, but will she help him? And Nico’s school prank puts Sienna in big danger.

videos.title: The Wrong Time
videos.overview: Maxine realises she’s made a terrible mistake and makes the brave decision to make things right. Carmel decides to do things her way, and is left reeling by what she finds. Dirk and Holly visit Cindy but find that, despite everything, they’re only making things worse. Meanwhile, someone returns to the village, and ends up causing quite a stir!

videos.title: Plans Gone Awry
videos.overview: The McQueens have devised a plan for revenge, but in true McQueens style, it has dramatic and dangerous consequences. Sinead pleads with Ste to get help, but she fears that she’s left it too late. And will Nana’s confession to John Paul change everything? Elsewhere, Darren launches a vendetta against the O’Connor family and finds himself on the wrong side of the law.

videos.title: Bad Decisions
videos.overview: Carmel is horrified by what her family has done, while Finn gets a shock when someone close to him comes to visit. Meanwhile, John Paul makes a decision that could seriously jeopardise his future, and will temptation get the better of Darren?

videos.title: Stand By Me
videos.overview: As Finn’s trial kicks off, John Paul is surrounded by the support of the McQueens and Ste, but Ste is feeling the pressure. Diane standing by Finn is pushing Tony and Sinead closer together, while Darren’s in for a shock following a courtroom revelation.

videos.title: A Problem Shared is a Problem Halved
videos.overview: Ste and Sinead find comfort in sharing their problems but Sinead’s in hot water when she shares one too many secrets. Elsewhere, the Osborne family is in turmoil after the first day of Finn’s trial and Darren finds an unlikely shoulder to cry on. Ever the flirt, Rick has his eyes on another of the village ladies.

videos.title: Righting Wrongs
videos.overview: It’s Ste’s turn to give evidence at Finn’s trial but his testimony could have devastating consequences for John Paul, while Darren is under pressure to right things with Nancy. Diane finds herself in the wrong place at the wrong time, as Dennis and Tom embark on a new business adventure.

videos.title: Decisions
videos.overview: The jury have to decide who to believe, Robbie or Finn, as they go head to head in court. Nana McQueen falls ill, while Dennis’ new business opens with a bang. Ste hits a new low as he tries to suppress his cravings.

videos.title: Shocks
videos.overview: It’s D-day for John Paul and Finn as the jury delivers its verdict. The McQueens are shocked when an unlikely witness shows up in court, while Tony and Sinead share a moment, but someone’s watching! Diane’s actions have a life-changing effect on the O’Connors.

videos.title: Deal With the Devil
videos.overview: Myra finds some incriminating evidence and has to decide whether to use it to stir up some trouble, while Trevor and Grace are given some heart-breaking news. Elsewhere, Freddie makes a deal with someone he should be avoiding, and Tegan interferes with Leela’s relationship.

videos.title: An Unexpected Visitor
videos.overview: Ziggy and Cameron go head to head in an unlikely challenge, while a new arrival in the village doesn’t go down well with Lindsey. Freddie and Big Bob’s plan spirals out of Freddie’s control and turns into a hostage situation at the hospital. While being held, Esther collapses, causing Grace to fear for her health. Elsewhere, Myra plans her revenge…

videos.title: Imprisoned
videos.overview: The hospital is still on lock-down, and one of the hostages is fighting a life or death battle. Meanwhile, Tegan and Ziggy are trapped in a lift and find an unexpected way to pass the time, and a scared Lindsey makes a confession…

videos.title: Hero of the Hour
videos.overview: Leela races to save her sister when the lift holding Ziggy and Tegan looks like it’s going to plummet. Elsewhere in the hospital, the day ends in tragedy, while Phoebe makes Robbie an offer he can’t refuse back in the village.

videos.title: Stirring Up Trouble
videos.overview: The dust begins to settle after the hospital crisis, but there’s not much relief for the hostages. Sienna has a cunning plan which forces Maxine and Patrick into an awkward situation, and Cindy finally gets the news her family have been waiting to hear, but Jason is worried by what he finds during their visit.

videos.title: Thwarted Plans
videos.overview: Maxine makes plans to propose to Dodger, but they’re ruined by scheming Sienna. Maxine immediately blames Patrick, and wishes him dead… but she better be careful what she wishes for. Meanwhile, Phoebe proves herself a true McQueen when she seduces Robbie while Carmel looks for the evidence she needs to free Theresa. Will Carmel actually use the evidence to help her cousin?

videos.title: Righting Wrongs
videos.overview: It looks like Cindy is finally heading home from hospital, until Jason shares a worrying secret, while the Blake/Savages are looking for someone to blame following the previous day’s events. Elsewhere, Carmel is racing against time to save someone she loves, and Holly breaks Jason’s heart when he sees her and Robbie getting close.

videos.title: Bedside Manners
videos.overview: Theresa goes into labour and is rushed to hospital, but the drama goes up a gear when she reveals who the daddy is. Elsewhere, Tony and Sinead are planning a romantic get-away but an unsuspecting Diane plans to join them.

videos.title: Lies and Games
videos.overview: Sienna and Theresa play dirty to get what they want, while Diane is confused when she tries to contact Tony and realises he’s not where he said he’d be.

videos.title: In For a Shock
videos.overview: Diane manages to track down Tony – but is she in for a nasty shock? Elsewhere, Grace begins to panic about her future, and Dodger is disgusted by what he’s done.

videos.title: Plans Backfire
videos.overview: Peri starts plotting against her family again, and ends up putting herself in serious danger. Diane finally gets the evidence she’s been waiting for to confront Tony with, while Frankie and Jack find something strange in Esther’s bag and wonder what on earth she’s up to.

videos.title: The Waiting Game
videos.overview: Frankie wants to put an end to her family’s secrets - but how far will she go protect Esther? Elsewhere, Diane is on the war path, while Sinead plucks up the courage to take a pregnancy test.

videos.title: Change of Heart
videos.overview: Trevor makes a heart-breaking decision leaving a desperate Grace trying to persuade him to change his mind. Dennis is grieving for Leanne as the anniversary of her death approaches, and oblivious Blessing accidentally makes things worse. Elsewhere, Tony manages to avoid a disaster with Diane, but it doesn't work out well for Sinead.

videos.title: Cunning Plan
videos.overview: It looks like Sienna might have an ulterior motive when she offers to look after Myra-Pocahontas, while Blessing helps Dennis confront some painful truths. Over at the Lomaxes, a secret is let slip at baby Rose’s birthday party which causes chaos.

videos.title: Revenge
videos.overview: Dennis comes up with a dangerous plan to avenge Leanne’s death, while Theresa starts to fear for her own sanity as the McQueens doubt her after some strange goings-on. Elsewhere, Tegan is given some dreadful news.

videos.title: Big Promises
videos.overview: Blessing makes a new friend who claims he can make her dream come true, while Lockie has news for Cameron who assumes his brother is in trouble. Elsewhere, the McQueens continue to worry about Theresa’s stability, while Theresa starts to suspect that Carmel is the one to blame for the recent vendetta against her.

videos.title: Getting Away From it All
videos.overview: The McQueen ladies head off to a spa for the day, unaware that Nana’s life is in danger back home! Blessing is over the moon at the thought of her problems soon being over – but Frankie senses something’s wrong. Elsewhere, Freddie moves on to his next dodgy scheme as Lockie worms his way into the Lomax house.

videos.title: Watch Your Back
videos.overview: The police make a trip to see Freddie, while Blessing makes a brave decision. Theresa finds proof that Carmel is the one causing her problems, but it looks like someone’s already waiting in the shadows to take care of Carmel.

videos.title: Terrible Timing
videos.overview: A familiar face returns to see Ste, but their timing couldn’t be worse! Carmel’s life is hanging in the balance, while the rest of the family discover the truth about Nana’s accident, and Blessing is completely unaware that she’s ruined Freddie’s plans and is sitting on a fortune.

videos.title: Weight of the World
videos.overview: John Paul pays the price after Ste’s drug addiction leaves him in debt to Lockie, and Holly is over the moon when she’s told Cindy can come home for a visit, but Cindy’s not so keen.

videos.title: Outburst
videos.overview: Cindy is finally home from hospital, but her secretive behaviour has got Holly worried. Ste lashes out at his family when he doesn't get the help he needs, and Freddie puts his faith in Robbie, which has heart-stopping consequences…

videos.title: New Surprises
videos.overview: Grace tries her best to play cupid for Esther, who doesn't feel brave enough to go for it, and Porsche’s unexpected arrival is the first of many surprises for the McQueens. Meanwhile, Cindy begins to fear for her life and ends up fleeing the village.

videos.title: Plans Gone Awry
videos.overview: There’s trouble when Cindy’s actions put Holly’s life in serious danger. Grace begins to fear that Esther’s new romance might scupper their deal, and decides that she must sabotage the whole thing. The McQueens are excited by the totally OTT plans for the impending wedding, but they’re completely unaware that their every move is being watched.

videos.title: Big Decisions
videos.overview: Will Maxine sell her soul in return from freedom when Patrick gives her an ultimatum? Rick and Robbie are concerned when Jason’s health deteriorates, and Grace tries to cover her tracks but she just can’t help breaking hearts. Elsewhere, Theresa is desperate when Kathleen-Angel disappears.

videos.title: Danger Approaching
videos.overview: Dodger is back in the village! But he doesn't know whether Maxine will be there waiting for him. Rick embarks on his next sleazy money-making scheme, completely without a thought for Jason’s safety. And as the McQueen wedding draws closer, the family are unaware that the big day is about to derail in spectacular style…

videos.title: In the Nick of Time
videos.overview: Porsche is hugely relieved when her missing bridesmaid appears at the last minute, but John Paul’s fears for his cousin’s happiness threaten to derail the ceremony. Elsewhere, Dodger returns, only to find Maxine under Patrick’s spell once again, but can he rescue her?

videos.title: Misplaced Trust
videos.overview: It’s time for the proud McQueens to board the party-train, but they’re oblivious to the danger that lies ahead. Maxine plans her escape from Patrick, placing her trust in a bitter Sienna… but little does she know, disaster is about to strike.

videos.title: The End of the Line
videos.overview: Celebration turns to tragedy on the wedding party train, but will everyone make it to the end of the line? Maxine goes into labour at the worst possible time, and her saviour leaves her life hanging in the balance.

videos.title: The Aftermath
videos.overview: Heartbreak fills the air at the scene of the train crash, while Patrick is the bearer of some tragic news, and Sienna is questioned about her part in the accident.

videos.title: On the Run
videos.overview: Sienna flees the hospital with a hostage in her clutches, while Esther wants answers after she finds out the real reason why her relationship with Kim was over before it had even begun.

videos.title: Old Habits Die Hard
videos.overview: Sienna takes her hostage to an abandoned building… what’s in store for her captive? Freddie decides that if he’s the father to Lindsey’s baby, he’ll be fighting for full custody, and Grace learns a heartbreaking truth.

videos.title: Not to Plan
videos.overview: Blessing hits the jackpot when she discovers her stolen loot, and Dennis hears some news of her whereabouts. Sienna and Patrick cover their tracks at absolutely any cost, and Lindsey goes into labour. Elsewhere, Grace plans the ultimate revenge…

videos.title: Little Miracle
videos.overview: Lindsey’s stuck with a birth partner she really didn't want, but surprisingly for the pair, a new bond starts to form. Trevor is on the hunt for his lost stash, leaving Blessing in danger, and someone plans to leave the village forever when the rest of their family turn against them.

videos.title: The Race is On
videos.overview: Dennis and Trevor both race each other to reach Blessing first, but she really doesn't want to be found. And someone catches Freddie and Lindsey in a compromising position leaving their life potentially in danger!

videos.title: Desperation
videos.overview: Blessing has a plan to frame Trevor, but Dennis is just determined to get their happy ever after. Following last night’s tragedy, someone is desperate to cover his tracks, while the victim’s family are unaware of their loved-one’s ordeal.

videos.title: Moment of Truth
videos.overview: The day finally comes for Lindsey to find out the paternity of her unborn baby, while Freddie is under suspicion from the police. The murder investigation steps up a gear, causing the victim’s family to fall apart, and Esther guesses the truth behind Sinead’s big secret.

videos.title: Wrong Place, Wrong Time
videos.overview: There's an accident at The Loft, while Diane sees Tony with another woman at The Hutch, but she’s unaware how close to the truth she is when she discovers what Sinead's been hiding. Elsewhere, Lockie’s good deed could have some serious consequences, and Cameron pushes Ziggy too far.

videos.title: Wedding Without a Hitch?
videos.overview: It’s Diane and Tony’s wedding day… what could possibly go wrong? A surprise guest threatens to expose Sinead and Tony’s affair. Elsewhere, Leela and Tegan finally put everything behind them and make-up, while Jason has to lie to Holly to avoid going to the wedding.

videos.title: Buckling Under Pressure
videos.overview: Jason panics about his upcoming boxing match, while Diane has a life-changing decision to make. Lindsey tells her sister about Freddie’s past, and a horrified Kim wants to make sure he gets what he deserves. Elsewhere, Leela and Tegan are suspicious of a new buyer for the Lomax house, is he all he seems?

videos.title: Desperate Measures
videos.overview: Cameron tries everything in his power to protect his family… but will it be enough? Jason’s boxing match is cancelled, much to Jason’s relief, but Robbie and Rick come up with another money making idea. Elsewhere, Nancy tries to intervene when she sees Patrick with baby Minnie.

videos.title: Tête-à-tête
videos.overview: Rick forces Jason to fight, despite his injured hand, just to see who will reign victorious in the battle of the twins. Meanwhile, Cameron has gambled everything on Rick’s advice, but the chances of it paying off are pretty sketchy. And Diane plays Tony at his own game.

videos.title: In the Shadows
videos.overview: Celine questions Jason’s behaviour and is shocked by what she discovers. Patrick enjoys every second of dealing a heart-breaking truth to Maxine, while Sienna is terrified when she can’t find Nico. Elsewhere, it looks like Cameron is about to take Rick's advice and repeat past mistakes, meaning he could be losing the family he’s fought so hard to get back.

videos.title: Injustice
videos.overview: Maxine is on trial and Dodger begs her not to give in to Patrick’s demands, but he could be hindering her chances at freedom as he takes matters into his own hands. Porsche makes Theresa rethink her decision to help Nico, but are they prepared to go up against Sienna? And Cameron and Rick are worried that their desperate act is about to be discovered…

videos.title: Big Mistakes
videos.overview: Lockie moves into the McQueen house, but resisting temptation with John Paul might be harder than they both expect. Nancy could have made the biggest mistake of her life. Meanwhile, Dodger pleads with Theresa to help Nico; will she regret her decision?

videos.title: Desperation
videos.overview: Dr S'Avage, Kim, Celine and Tegan desperately try to find out who’s to blame for what happened to Theresa. John Paul and Lockie struggle to keep their hands off each other, while Tom needs Darren’s help.

videos.title: Welcome Home
videos.overview: Ste is immediately suspicious of John Paul and Lockie’s friendship when he returns home, and he’s later thrown into turmoil by a frightening reminder from his past. Elsewhere, Sienna’s forced to help an enemy in need, and Celine finds out something heart-breaking about a friend.

videos.title: Uncovering Secrets
videos.overview: Tegan is fuming about Celine’s discovery, while Joe panics when he’s dragged into the murder investigation. Elsewhere, desperate to protect his family, Ste makes a big decision about him and John Paul.

videos.title: Dangerous Decision
videos.overview: Freddie’s up against a relentless enemy who discovers more than they bargained for, while Sinead and Tony find something to celebrate. Elsewhere, Rose is rushed to hospital where an impatient Tegan takes control, but her actions only make matters worse.

videos.title: Good Deed
videos.overview: Jason prepares a festive surprise for Holly to help her build bridges with Cindy. Dr S’avage’s diagnosis leaves Tegan in complete shock, while old habits die hard for Tony and Sinead.

videos.title: Weight of the World
videos.overview: Tegan’s world starts to crumble around her following her news at the hospital, while Holly realises something that leaves her wondering what to do next. Myra has no choice but to swallow her pride and Diane makes a big decision about her future with Tony.

videos.title: The Truth
videos.overview: Holly is on the warpath and the Roscoes are shocked when they find a fragile Jason reaching out for help. Sienna recruits Nico to do her dirty work when she fears she’s going to lose Dodger. Sinead is torn over whether she should tell Tony the truth, and Tegan has a huge dilemma to face.

videos.title: Escape Plan
videos.overview: Diane decides that she’s going to leave the village with the twins, but Tony and Sinead are desperate to convince her to stay. Dodger blames Sienna for meddling in his life again, but he’s gobsmacked to discover who’s really to blame. There is some shocking news for Jason as Robbie struggles to handle his twin brother’s behaviour.

videos.title: Dark Discoveries
videos.overview: Sienna kidnaps Minnie, while Nico wants to find her father for Christmas. She might regret it though, when Peri stumbles across some disturbing evidence. Will Nico finally find out the truth? Sinead fears for her relationship when Tony finds out about her manipulative behaviour, so she tries to make it up to him with some festive fun. Elsewhere, Nancy is becoming more reliant on painkillers, and Tegan makes a life changing decision.

videos.title: Desperate Measuress
videos.overview: Nico decides her family would be better off without her, and Tom is desperate to stop her from making a dangerous decision. Dodger tells Sienna he can’t be a father to Nico, so she takes drastic action to make sure that they have the perfect family Christmas. Phoebe gets on the wrong side of Rick when he declares that she’s not good enough for Robbie.

videos.title: A Very Merry Christmas
videos.overview: Dodger is trapped in a Christmas nightmare, while Sienna is delighted to have her family by her side. Little does she know, she’s putting her daughter’s life in danger in the process. Phoebe drops a baby bombshell on Robbie, while Nancy leans on Rick for the wrong kind of help.

videos.title: Suspicious Minds
videos.overview: Theresa is suspicious about Dodger’s whereabouts, and even Sienna’s lies don’t stop her mind whirring. As per, Rick manipulates those around him to get what he wants and upsets Robbie in the process. Meanwhile, Sinead’s insecurity over Tony starts to get the better of her…

videos.title: Stag Dos and Don'ts
videos.overview: It’s the night of Ste and John Paul’s joint stag do, but temptation is in the air for Ste, while JP and Lockie go on the run from the law, taking an unexpected journey. So a normal Hollyoaks stag do, then? Holly is heartbroken when Jason breaks up with her, unaware Cindy is behind his change of heart. Tegan offers Tony a shoulder to cry on, but he takes her advice to new heights and discovers a shocking truth.

videos.title: Christmas Feature Ep!
videos.overview: The day of Ste and John Paul’s wedding has arrived! But with both grooms missing, it still seems like a long road to the altar. Meanwhile, Tony is hosting Christmas lunch for his nearest and dearest, but Sinead’s explosive secret could ruin it all. Holly is delighted with her gift from Cindy and helps Dirk return the favour for her mum. Elsewhere, Sienna reaches new depths of desperation. Will Dodger ever escape? (Part 1)

videos.title: Danger
videos.overview: Things get scary as Sinead’s life hangs in the balance. Nancy is desperate for more pills and has to decide whose help she wants more - Rick or Robbie’s. Meanwhile, Ste and John Paul’s post-wedding relationship is on rocky ground.

videos.title: Guilt
videos.overview: Nancy comforts Peri over the stolen necklace, but when the prospect of Cameron going to prison occurs to her, Peri decides she needs to take drastic measures. Robbie discovers that Rick has been dealing drugs to Nancy, while DS Thorpe has a plan that could tear the Roscoes apart. Elsewhere, there’s a serious turning point in Ste and John Paul’s relationship.

videos.title: The Return
videos.overview: Sandy returns to the village and is delighted to meet her grandson for the first time. But her happiness is short-lived when she finds out Freddie is being investigated for murder. Freddie and Lindsey panic when they find out about DS Thorpe’s plot, and in an effort to keep their affair secret, Freddie puts Joe in danger. Meanwhile, Robbie breaks up with Phoebe, and Jason’s eating disorder takes a turn for the worse.

videos.title: New Year Feature Ep!
videos.overview: Frankie and Robbie offer to help Nancy beat her addiction, but her desperation leaves her out in the cold and in danger. Ziggy manages to bring some light-relief to the Roscoes’ night out at The Dog’s Star-i-oke competition, while Joe decides he needs to find out the truth about Freddie, but gets more than he bargained for. Robbie stands up to his dad, with tragic consequences, and Darren has a rare light-bulb moment, which could change everything for him in 2015. (Part 1)

videos.title: New Year Feature Ep!
videos.overview: Frankie and Robbie offer to help Nancy beat her addiction, but her desperation leaves her out in the cold and in danger. Ziggy manages to bring some light-relief to the Roscoes’ night out at The Dog’s Star-i-oke competition, while Joe decides he needs to find out the truth about Freddie, but gets more than he bargained for. Robbie stands up to his dad, with tragic consequences, and Darren has a rare light-bulb moment, which could change everything for him in 2015. (Part 2)

videos.title: Worry
videos.overview: Celine sheds a new light on Jason’s eating disorder while the rest of the family learns the fate of their loved one. The Roscoes pray for a miracle, and Joe uses his hold over Kim to get her to make sure justice is done.

videos.title: A Big Mistake
videos.overview: The Roscoes are struggling to cope after the events of New Year’s Eve; will they let it destroy the family? Tegan records a special message for baby Rose, but ends up making a terrible mistake that could blow her world apart. And Grace is furious when she discovers that Trevor’s been keeping some pretty huge secrets from her and is determined to find out what they are.

videos.title: Escape
videos.overview: Leela is caught in the middle as Cameron and Peri go head to head, and a mysterious arrival has a surprising revelation for the Lomax family. Tegan panics when she remembers what she did last night, and decides to flee with Ziggy and Rose. Meanwhile, Trevor has his own bombshell for Grace.

videos.title: The Secret
videos.overview: Tegan and Ziggy discover a surprise stowaway when they arrive at their secret hideaway, and when Leela and Cameron track them down, it seems like Cameron’s past mistakes could finally be catching up with him. And Porsche and Lockie battle it out for a job at The Loft, right in the middle of Grace and Trevor’s relationship troubles.

videos.title: Biting the Bullet
videos.overview: Tegan forces herself to be cruel to be kind when Ziggy shares his deepest feelings with her. Grace makes a decision about the job in The Loft, but celebrations turn frosty when a misplaced revenge attack puts someone in danger.

videos.title: Fallout
videos.overview: The Lomaxes try their best to survive the emotional earthquake that threatens to destroy their family. When Lockie discovers Porsche is missing, panic sets in, but someone knows more than they’re letting on. Joe begs for Nancy’s help, but as Nancy battles her conscience, she realises it could be too little too late.

videos.title: Misplaced Trust
videos.overview: Darren launches his new business and is delighted when he gets his first customer. Elsewhere, keen to escape her family, Peri puts her trust in the wrong person, while Robbie goes off the rails, and Nancy has a proposition for Trevor… but she risks getting in too deep.

videos.title: Slippery Slope
videos.overview: Trevor offers Robbie a job stealing cars, while Jason fears he’s holding Sandy back from an exciting new adventure. Dirk is shocked when Maxine returns from LA without Dodger, but there could be new hope for the captive in the basement.

videos.title: Against the Clock
videos.overview: Maxine and Theresa are racing against time to rescue Dodger as Sienna plans to disappear with him forever. Elsewhere, Robbie’s new job causes more heartbreak for the Roscoes.

videos.title: New Ventures
videos.overview: Maxine needs to find the courage to save herself and Minnie when they are forced to leave the village. Tony offers to help Darren with ‘Daz Cabs’, but the pairing could be a recipe for disaster. Elsewhere, Dirk is in a dilemma when he receives a letter and he must decide whether to respond to a cry for help.

videos.title: Unwelcome Return
videos.overview: Life is set to change forever for the Blakes and the Savages, while shockwaves are felt throughout the village when news of an escape spreads. Elsewhere, can Darren swallow his pride and make his new business a success with his meddling best mate?

videos.title: Impossible Decisions
videos.overview: Dodger is faced with a terrible dilemma when Maxine and Theresa find themselves in danger. Jason takes his first steps on the road to recovery when he’s admitted into an eating disorder facility. Elsewhere, Ste is concerned when he gets a call from a past fling.

videos.title: The Showdown
videos.overview: Ste has some heart-breaking news for John Paul. Elsewhere, Dodger’s world goes up in flames and he makes a desperate attempt to save the people he loves. His final showdown with Will ends with tragic consequences...

videos.title: Turmoil
videos.overview: John Paul needs answers but Ste’s behaviour only pushes his husband even further away.  The pair wait for news that could affect their lives forever, but will they find the strength to face the future together, or is this a betrayal too far for John Paul?

videos.title: The Future
videos.overview: Myra and Porsche receive some encouraging news about Mercedes, while Nana makes a decision about the McQueens’ future in Hollyoaks. Elsewhere, Freddie and Lindsey settle into their new home, while Nico is haunted by what happened between Will and Dodger, and John Paul struggles to come to terms with the latest bombshell.

videos.title: Doubts and Discontents
videos.overview: With the evidence against him continuing to grow, Lindsey starts to question Freddie’s innocence.  Meanwhile, Porsche, Nana and Lockie search for answers of their own. Grace plans something special for Esther but Kim rubs her up the wrong way and can’t believe what she discovers.

videos.title: Family Support
videos.overview: Ste’s loved ones rush to him when he sets out for revenge, while Grace, Trevor and Esther are delighted to see their baby for the first time. Elsewhere, there’s a development in Mercedes’ murder case, and Porsche and Celine are shocked by a new arrival.

videos.title: Wrong Place, Wrong Time
videos.overview: Freddie has a terrible day as he tries to keep one step ahead of the police, only to be caught at the scene of a crime. Patrick has faith in Nancy and decides to give her an exciting new opportunity at Hollyoaks High, but can she step up to the mark?

videos.title: Lending a Helping Hand
videos.overview: Nancy asks Esther for help at the school, but the students get more than they expected when Grace gets involved. Elsewhere, Lindsey makes it her mission to save Freddie from a life behind bars but only lands herself in the firing line.

videos.title: Unexpected Arrival
videos.overview: Lindsey’s actions leave Celine in a terrible dilemma, while a familiar face returns and makes things even more difficult. Dylan leads Peri down a dangerous path, putting her and her schoolmates in danger, while Nancy desperately turns to Trevor for help.

videos.title: Dealing With the Consequences
videos.overview: Nancy knows what happened at the school was her fault… but will she find the courage to face the consequences? Elsewhere, Jack makes a potentially life changing decision, while Dirk’s painful admission could come back to haunt him.

videos.title: Wrong Move
videos.overview: Nancy continues to struggle with her pill addiction. It has disastrous consequences, and it’s her family who suffer the fallout. Dylan puts Nico in danger when he suggests that they skip school for the day. Meanwhile, Tegan, Celine and Kim’s prank puts their careers on the line.

videos.title: Big Mistake
videos.overview: Frankie forces Esther to choose between her family and Grace & Trevor, while Robbie, Holly & Phoebe’s big day out ends up in a surprising party at The Loft. Elsewhere, Nico’s actions result in a life-threatening situation for Cindy.

videos.title: Survival
videos.overview: It’s a race against time to save Cindy, and Dirk is faced with a tough choice to make. Maxine opens up to Darren about her past and is surprised when Patrick comes to her rescue. Elsewhere, Dylan warns Esther about his dad, while Trevor threatens Robbie about his recent behaviour.

videos.title: Misguided
videos.overview: Dirk’s decision stirs up some unwanted attention, while Holly is disgusted by Robbie’s actions. Kim makes it her mission to spread some joy, with embarrassing consequences for one of her team-mates.

videos.title: Ceasefire
videos.overview: Holly helps Jason settle in at the clinic, while Dirk can’t escape his tormentor. Meanwhile, Tom and Dylan try to call a truce, and Maxine goes to an old foe to help her win custody of Minnie.

videos.title: Truth be Told
videos.overview: Someone is targeting Darren and Maxine, while Ste confides in his old friend Tony about being HIV positive. Elsewhere, Theresa tells Dirk the truth about Myra-Pocahontas but his happiness is short-lived when he receives another threatening reminder about his guilty secret.

videos.title: Plotting and Scheming
videos.overview: In the midst of another row, Diane and Tony are taken back by the return of a familiar face. Elsewhere, Maxine is admitted to hospital, and Peri plots to get rid of Ziggy in a desperate bid for Cameron to return – but she’s shocked when a family secret is revealed.

videos.title: Drastic Action
videos.overview: With her world spiraling out of control, Peri decides to take drastic action, and John Paul’s good mood is ruined by a haunting phone call. Elsewhere, Maxine is shocked when Patrick makes her an offer, leaving her to decide whether to accept for the sake of their daughter.

videos.title: First Glimpses
videos.overview: Ste and Sinead go for a baby scan, while John Paul enlists Trevor's help in getting rid of his demons. Elsewhere, love-sick Tegan offers to help Ziggy plan a Valentine’s Day surprise, but she’s stuck in the middle when Leela reveals her own Valentine’s idea.

videos.title: Blissfully Naïve
videos.overview: Ziggy talks to Tegan about his future with Leela, oblivious to Leela’s big plan, while Porsche’s demands push Lockie down a criminal path, and Diane’s day goes from bad to worse before Patrick’s event at The Hutch. Elsewhere, John Paul has to to choose between Ste and his career.

videos.title: Regret
videos.overview: Porsche locks horns with Trevor over Lockie. It’s the morning after the night before for Diane and she’s shocked by what she’s done. John Paul and Ste’s marriage is put under strain, and JP turns elsewhere for comfort.

videos.title: Step Forward
videos.overview: Lindsey vows to help Freddie, but there are dangerous consequences in store. John Paul struggles to get his life back on track until a reminder of the past makes things ten times worse. Meanwhile, Cleo grows jealous of Holly and Harry’s friendship.

videos.title: Speak of the Devil
videos.overview: As John Paul attempts to overcome his demons, Patrick’s intervention could spell big changes for JP’s future. There’s a new development in the Mercedes murder case, while Grace zeroes in on a new ally in her plot against Freddie.

videos.title: Surprises
videos.overview: Will it be an all-out war or happy families for the Roscoes when Joe makes a shock appearance at JJ’s naming ceremony? Phoebe is stunned by what she discovers when she finds Mercedes’ diary. Tony invites Ste and John Paul over for tea, but a surprise guest could land John Paul in hot water.

videos.title: Challenge
videos.overview: When more evidence stacks up against Freddie, he makes a decision to flee the village. Joe seizes the chance to get Lindsey back, but Lindsey’s got her own agenda. When Tony offers to help Darren with his love life, things do not go to plan. Elsewhere, Cindy doesn't react too well when a newcomer threatens to take away everything she’s worked for.

videos.title: A Father’s Love Knows No Bounds
videos.overview: Joe makes a desperate attempt to get his son back as Freddie and Lindsey make a quick escape, while Jack faces big decisions about his future. Elsewhere, Cindy starts brewing a cunning plan for one of the village newcomers.

videos.title: Taking Small Steps
videos.overview: Things are looking up for Jason when he makes a friend in the clinic, while Kim is in turmoil when someone she loves begs her for help. Elsewhere, Theresa gets herself in trouble when she gets a new job, and there’s a revelation at the hospital that changes the lives of those involved forever.

videos.title: Call in the Back-up
videos.overview: Theresa is relying on a family member when she makes an error of judgement, while it seems Jason’s new friend may not have his best interests at heart. Elsewhere, Lindsey reveals her big plan to Freddie, and Tom puts his relationship with Peri at risk when she gets the total wrong end of the stick.

videos.title: The Party’s Over
videos.overview: Leela makes a huge discovery at Peri’s birthday party, but someone steps in to take the blame. Ziggy is left embarrassed when he steps up to the mark to impress the Lomaxes, and Patrick gives Nico an impossible order.

videos.title: News Spreads Fast
videos.overview: It’s the morning after Peri’s party and the village is shaken by last night’s news. Following the revelation, Leela makes an announcement, leaving two other villagers feeling very awkward. Elsewhere, Jason is faced with his biggest dilemma yet.

videos.title: Truth
videos.overview: Nancy gets too close for comfort and provokes an emotional outburst from a village resident. Maxine receives devastating news that could change everything, and Ste decides he needs to tell the truth about his illness, but worries about how people will react.

videos.title: The Great Escape
videos.overview: Maxine flees with Minnie, but she could be putting her daughter’s life in danger in the process. John Paul’s guilt over Harry begins to spiral out of control when a good deed goes wrong. Elsewhere, Nancy finds herself in the centre of a love triangle… but who will she choose?

videos.title: Risky Business
videos.overview: Someone is closer to discovering John Paul and Harry’s secret than they realise. Meanwhile, Maxine tries everything to put things right before history repeats itself, and Nancy has made her choice, but is worried she’ll live to regret it.

videos.title: Cruel Intentions
videos.overview: Robbie is furious when he discovers Joe’s secret, while Joe is shocked by the return of a familiar face. Patrick ropes Theresa in to a wicked plan with an offer she can’t refuse. Harry gets in over his head trying to be someone he’s not.

videos.title: It's All Coming Up Roscoe
videos.overview: Lockie gives Ziggy a hilarious new business idea, and it looks like Joe’s luck is about to change for the better, but things might not be all that they seem. And Theresa could find herself in danger when Patrick flies off the handle.

videos.title: Haunting Reminders
videos.overview: Grace is spooked out by some reminders of Mercedes, while Porsche gets a bit too close for comfort to a guilty Diane. Elsewhere, Ziggy is mortified when a new business venture takes a very awkward turn, while Lockie stumbles on an opportunity to make some money.

videos.title: Actions Have Reactions
videos.overview: Porsche is on the warpath, and her rage has heart-stopping consequences. Lindsey comes close to uncovering a truth, but a secret someone stands in her way. Elsewhere, Lockie is forced to flee the village when he causes trouble with Trevor.

videos.title: Difficult Decisions
videos.overview: It's decision time for Tom and Peri as the reality of their situation hits, while Lockie teams up with his brother when Porsche is under threat. Elsewhere, Tony is determined to see justice done, while tragedy could be about to strike at the hospital…

videos.title: A Valiant Effort
videos.overview: Lockie puts himself and Cameron in danger as a heroic act goes horribly wrong, while suspicion causes tension between Charles’ Angels at the hospital. Elsewhere, Theresa’s conscience kicks in over her latest scheme.

videos.title: The Pressure is On
videos.overview: Tegan receives some life changing news about her health, while another part of her life is about to crumble. Elsewhere, the pressure is building for Peri and Tom, and Patrick gives Theresa a challenge that puts her in a moral dilemma.

videos.title: Rescue
videos.overview: Maxine seems doomed to fail when a secret plot threatens her chances with Social Services. Will a guardian angel be her saviour? Porsche drags a dangerous ally into her bid for revenge against Lockie, and Peri’s mind is made up… until her situation spirals out of control.

videos.title: War Games
videos.overview: A night out with Porsche and Theresa could cost Maxine her future. Meanwhile, it’s a race against time for Darren and Cameron after a shock revelation. Trevor locks horns with a fellow villager as things turn nasty, while Grace is on the warpath. Eeeeeek!

videos.title: Liar Liar
videos.overview: Grace is determined to get to the bottom of Trevor’s betrayal, and Kim gets more than she bargained for when she confronts Grace. Dirk’s torture over the poison pen letter escalates… what is he going to do?! And a surprise intervention leads to a shock result for scheming Patrick.

videos.title: The Tip Off
videos.overview: Dirk’s tormentor could be closer to home than he thought. Fresh clues about the Mercedes case emerge, while Grace and Kim have to deal with the consequences of their actions. Patrick fears for Nico, but is it all as it seems?

videos.title: Homecoming
videos.overview: It’s a big day for Jason as he finally leaves the clinic. When more truths surrounding Will’s death surface, Dirk is forced to pray the price. Elsewhere, Kim comes dangerously close to blowing things apart for Freddie and Lindsey.

videos.title: Revenge
videos.overview: Sinead hits the jackpot when she stumbles across Lindsey’s plan. Robbie finds himself out of his depth, and makes a shock discovery, while Joe ensures the rogue responsible for a recent attack will pay the price. Meanwhile, Jason uncovers fresh leads about missing Freddie.

videos.title: Big Mistake
videos.overview: Robbie goes off the rails, but will anyone come to his rescue before he hits self-destruct? Kim’s scheme could prove detrimental for one Roscoe brother. Desperate Tom clutches at straws, and Lindsey appeals to Sinead… is this the start of an unlikely alliance?

videos.title: Impulsive Proposal
videos.overview: Tegan is speechless when a notorious face turns up on her doorstep. Meanwhile, an astonishing secret is exposed after an impulsive proposal. Elsewhere, someone is out for revenge on the McQueens and will stop at nothing to see the family crumble.

videos.title: The Trail
videos.overview: Patrick sees red after a recent revelation. The walls are closing in on one villager as the police gather more evidence surrounding Mercedes’ murder. Meanwhile, Tegan’s condition takes a turn for the worse…

videos.title: Desperation
videos.overview: With time running out, Tegan is forced to make some tough decisions. Grace is out for revenge when she discovers that her plans have been thwarted. Elsewhere, a desperate Ziggy is pushed to the limit, and makes a bold decision…

videos.title: Dilemma
videos.overview: Tony and Diane go in search of answers, while a blast from the past causes havoc for Dr S'Avage. Meanwhile, a frantic Ziggy takes desperate measures…with criminal consequences.

videos.title: Hush Hush
videos.overview: Someone threatens to expose the truth about Dr S'Avage, but what’s his big secret? Reality hits Ste and Leela as they take the law into their own hands. And it’s decision time for Darren - will he do a deal with the devil?

videos.title: Old Habits Die Hard
videos.overview: Ziggy’s faced with an impossible decision… what will he decide? Diane’s search for justice has frightening consequences, which put her family in the firing line. Elsewhere, Cindy spies a new romance blooming, while Sienna starts to scheme a way out of the psychiatric unit.

videos.title: All is Fair in Love and War
videos.overview: Tegan has to cover her heartbreak when Leela makes an announcement, while Celine plots to keep love on course. Sienna has something planned, and sets her sights on Dr S’Avage, and Maxine and Darren find themselves closer and closer. Jason’s new career brings a surprise revelation for Cindy, which results in devastating consequences.

videos.title: The Hero
videos.overview: As Jason leaps to Cindy’s rescue, Darren has his own suspicions about the culprit, and Maxine discovers Darren’s not all he seems. Patrick and Theresa take their working relationship to the next level, and Esther is heart-broken by desperate Phoebe’s situation.

videos.title: Unexpected Discoveries
videos.overview: Theresa makes a shocking discovery when doing a good deed, while Darren takes matters into his own hands, but soon finds the police are one step ahead of him. Elsewhere, things are getting worse for innocent Phoebe, leaving Esther desperate to find a way to help her friend.

videos.title: Truths Threaten to Surface
videos.overview: Patrick gains an ally, but can he trust them to keep his secret safe? Sinead finds herself caught up in a dangerous game when she does a deal with Freddie, while a surprise phone call sends Grace into a panic… her plan is unravelling - fast.

videos.title: Party’s Over
videos.overview: An awkward double booking at The Dog brings two sets of sworn enemies face to face… but there’s a big shock in store when DS Thorpe makes a very public arrest. Elsewhere, in a moment of madness, Kim reveals a dark secret from her past.

videos.title: Happy Ever After?
videos.overview: Cracks start to show in John Paul’s fairy-tale when Sinead comes between him and Ste. Trevor’s loyalty is pushed to the limit when Grace refuses to abandon her master plan, and Joe is desperate to convince Nancy of the truth after a shocking revelation.

videos.title: Woman on the Edge
videos.overview: Feeling guilty and alone, Sinead’s emotions threaten to spiral out of control, while Ste re-opens some old wounds, but it’s at a cost to John Paul. Elsewhere, Porsche and Celine attempt to build bridges… but will they be forgiven?

videos.title: Two’s Company
videos.overview: Three is a crowd for Sinead, John Paul and Ste. Cleo pushes boundaries to get back at Harry, a decision she might end up regretting. Meanwhile, Porsche’s buried secrets threaten to resurface, while Diane takes her battle for Rose and Dee Dee to the next level.

videos.title: Time to Confess
videos.overview: Harry braces himself to come clean about one of his many secrets, and Peri panics as her dilemma gets bigger every day. Lockie faces a tough decision to help Porsche, which forces him to choose between his past and his present.

videos.title: Unexpected Emotions
videos.overview: Celine gets more than she bargained for when deep emotions are stirred because of her interfering. Sparks fly for Darren as the search for his mystery woman continues. Elsewhere, Tegan needs to decide whether she should continue to conceal her true feelings or finally confess.

videos.title: Uninvited Problems
videos.overview: An unwelcome face tells Porsche their plans to stick around. Tensions erupt for Leela over her wedding day plans, while Cameron gets his hands on evidence that could make his dreams come true. Meanwhile, Cindy makes a difficult decision about her future with Dirk.

videos.title: No Way Out
videos.overview: Cameron’s meddling may have gone too far and Tegan is forced to reveal her true feelings as the pressure mounts. Jason and Cindy get a bit too close for comfort when they use each other as a shoulder to cry on.

videos.title: A Day to Remember
videos.overview: Leela starts to blame her loved ones following the recent attack, while jealous forces are out to stop her wedding to Ziggy. Nico and Dylan come up with an idea to cheer Peri up, but it seems like more than just a bit of fun to Dylan. Elsewhere, Theresa tries to call a truce, but Sienna has other plans…

videos.title: The Head or the Heart?
videos.overview: Time is running out for Ziggy at the wedding, but what will his heart decide? Elsewhere, Tegan faces another battle with Diane, while Cameron’s biggest secret could be about to come spilling out…

videos.title: More Than They Bargained For
videos.overview: Patrick and Sienna are in for a shock after a visit to the hospital, while Theresa is approached with a new career prospect. Elsewhere, Cameron has to choose between his pride and his freedom, while Kim’s obsession with Grace continues to grow.

videos.title: Not Giving in
videos.overview: Cameron has met his match, but he won’t go down without a fight. Elsewhere, Theresa faces tough decisions about her future, and Nancy can’t keep Kim’s dark secret for much longer, so decides to confide in someone.

videos.title: Relationship on the Brink
videos.overview: Kim tries to claw her way back into Esther’s affections, while a livid Lindsey sets out for revenge. Elsewhere, Trevor is furious when a video of Dylan goes viral.

videos.title: Unlikely Ally
videos.overview: Trevor vows to clear Grace’s name… but he’s going to need Darren’s help. Lindsey’s shocked to discover the truth about Kim’s new obsession, as a dark secret from the sisters’ childhood is revealed. Sienna confronts her father over secrets and lies, while Sinead is delighted by the arrival of a flamboyant newcomer.

videos.title: Ghosts from the Past
videos.overview: Lindsey is haunted by reminders of her childhood and resolves to face her demons. Darren double-crosses his family, but a rare act of brotherly love from Joe leaves him guilty. Will Sienna’s revenge on Patrick leave her father in serious trouble?

videos.title: Defended
videos.overview: A new cell-mate threatens to make life difficult for Grace, while Kim reaches rock-bottom in a bid to get her girl. Harry protects Dylan against school bullies, putting his chances of footballing success on the line. A new arrival threatens to come between John Paul and Ste.

videos.title: Lottery of Secrets
videos.overview: Dylan hatches a revenge plan, but doesn't realise that he could end up the loser when things backfire. Porsche’s world crumbles when she realises the past is about to catch up with her. John Paul struggles to reconcile with the new lodger, unaware he’s about to expose his dark secret. Meanwhile, Kim resorts to extreme measures to get closer to her target.

videos.title: Not According to Plan
videos.overview: Sinead’s meddling has tragic consequences. Porsche has a plan to protect her sisters, but getting Celine and Cleo on board won’t be as easy as she’d hoped. Grace feels the full force of Kim’s obsession, while Dylan resorts to crime in a bit to conceal his secret.

videos.title: The Pay Off
videos.overview: Harry is rewarded for his silence but the prospect of prison may force him to reveal the truth. Dylan’s secret looks set to be revealed when Trevor makes an intimate discovery, and Diane is charmed by a wolf in sheep’s clothing, but will she wise up before any real damage is done?

videos.title: Man on a Mission
videos.overview: Tony is determined to expose the truth about a love-rat, but looks set to embarrass himself instead. Elsewhere, Harry pays the price for tangling with the school bullies, and Esther plays peacemaker but ends up doing more harm than good.

videos.title: Unlucky for Some
videos.overview: Lockie pushes his luck too far, while it looks like the game is up for Porsche when Tony plays detective. Elsewhere, Zack is disgusted by a schoolyard confession, and John Paul fears he’s lost Ste forever, while Sinead confronts the real culprit.

videos.title: Relationship in Tatters
videos.overview: Sienna tries to build bridges with Nico, but only ends up making things worse. Tegan questions a friend’s motives when he gets too close for comfort, while Zack and Holly’s cunning plan leads to heartbreak. Elsewhere, Lockie’s lies may have gone too far, and Porsche gets a call from Reenie about her release.

videos.title: ‘Ello, ‘Ello, ‘Ello
videos.overview: Holly’s determined to prove her love to Jason, but it comes at a cost to herself. Elsewhere, desperate Porsche decides her best bet is to play dirty, while Nico puts herself in danger, and gripped by jealousy, Mariam is out for blood.

videos.title: Double Bluff
videos.overview: Sienna teams up with Dr S'Avage , while Mariam suspects someone of murder; could the Gloved Hand killer be revealed? Elsewhere, Holly passes her driving test, while Lockie plots to steal money from Diane to give to a desperate Porsche.

videos.title: Trouble is Brewing
videos.overview: Tegan is furious to bump into an intoxicated Mariam, who is still on the hunt for evidence to condemn Dr S’Avage. Meanwhile, Sienna stumbles into a horrifying situation, Dirk finds out about Cindy’s debts and Simone captures a naughty kiss on Louis’ new drone.

videos.title: Meddling Shopkeeper
videos.overview: Simone accidentally lets slip Cindy’s big secret to a devastated Holly. Elsewhere, Dr S’Avage is arrested after being found with some very suspicious evidence.

videos.title: Tropical Surprise!
videos.overview: Lockie tries to win Porsche’s forgiveness by organising a surprise BBQ at the McQueens. Threats are being thrown around between Patrick and Sienna, while Tegan is questioned by the police. Meanwhile, Cindy and Dirk finally tie the knot, even after Jason tells Dirk the real reason behind her excessive spending.

videos.title: Fire! Fire!
videos.overview: The BBQ sets fire to the McQueens and it is a race against time for Phoebe to get Lockie and Porsche out. Elsewhere, Darren is shocked with who he finds in the boot of Trevor’s car, while Freddie taunts Grace knowing he has the upper hand.

videos.title: Wedding Crasher
videos.overview: It’s Freddie and Lindsey’s wedding day, but a fight between the Roscoe brothers halts the celebrations when Joe bursts into the church. Grace is released from prison and is presented with an engagement ring from Trevor, but the magical moment is short-lived when a betrayal is revealed. Elsewhere, Sinead's waters break.

videos.title: Ruthless Revenge
videos.overview: Tensions are running high in the village when Grace pulls out a gun on Freddie, but the tables are dramatically turned when Joe gets a grasp of the trigger. Patrick is furious to oversee Darren and Maxine kiss but is persuaded by Theresa to apply for joint custody.

videos.title: Mr. Mischievous
videos.overview: It’s the day of Maxine and Patrick’s court hearing for custody of Minnie, and Patrick plans to ruin Maxine’s chances by blackmailing Darren. Sinead’s labour is taking longer than expected so is sent home and, high on emotion, kisses Ste.

videos.title: Labour Day
videos.overview: Patrick and Maxine fight their case for the custody of Minnie but Patrick’s evil foul play begins when Maxine is found with a water bottle filled with alcohol and is escorted out of the hearing. Elsewhere, Sinead goes in to labour for real on the kitchen floor of The Hutch.

videos.title: Full Custody
videos.overview: Maxine is devastated when Patrick wins full custody of Minnie and struggles to cope with her emotions. Sinead and Ste bring baby Hay home to the flat, but she becomes worried when she finds out that he’s broken up with John Paul.

videos.title: Accidental Damage
videos.overview: Zack’s antics cause an argument in the group, which distracts him from the road, as he accidentally hits a bystander. Meanwhile, Maxine convinces Darren not to go to the police, while Patrick lies to Theresa to keep her onside. Elsewhere, Simone informs Lindsey that she has bought her flat and plans to move in right away.

videos.title: Uncovered Secrets
videos.overview: Kim finds a silky camisole underneath Dylan’s clothes, and Nico jumps to conclusions. Jason tries to get rid of any evidence from the car crash but ends up discovering something a lot worse. Cleo receives some suspicious CCTV footage which makes her doubt Harry, and Freddie tells Lindsey that he has found somewhere for them to live, which could be controversial.

videos.title: Background Check
videos.overview: Ben is having issues with his new recruit and decides to do some digging. Nico is fed some lies to protect Dylan’s secret, this backfires and Sienna finds herself in danger. Elsewhere, Harry has to prove himself to Cleo in order to regain her trust.

videos.title: Breaking Point
videos.overview: Dr S'Avage agrees to help Sienna, but after realising the truth about Dylan, Nico begs for Sienna’s forgiveness, but it could be too late. Porsche goes to desperate measures to gather some cash, while Cindy tries to relieve some of Jason’s tension. Meanwhile, Esther is surprised when Kim tells her about Kath.

videos.title: Looking for Comfort
videos.overview: Sienna regrets her actions, and finds solace in a certain doctor’s arms. Celine gets involved in some dodgy dealings to stop Porsche from going too far, and Reenie arrives in the village. Meanwhile Grace tests Esther’s feelings for Kim to prove a point.

videos.title: Happy Families
videos.overview: Grace is overwhelmed with jealousy when Dylan’s mum turns up at the hospital. Reenie invites the family to lunch at The Dog and insists she’s staying for good, so Porsche hatches a plan to send her straight back to prison.

videos.title: Dark Revelations
videos.overview: Things take a sinister turn when Reenie’s boyfriend Pete arrives at the McQueens and a dark revelation is uncovered. Elsewhere, Grace is in hospital and a love-struck Kim continues with her malicious antics.

videos.title: Blinded from the Truth
videos.overview: Porsche is devastated when Reenie accuses her of lying about Pete’s assault. John Paul offers to babysit baby Hay as Ste struggles to juggle work and fatherhood, while Sinead wishes to reveal her secret crush.

videos.title: Cry Wolf
videos.overview: Sinead is convinced that John Paul wants Ste back so she causes havoc to gain Ste’s attention. Sienna helps Dr S’avage clean out Mariam’s house, but finds there are a number of precious items missing.

videos.title: Part-Time Burglars
videos.overview: Cameron and Celine break into Mariam’s house and plan to get a painting back for Dr S’Avage. An argument erupts between Sinead and Ste, which leads him to visit someone from the past.

videos.title: 50 Shades of Cindy
videos.overview: There’s some awkward chemistry in the air when Cindy begins to pen an erotic novel and ropes Jason into helping her. Ste insists he wants to do the ‘family thing’ with Sinead, and Nico plans a chilling revenge for her mother.

videos.title: Blake vs McQueen
videos.overview: Reenie and Sienna battle it out for a job at Price Slice, whilst Nico collapses in the flat after her malicious plan to hurt her mother goes terribly wrong.

videos.title: Against Time
videos.overview: Phoebe’s health is deteriorating as John Paul desperately tries to find a way to get through to her. Elsewhere, Scott is disgusted to hear Sinead wants him to move out of the flat.

videos.title: All Aboard The Party Bus
videos.overview: Lockie attempts to calm a troubled Porsche from drinking her problems away, but his efforts are wasted when she leaves on a party bus. Elsewhere, John Paul breaks the news of Phoebe’s unconsciousness to a heartbroken Robbie.

videos.title: Secrets Under Covers
videos.overview: Porsche returns home from another night out, grabs Lockie and takes him upstairs to the shock of John Paul who catches them in the act. Dr S’Avage presents a twinkle of hope for the McQueens, but a grief-stricken Robbie endeavours to halt Phoebe’s treatment.

videos.title: No Entry
videos.overview: Robbie persists to barricade Phoebe’s hospital room door, while the McQueens desperately struggle to get in. Elsewhere, Tegan is put-out by the return of loved-up Leela and Ziggy.

videos.title: Mistaken Identity
videos.overview: Thinking that Grace shot Phoebe, Robbie seeks help in getting revenge. Meanwhile, Tegan is furious to see her potential date giving Celine flowers.

videos.title: Guilty Conscience
videos.overview: Joe decides to hand himself in to the police for shooting Phoebe, while Trevor is distracted in the flat by Val, unaware that Kim’s hidden camera is watching them.

videos.title: Say Cheese!
videos.overview: Val makes a move on Trevor and kisses him, which is all caught on camera. At the garage, Mercedes urges Robbie to stop Joe going to the police with a reason he can’t ignore.

videos.title: Photo Bomb
videos.overview: During Esther’s baby shower, Kim maliciously shows Grace the photos of Val and Trevor kissing. Elsewhere, Ziggy is seething with jealousy when he returns to find Tegan and Tony getting cosy with a game of Twister.

videos.title: The Power of Love
videos.overview: Grace starts pretending she’s in love with Kim to keep her sweet. Tony arranges a drink with Tegan, only for it to be sabotaged by a jealous ex, but whose? Elsewhere, Scott plans revenge on Ste and Sinead, and Holly realises the messages from Zoe aren’t coming from Switzerland…

videos.title: Green with Envy
videos.overview: Ziggy tries to tell Tegan that Tony is using her, but Tony manages to convince her otherwise. Elsewhere, Dirk fools Cindy into thinking she’s won a writer’s competition. In the Magic Bean, Holly messages ‘Zoe’ and is shocked to see a message arrive on a phone where Louis Loveday is at.

videos.title: Biting the Bullet
videos.overview: Thinking Louis is behind the messages from Zoe, Holly, Cleo and Harry tell Zack about the folder. Elsewhere, Tegan threatens to flee the village with Rose after getting into an argument with Diane, but is there an even bigger shock in store?

videos.title: Doing the Right Thing?
videos.overview: Leela suspects Diane is lying about her whereabouts when Rose was snatched, so she heads to The Hutch for clues. Elsewhere in the village, everyone is shocked when the police make an arrest.

videos.title: Incriminating Evidence
videos.overview: DS Thorpe questions Tegan, while Tony asks Darren to give him an alibi. Elsewhere, Zack is furious when Louis doesn’t stand up for their family, and Ben and Sienna’s relationship continues to bloom.

videos.title: Lights, Camera, Action!
videos.overview: Accusations are thrown around the village for the kidnapping of baby Rose. During the press conference, Tony suspects the worst and drops Diane in the firing line. Elsewhere, Louis tells Zack they’ve decided to leave Hollyoaks.

videos.title: Master of Manipulation
videos.overview: Patrick attempts to meddle in Sienna's love life by insinuating that Ben is no good for her. Meanwhile, a hooded intruder is spotted in a family home.

videos.title: Independent Woman
videos.overview: Patrick maliciously flaunts Minnie in the village, but Maxine is stronger than ever with a new business venture to secure a future for her and Minnie. Meanwhile, Jason becomes increasingly jealous of Holly and Zack’s relationship.

videos.title: Should I Stay or Should I Go?
videos.overview: An argument erupts between Sienna and Patrick, so Ben gives her the choice to leave with him and offers his hand. Elsewhere, the attraction between Jason and Cindy is uncontrollable.

videos.title: Loyalty Lies
videos.overview: Pete attempts to fit in within the village, while Porsche is devastated to see Lockie socialising with her abuser. Sienna takes extreme measures after Nico warns her about the possibility of another woman in Ben’s life.

videos.title: Secrets and Lies
videos.overview: Ben’s past starts catching up with him, while Robbie flies into a fit of rage after a heartbreaking discovery. Elsewhere, Porsche despairs when some sinister secrets bubble to the surface.

videos.title: A United Front
videos.overview: The McQueens are in meltdown, but can they pull together for Phoebe’s funeral? Lockie and Porsche are at breaking point, and Mercedes is devastated when Joe gives her a few home truths.

videos.title: Betrayal
videos.overview: Cleo’s betrayed by someone she thought she was close to, but how far is she prepared to go to save her Mum? Elsewhere, an unlikely hero means Ziggy can attend the audition of his life, and John Paul let’s out his devilish side for the sake of love.

videos.title: Facing Facts
videos.overview: Mercedes decides to confront the truth, which has huge consequences. Elsewhere in the village, Nancy‘s in for a shock from a mystery admirer, and Lindsey takes drastic action when she uncovers a conspiracy that could ruin her future.

videos.title: New Beginnings
videos.overview: Reenie promises to turn over a new leaf, but is it too little too late? Elsewhere, the Roscoes race against time to finally put things right, while Theresa comes up with a wicked scheme, but she could be totally overstepping the mark…

videos.title: Motherly Instincts
videos.overview: Maxine hears Minnie crying through the window of Patrick's flat, she goes to investigate and sees him collapsed on the floor. Meanwhile, Mercedes and Joe discuss how to tell Lindsey about their baby.

videos.title: New Arrival
videos.overview: Leela introduces her cousin Angela to the village and gives hope to Peri in finding prospective adoptive parents for her baby. Elsewhere, Patrick’s secret is out when Maxine discovers leaflets about MND.

videos.title: Close Encounter
videos.overview: Prior to the re-opening of The Loft, Grace panics when Kim plasters the walls with photos of them kissing. She confronts her and they share a passionate kiss... but are they alone? Elsewhere, Patrick is furious when Theresa reveals his illness to Darren.

videos.title: Bold and Beautiful
videos.overview: Trevor is shocked to see Dylan wearing women’s clothing and locks him in the flat, so Dylan plans a merciless act of revenge on his father. Meanwhile, Kim spikes Esther's drink with a drug that induces labour.

videos.title: Family Quarrels
videos.overview: Trevor lashes out and accidentally hits Dylan for vandalising the new Loft. Elsewhere, Dr S’Avage continues to misread the signs from Sienna and Dirk insists that she only feels sorry for him.

videos.title: Unexpected Attractions
videos.overview: Dr S'Avage finds himself the object of an unlikely suitor’s affections, while another villager has a life changing decision to make. Elsewhere, Reenie has a high price to pay for the night before.

videos.title: Blake VS McQueen
videos.overview: Sienna gives a scheming McQueen a taste of her own medicine, while Grace and Trevor have a devious trick up their sleeves, but can they pull it off? Elsewhere, it’s time for Lockie to choose whether to follow his head or his heart.

videos.title: Interfering Individual
videos.overview: Frankie’s interfering threatens to have devastating consequences for Tom and Peri. Cleo visits a familiar face in an act of desperation, and Porsche is out for blood as she plots a cruel act of revenge. Elsewhere, Sienna is helped by a secret saviour.

videos.title: Mother on a Mission
videos.overview: Leela is on the warpath and Frankie’s meddling tips her over the edge. Cleo is reeled back into a web of deceit, while Tegan is playing with fire when she turns to someone she shouldn’t.

videos.title: Hauntings of the Past
videos.overview: Zack is at breaking point when the Lovedays refuse to let go of the past. Tegan panics when her good deed jeopardises everything, while Ziggy makes a horrifying discovery, but will he keep it to himself?

videos.title: Revelations and Repercussions
videos.overview: Heartbroken and distraught, Louis could be about to push his family too far. Ziggy needs to make a life-altering decision when the truth dawns on him, and Harry’s suspicions grow, but will he realise the threat is so close to home?

videos.title: One Step Forward, Two Jumps Back
videos.overview: When there’s a danger of losing everything, Zack chases after Lisa. Elsewhere, Robbie’s good deed turns into a chaotic nightmare, while Cindy falls head first into her old ways.

videos.title: Actions and Consequences
videos.overview: Cindy’s mortifying moment has her embarrassed and nervous. Elsewhere, Robbie spies an appealing opportunity and is determined to take action, while Lisa’s stories start to untangle when someone sees something they shouldn’t.

videos.title: Good Intentions
videos.overview: Nico urges Sienna to forgive and forget when Ben attempts to make amends, but does he have underlying intentions? Elsewhere in the village, Nancy is given a lavish gift from a very untrustworthy source.

videos.title: Temptation and Turmoil
videos.overview: Extreme measures are taken when Sienna tries to get to the bottom of her lover’s secret, while Jason has to choose between a brother in need and a job he loves. Elsewhere, Holly tries to resist temptation after her actions the night before.

videos.title: When Pranks Turn Sour
videos.overview: A schoolboy prank upsets Celine, revealing a dark secret, could she be the gloved hand? Meanwhile, Sienna is left reeling when Ben sheds new light on his mystery woman, and wonders whether she might have made a huge mistake. Darren sees red when Patrick gets closer to Maxine.

videos.title: Worse To Come
videos.overview: Sienna and Nico struggle to hold it together in the aftermath of a horrific accident, but does it end there? Cameron and Celine finally get some time alone, while Zack tries to make amends with Lisa and reunites his family.

videos.title: Under Pressure
videos.overview: Sienna fights to keep her cool but Nico looks like she might crumble under the pressure. Unsettled after the events of the previous night, Celine looks like she may slip back into her old ways. Elsewhere, Darren becomes increasingly agitated by Patrick and struggles to keep his temper under control.

videos.title: Nasty News
videos.overview: Dr S'Avage delivers some crushing news to Patrick, but Maxine continues to show her support. A jealous Kim fumes as Grace and Trevor look set to get their happy ever after. Meanwhile, Jason and Robbie make amends, but Jason struggles to keep his brother on the right path.

videos.title: Test of Temptation
videos.overview: Robbie chases after his forbidden love. Elsewhere, Grace and Frankie lock horns over a villager’s latest meddling and Dylan will stop at nothing to prove himself to his father.

videos.title: Pushed to the Limit
videos.overview: Twin rivalry reaches new heights when Robbie and Jason lock horns, resulting in a terrible accident. Elsewhere, Trevor’s determined to get rid of Kim once and for all, and Scott spins a web of deceit to get Ste on his side.

videos.title: Embarrassing Encounters
videos.overview: Tom infuriates Peri when he humiliates her at the baby scan. Sparks fly between a forbidden couple, while Grace’s blood runs cold when Frankie gets too close for comfort.

videos.title: A Leopard Never Changes its Spots
videos.overview: Frankie has a trick up her sleeve to get her own way, while Leela sees red when she finds out the shocking truth about what Tom’s been up to. Elsewhere, Sinead spots an intimate moment she shouldn’t have – and can’t help but interfere.

videos.title: Meddling Ways
videos.overview: Porsche comes up with a secret scheme, and Cleo is torn between her heart and her head when she realises she has some big decisions to make. Elsewhere in the village, Ben’s looking for revenge on Trevor when he’s given a tip-off.

videos.title: Unhappy Birthday
videos.overview: It’s Porsche’s birthday, but there’s trouble brewing, in true McQueen style. Sinead’s interfering goes disastrously wrong due to an awkward case of mistaken identity, while Mercedes flies off the rails when she follows her gut instinct about a lie.

videos.title: Steal a Kiss
videos.overview: Harry and Ste get a lot closer, while Sinead realises the mistake she has made. Porsche's birthday party doesn’t go to plan when Reenie spoils the decorations.
